title: Genome-anchored foundation model embeddings improve molecular prediction from histology images
abstract: Precision oncology requires accurate molecular insights, yet obtaining these directly from genomics is costly and time-consuming for broad clinical use. Predicting complex molecular features and patient prognosis directly from routine whole-slide images (WSIs) remains a major challenge for current deep learning methods. Here we introduce PathLUPI, which uses transcriptomic privileged information during training to extract genome-anchored histological embeddings, enabling effective molecular prediction using only WSIs at inference. Through extensive evaluation across 49 molecular oncology tasks using 11,361 cases from 20 cohorts, PathLUPI demonstrates superior performance compared to conventional methods trained solely on WSIs. Crucially, it achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of at least 0.80 across 18 biomarker prediction and molecular subtyping tasks, and a concordance index of at least 0.70 across survival cohorts spanning five major cancer types. Moreover, PathLUPI embeddings reveal distinct cellular morphological signatures associated with specific genotypes, whose spatial fidelity is substantiated in representative high-resolution spatial transcriptomics samples. By effectively encoding molecular context to refine WSI representations, PathLUPI offers a strategy to bridge molecular insights with routine pathology workflows for wider clinical application.
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
Macau University of Science and Technology
First Affiliated Hospital of Jinan University

llm.novelty_zh: 训练阶段以转录组作为特权信息学习基因组锚定的组织学嵌入，使推理时仅需全切片图像即可预测分子特征。
llm.summary_zh: PathLUPI在训练中以转录组作为特权信息，得到与基因型相关的组织学嵌入，推理时只需全切片图像。作者在20个队列、11361例病例的49个分子肿瘤学任务上进行评估，并报告了生物标志物预测与生存分析的性能指标。

llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: Building a pre-trained model for single-cell multi-omics analysis beyond highly variable feature selection
abstract: Single-cell multi-omics technologies enable simultaneous measurement of transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic modalities in individual cells, offering a unique opportunity to dissect cellular identity and regulation. The heterogeneity of multi-omics data, together with the wide range of downstream analytical tasks, underscores the need for a versatile computational framework for integrative analysis. However, current multi-omics analysis approaches typically rely on task-specific training and highly variable feature selection, which can hinder effective knowledge transfer across datasets and discard biologically informative signals. Here, we present scPMMI, a pre-trained multimodal model for integrative analysis of single-cell multi-omics data. By grouping features into patches according to genomic coordinates, scPMMI processes tens of thousands of features per cell with reduced reliance on prior feature selection, thereby preserving more complete biological information. Our results demonstrate that scPMMI learns biologically coherent cell representations by jointly modeling multi-omics data. Through further transfer learning, the model can be readily adapted to achieve superior performance across diverse downstream tasks, including multi-omics integration, cell type annotation, protein abundance prediction, transcriptomic enhancement, and trajectory reconstruction.
affiliations: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

llm.novelty_zh: 按基因组坐标将特征分组为 patch，减少单细胞多组学对高变基因筛选的依赖。
llm.summary_zh: scPMMI 是面向单细胞多组学的预训练多模态模型，按基因组位置对数万特征分块处理，并通过迁移学习适配多种下游任务，包括整合、细胞类型注释、蛋白丰度预测和轨迹重建。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为单细胞多组学的预训练表征提供了无需特征筛选的思路。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及预训练数据规模与具体对比基线的数值。

title: DiffKnock: diffusion-based knockoff inference for neural networks with applications to single-cell RNA-sequencing data
abstract: High-throughput single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) technologies have revolutionized our ability to characterize cellular heterogeneity and dissect gene regulatory mechanisms. These data, however, are inherently high-dimensional and correlated, posing substantial challenges for statistical inference and feature selection. Identifying disease-related genes, while rigorously controlling false discoveries, remains a key challenge in scRNA-seq data analysis. Traditional methods often rely on parametric assumptions, which may fail to capture complex relationships and can suffer from inflated false discovery rates (FDRs) in high-dimensional settings. We introduce DiffKnock, a diffusion-based knockoff framework for high-dimensional feature selection with finite-sample FDR control. DiffKnock addresses two key limitations of existing knockoff methods: preserving complex feature dependencies and detecting nonlinear associations. Our approach leverages diffusion models to generate valid knockoffs and employs neural network-based gradient and filter statistics to construct antisymmetric feature importance measures. Through simulations, DiffKnock demonstrates higher power than autoencoder-based, GAN-based, and Gaussian-based knockoff methods while maintaining target FDR, indicating superior performance in scenarios with complex nonlinear relationships. By applying the method to murine single-cell RNA-seq data of LPS-stimulated macrophages, we also identified canonical NF-$\kappa $B target genes (Ccl3, Hmox1). In another application to Religious Orders Study and Rush Memory and Aging Project donor-level pseudobulk transcriptomic data, DiffKnock further identifies a strong microglial signal for CERAD score, with PTPRG emerging as the most stable selected gene under both gradient- and filter-based statistics. These results highlight that, by combining flexible deep generative models with rigorous statistics, DiffKnock is a powerful and reliable tool for analyzing scRNA-seq data and other high-dimensional structured data.
affiliations: Department of Biostatistics, University of Florida, Gainesville, FL, United States.

llm.novelty_zh: 用扩散模型生成 knockoff 变量，并结合神经网络统计量进行有限样本 FDR 控制。
llm.summary_zh: DiffKnock 利用扩散模型构造 knockoff 以保留特征间复杂依赖，并用神经网络梯度与过滤统计量进行特征选择。模拟中功效高于基于自编码器、GAN 和高斯的方法，并在 LPS 刺激巨噬细胞和阿尔茨海默病队列中找到已知与新的相关基因。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为高维单细胞数据中的显著性推断提供了可控 FDR 的工具。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及大规模数据上的运行时间。

title: Spatially extended Flow Phixer (SpeF-Phixer): A spatially extended ϕ-mixing framework for spatial regulatory motif discovery in reconstructed gene fields
abstract: Background and objective Spatial transcriptomics provides rich spatial context for studying tissue organization and gene regulation. However, approaches capable of extracting similar spatial regulatory information from routine histological images remain limited. We developed Spatially extended Flow Phixer (SpeF-Phixer), a spatially extended phi-mixing framework integrating whole-slide image (WSI)-derived spatial cell distributions with mapped scRNA-seq expression fields to identify spatially organized directional dependency motifs. Methods Using CD103/CD8-immunostained colorectal cancer WSIs and publicly available scRNA-seq datasets, spatial gene fields were constructed around mapped cells and discretized for signed phi-mixing computation. Pairwise dependencies, directional signs, and triplet structures were evaluated through k-nearest neighbor-based neighborhood screening and bootstrap consensus inference. Mediation and convergence were distinguished using generalized additive models. Spatial organization and directional consistency were further characterized using real-null comparisons and database-supported direction analyses. Results Across tissue patches, the pipeline reduced approximately 36,000 triplet candidates to a stable consensus set of approximately 300 triplets per patch. The downstream edge from Y to Z showed significant directional bias consistent with curated regulatory databases. Spatial path tracing demonstrated markedly higher coherence for inferred triplets than for null controls, indicating that the identified motifs exhibit non-random spatial organization. Conclusion SpeF-Phixer identifies spatially coherent and directionally consistent three-gene regulatory motifs from histological images. This framework links single-cell molecular profiles with tissue architecture and provides a scalable foundation for spatial regulatory motif discovery and exploratory reconstruction of spatially informed regulatory networks.

datasets_used: colorectal cancer whole-slide images with CD103/CD8 immunostaining
llm.novelty_zh: 将全切片图像中的空间细胞分布与scRNA-seq表达场结合，用signed phi-mixing识别空间调控三元组基序。
llm.summary_zh: 研究利用CD103/CD8免疫组化结直肠癌全切片图像与公开scRNA-seq数据，构建空间基因场并计算有向依赖关系。作者通过KNN邻域筛选与bootstrap一致性推断，将约36,000个三元组候选缩减为每个切片约300个稳定三元组，并与真实-空模型比较空间路径的一致性。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法尝试从常规组织切片中推断空间调控信息，为低成本获取调控线索提供了思路。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及实验验证，有向调控关系主要由数据库一致性间接支持。

title: Cell lines that share a well are not independent observations in the Tahoe-100M drug screen
abstract: Pooled drug screens treat and sequence dozens of cancer cell lines together in one well. Tahoe-100M, the largest, is used to train and benchmark models that predict how unmeasured cell lines respond to drugs, and its benchmarks, reproducibility ceilings and statistical tests treat the cell lines of a well, and random halves of a well's cells, as independent observations of a drug's effect. Because the drug is applied to the well, this is harmless only if the lines of a well share nothing beyond the drug's reproducible effect. We tested this with pairs of untreated control wells on 13 plates, with replicate wells whose labels we checked, and with two plates that repeat each other well by well. In each test the cell lines of a well share a component of expression that a replicate well does not reproduce, also when the two wells occupy the same inferred position; where drugs are present, it cannot be told apart from an interaction of plate and drug, but in untreated wells it can. In replicate wells at different positions whose labels pass the check, about a third of what two halves of a well have in common (35%, 95% interval 22-58%, 9 compounds) is not reproduced by the replicate well. The well effect inflates results that take something from a well and judge it in the same well: retrained versions of two published models that take a measured response as input lose about a quarter to a third of their score when the input comes from a replicate well instead of the predicted well (22-43% under the control-well reference), halves of a well overstate how well the experiment reproduces, and a test across the lines of a well calls 5 of 13 plates significant when two untreated wells are compared. Many labels of strongly responding replicate wells, those of plate 13 above all, fail the label check. Evaluations, ceilings and tests on such data should treat the well as the experimental unit.

llm.novelty_zh: 利用对照孔与复制孔检验 Tahoe-100M 中同一孔内的细胞系是否独立，并量化孔效应对基准与统计检验的影响。
llm.summary_zh: 研究发现同一孔中的多个癌细胞系共享一部分表达成分，而复制孔无法复现其中约三分之一的共有成分。两个已发表模型在以复制孔响应作为输入时评分下降约四分之一到三分之一，且在对照孔比较下 13 块板中有 5 块被误判为显著。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作指出大规模药物筛选基准的独立性假设不成立，提醒虚拟细胞与药物响应模型的评估应以孔为实验单位。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: CytoWave: Perturbation-Centric Pretraining for Single-Cell Response Prediction
abstract: Predicting gene expression under perturbations from single-cell data is a fundamental task for modeling cellular responses, with applications in discovering gene function and designing therapeutics. However, existing methods often struggle to generalize across datasets due to differences in experimental protocols, biological contexts, and species. We present \textbf{CytoWave}, a perturbation-centric pretraining framework for single-cell genetic perturbation response prediction. We leverage large-scale cross-species perturbation datasets unified via orthology and train CytoWave in a two-stage manner. In the first stage, we learn reference control cell states via masked gene expression recovery on unperturbed cells. In the second stage, we pretrain the model to predict perturbed gene expression given control states and perturbation signals, together with a contrastive objective that aligns latent representations of perturbation responses with perturbation signals. We perform strict dataset-held-out evaluation across multiple condition combinations and case studies of pathway activity changes, demonstrating consistent and effective performance of CytoWave in predicting single-cell genetic perturbation responses.
affiliations: The University of Texas at Arlington
The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center

llm.novelty_zh: 提出以扰动为中心的两阶段预训练，并用对比目标对齐扰动响应与扰动信号。
llm.summary_zh: CytoWave利用经直向同源统一的跨物种扰动数据进行两阶段预训练，先学习对照细胞状态，再预测扰动后的基因表达。模型加入对比目标对齐扰动响应与扰动信号，并在严格的留出数据集评估中表现稳定。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 它针对跨数据集泛化这一关键难题，对单细胞遗传扰动响应预测有实际意义。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: A low-rank decoder bottleneck bounds reliability in foundation-model perturbation prediction
abstract: Foundation-model predictors of perturbation response are evaluated primarily by aggregate accuracy. Using their predictions to prioritize experiments requires assessing each prediction's reliability. We audit the state-transition (ST) decoder used in STATE across three encoders (SE-600M, scGPT, and Tahoe-x1) and four cell lines under CRISPRi. The decoder's first attention layer has a low-rank output. Projecting this output onto 4-32 fixed directions estimated from training activations preserves mean per-perturbation Pearson delta correlation (PDC). This low-rank attention bottleneck bounds the decoder's reliability by distance to training responses: PDC declines as the cosine distance from a perturbation's observed response to its nearest training response increases. We propose predicted-NN-distance, the cosine distance from a predicted response to its nearest training response, as a per-prediction confidence score. The score has a mean absolute Spearman correlation of 0.81 with PDC, close to the 0.88 obtained with the observed response. Thresholds calibrated on this score transfer across encoders and cell lines, and the score remains predictive of PDC for drug perturbations.

llm.novelty_zh: 发现 STATE 解码器的低秩注意力瓶颈，并提出预测响应到最近训练响应的距离作为逐样本置信度。
llm.summary_zh: 作者在三种编码器（SE-600M、scGPT、Tahoe-x1）和四个细胞系的 CRISPRi 数据上审计了 STATE 的状态转换解码器，发现其首层注意力输出为低秩，投影到4至32个固定方向后平均 PDC 基本保持，说明可靠性受限于与训练响应的距离。提出的 predicted-NN-distance 与 PDC 的平均绝对 Spearman 相关系数为0.81，阈值可在编码器和细胞系之间迁移，对药物扰动也具预测力。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 给出了可在实验优先级排序前使用的逐样本可靠性评分，具有实际意义。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未说明药物扰动评估的具体规模，分析范围限于 STATE 解码器结构。

title: MUSS: A Multi-scale and Sequence-based Model for Single-cell Gene Regulation
abstract: Modeling gene regulation in single cells requires jointly representing DNA sequence, chromatin accessibility, and gene expression across regulatory scales. Sequence-based models capture DNA-level regulatory grammar but often lack cell-level resolution, whereas many single-cell omics models represent genes and peaks as fixed-vocabulary tokens without their underlying sequence. Here, we present MUSS, a sequence-based multi-scale model for single-cell gene regulation that preserves both DNA-level and cell-level resolution. MUSS derives peak- and gene-level representations from DNA using a frozen pre-trained sequence encoder and integrates them through peak-peak self-attention and distance-biased peak-gene interactions. Peak masked language modeling followed by training on paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq aligns these representations with cell-specific regulatory states. Across gene expression prediction, enhancer-gene linking, motif-guided regulatory prioritization, and zero-shot cell clustering, MUSS achieves strong performance against sequence-based and single-cell omics baselines. It further predicts expression for genes and peaks unseen during task training. These results support sequence-grounded, multi-scale representations for decoding cell-type-specific regulatory programs. Code, datasets, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Lotfollahi-lab/MUSS_neurips26.
affiliations: Cambridge Centre for AI in Medicine

llm.novelty_zh: 用冻结的DNA序列编码器派生峰与基因表示，并通过峰-峰自注意力和距离偏置的峰-基因交互，将序列与单细胞调控状态对齐。
llm.summary_zh: 作者提出MUSS，融合DNA序列、染色质可及性和基因表达进行单细胞基因调控建模。该模型在基因表达预测、增强子-基因连接、基序引导的调控优先级排序和零样本聚类等任务中，表现优于序列模型和单细胞组学基线，并能预测训练中未见的基因和峰的表达。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将DNA序列层面的调控语法与细胞层面的表达状态连接起来，为细胞类型特异的调控程序解析提供了统一表示。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及模型在不同物种或更多细胞类型上的泛化能力。

title: The Delta Gap: Cellular World Models for Perturbation Response Prediction Are Far Harder Than Global Correlation Implies
abstract: Cellular world models aim to predict how cells respond to genetic perturbations, analogous to world models in reinforcement learning. Perturbation response models are evaluated almost exclusively by global Pearson correlation between predicted and observed transcriptomes. We show this metric is dominated by thousands of non-responsive genes and severely inflates apparent performance. On the Replogle K562 screen (509 unseen perturbations, 5000 genes), GEARS achieves global Pearson 0.977, but its delta Pearson is only 0.076. A trivial baseline predicting mean training delta achieves 0.267, which is 3.5x better than GEARS. Our primary contribution is methodological: we identify and quantify this delta gap as a systematic evaluation artifact, and propose delta-space evaluation as the primary benchmark. We provide two post-hoc corrections (RWR on co-expression graphs and kNN matching) and show that 2.8x of the remaining gap lies in perturbation representation geometry, not decoder capacity. We further show the gap is partially addressable end-to-end: delta-aligned training (lambda = 3.0) raises delta Pearson to 0.179 on Replogle (2.35x over GEARS) and surpasses the trivial baseline on direction accuracy (0.680 vs 0.567) and gene recovery (1.52 vs 1.19); combined with kNN it reaches 0.217. An amplitude-calibration variant (eta = 0.3) further raises gene recovery to 2.16 while reaching 0.218. Critically, these representations transfer zero-shot across cell lines: from Replogle K562 to unseen Norman A549, the delta-aligned model reaches 0.328 on 741 shared genes, 4.7x a trivial baseline and 2.1x standard GEARS. This is the first systematic quantification of the delta gap, and the first diagnostic framework localizing the residual gap to perturbation representation geometry via an oracle upper bound.

llm.novelty_zh: 将扰动响应评估从全局相关转向delta空间，并以oracle上界定位残余差距来自扰动表征几何。
llm.summary_zh: 论文指出扰动响应模型常用的全局Pearson相关会被大量无响应基因主导，在Replogle K562数据上GEARS的全局Pearson为0.977，但其delta Pearson仅为0.076，而预测均值训练delta的平凡基线为0.267。作者提出delta空间评估，并采用RWR与kNN后处理及delta对齐训练，使delta Pearson提升到0.179，结合kNN达到0.217；这些表征还可零样本迁移到Norman A549。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 指出当前基准中的系统性评估偏差，并建议以delta空间作为主要指标，对社区评估标准有直接影响。
llm.limitations_zh: 即使经过改进，delta Pearson仍仅约0.2，摘要显示残余差距主要位于扰动表征几何中

title: Learning Biological Hierarchies in Single-Cell Foundation Models
abstract: Cell types are organized by taxonomic relationships that define lineages in the so-called cell ontology. However, most existing foundation models typically ignore cell-type lineages encoded in this cell ontology. We introduce a biologically informed foundation model called scOntoFM, which embeds hierarchical cell ontology into representation learning. Using Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) distances from the ontology graph, our framework pairs efficient offline triplet sampling with hierarchical cell-ontology learning. This approach jointly preserves local neighborhoods and shapes the global embedding geometry to reflect the ontology structure. Across diverse cell- and gene-level benchmarks, the model consistently improves performance, with especially strong gains in zero-shot settings. Our model also balances batch integration with biological structure preservation, providing complementary perspectives to existing embedding evaluation frameworks and supporting scalable biological discovery.

llm.novelty_zh: 将细胞本体的最近公共祖先距离融入三元组采样与层级学习，使scFM嵌入几何反映细胞类型谱系。
llm.summary_zh: scOntoFM 利用细胞本体图中的最近公共祖先距离，在表征学习中同时保持局部邻域结构，并塑造与本体一致的全局嵌入几何。摘要称其在多项细胞级和基因级基准上持续提升，零样本场景增益尤其明显，并兼顾批次整合与生物结构保持。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 把结构化生物本体引入scFM表征，为生物可解释的嵌入学习提供了可借鉴的思路。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: scBIG++: Learning Across Genes and Cells to Predict Single-Cell Perturbation Responses
abstract: Predicting single-cell transcriptional responses to genetic and chemical interventions supports gene-function discovery and regulatory analysis. Existing studies often focus only on highly variable genes, restricting the expression changes available for downstream analysis. Cells exposed to the same intervention can also show heterogeneous expression responses, with coordinated gene programs active to different degrees. We propose scBIG++, a full-gene perturbation prediction framework that models this heterogeneity by connecting expression-adaptive gene modules with population-conditioned generation. To preserve shared gene structure while accommodating cellular variation, Gene-Relation Clustering organizes genes into common windows, within which Dynamic SoftSub learns expression-dependent submodule memberships. This shared organization enables Set-GCAE to exchange information about corresponding gene groups across control cells, placing individual representations in their source-population context. The cell representations initialize a latent flow, while their pooled summary and the perturbation representation condition response generation. Generated states are decoded into expression profiles covering all assayed protein-coding genes retained after preprocessing, supporting comprehensive analysis of perturbation-induced expression changes. Experiments across six genetic and chemical settings spanning 6,539--19,451 genes demonstrate competitive perturbation-effect recovery and full-gene expression reconstruction under unseen targets and combinations, cross-cell-line transfer, and held-out compounds. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/ttruan2426-dot/scBIG.

llm.novelty_zh: 用表达自适应的基因模块和群体条件的潜在流，实现覆盖全部蛋白编码基因的扰动响应生成。
llm.summary_zh: scBIG++ 把扰动预测扩展到保留的全部蛋白编码基因，通过基因关系聚类与动态软子模块学习表达自适应的基因模块，并结合群体条件的潜在流生成扰动后表达。在六个遗传与化学扰动设置（6,539至19,451个基因）上展示了与基线相当的效应恢复能力，并能泛化到未见靶点、跨细胞系和留出化合物。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 解决了仅使用高变基因造成的信息丢失问题，有利于全基因组层面的扰动效应分析。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要描述结果为「竞争性」，未明确说明相对最强基线的提升幅度。

title: Bridging Graph and Pairwise Learning for Gene Regulatory Network Inference from scRNA-seq Data
abstract: MOTIVATION: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) capture the underlying interactions through which transcription factors (TFs) regulate genes. Based on gene expression data, existing GRN inference approaches generally fall into two categories: graph-based methods, which model the GRN as a whole graph, and pairwise-based methods, which decompose the GRN into individual TF-target gene pairs for modeling. However, each approach exhibits limitations that are precisely the strengths of its counterpart. Graph-based methods tend to overfit due to their reliance on a single training graph, whereas pairwise-based methods benefit from abundant TF-target training pairs. In contrast, pairwise-based methods overlook the global topological structure, which is essential for comprehensively capturing regulatory mechanisms. RESULTS: To address these limitations, we propose scGPL, an end-to-end unified framework that jointly models global regulatory topology and local interactions. scGPL extracts macro-level features from the global regulatory graph and introduces a dynamic, importance-guided subgraph sampling mechanism to capture fine-grained local dependencies. By fusing global representations with subgraph-enhanced local features, our framework bridges the gap between the two paradigms, incorporating essential whole-graph topological dependencies while retaining the data abundance advantage of pairwise methods. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that scGPL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with up to 13.7% improvement over the strongest baseline, validating the effectiveness of our integrative design. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: The source code is maintained on GitHub (https://github.com/talent-hang/scGPL), and the datasets and versioned releases are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21608485 for reproducibility.
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

llm.novelty_zh: 将全局调控图拓扑建模与重要性引导的子图采样融合，用于 scRNA-seq 的 GRN 推断。
llm.summary_zh: scGPL 是统一的端到端框架，同时从全局调控图中提取宏观特征，并通过重要性引导的动态子图采样捕获局部依赖。两类表征融合后，在七个基准数据集上取得了优于基线的表现，相比最强基线最多提升 13.7%。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 兼顾图方法与成对方法的优势，改进了单细胞 GRN 推断的整体性能。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: Predicting transcriptional interactions with GrnPFN
abstract: Combinatorial therapies offer opportunities to improve treatment efficacy and overcome therapeutic resistance, but their rational design requires understanding how combined interventions interact beyond their individual effects. Combined genetic and chemical perturbations can elicit nonadditive transcriptional responses, yet the vast number of possible combinations limits experimental characterization. Predicting these interactions is particularly challenging when few or no combinations have been measured. Here we present GrnPFN, a prior-data fitted network that predicts nonadditive transcriptional responses to combinations from single-perturbation profiles. Pretrained on simulated screens generated from random gene-regulatory networks, GrnPFN incorporates measured combinations through in-context learning without retraining. We evaluated GrnPFN in single-cell screens spanning CRISPR activation, RNA knockdown and drug combinations, using separate cells to construct model inputs, training targets and test targets. Without measured combinations in the target screen, GrnPFN outperformed gradient boosting trained on other screens. With limited combination measurements, it outperformed kernel ridge regression fitted to the same measured pairs. These advantages extended to an additional screen combining CRISPR interference with a drug. Our results demonstrate that pretraining on simulated regulatory networks enables prediction of nonadditive transcriptional interactions across perturbation modalities when experimental measurements are scarce.

llm.novelty_zh: 用在随机基因调控网络模拟筛选上预训练的先验数据拟合网络，通过上下文学习融入已测组合，无需对目标筛选重新训练。
llm.summary_zh: GrnPFN是先验数据拟合网络，在随机基因调控网络生成的模拟筛选上预训练，并以上下文学习方式融合已测组合，预测组合扰动引起的非加性转录响应。在CRISPR激活、RNA敲低和药物组合等单细胞筛选中，它在目标筛选无组合测量时优于在其他筛选上训练的梯度提升，在少量组合测量时优于拟合同样配对的核岭回归。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 在组合扰动测量稀缺时提供了可迁移的非加性交互预测方法，有助于筛选更有信息量的实验。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: Does Your World Model Know Actions Have Consequences?
abstract: Embodied world models (WMs) are implicit learning systems that predict the next future latent state directly from observations and actions. Unique from other end-to-end learning systems, the dynamics predictor of WMs can simulate the environment's response to alternative actions without physical deployment nor pre-specifying states of the dynamical system. Current metrics focus on the quality of model outputs, e.g., clarity of reconstructions or task success, but fail to assess the fidelity of modeling consequences of counterfactual actions. Inspecting the forced response to action perturbations through sensitivity analysis is one way to audit how well WMs can predict the consequences of counterfactual actions. Deploying WMs on hardware will require new evaluation frameworks to analyze the tradeoffs between state error and accurate sensitivity prediction.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出通过对动作扰动的敏感性分析来审计具身世界模型能否预测反事实动作后果的评估思路。
llm.summary_zh: 作者讨论具身世界模型的评价问题：现有指标关注输出质量与任务成功，却未评估模型对反事实动作后果的预测是否可靠。文章提出通过对动作扰动的强迫响应做敏感性分析来审计这一能力，并指出实际部署需要在状态误差与敏感性预测精度之间权衡的新评估框架。摘要未给出实验结果。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为世界模型在部署前的评估提供了可操作的审计角度。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未报告实证结果，具体方法与数据集也未给出。

title: AI for Biologists: The Knowledge Boundaries of Foundation Models in the Age of Agentic Systems
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how biological research is done. Biological foundation models trained on millions of nucleotides, protein, and single-cell measurements predict protein structures, mutation effects, and cellular responses to genetic perturbations. Agentic systems, AI assistants built on large language models, can run multistep analyses from plain-language requests and increasingly call foundation models as tools. Yet it is often unclear when these models' outputs can be trusted. We frame this as a model's knowledge boundary: the range of inputs, tasks, and conditions over which its outputs are reliable. This review explains how foundation models are built and proposes that five design elements (data, architecture, training scheme, evaluation scheme, and post-analysis) define this boundary. We examine evidence on where current models succeed or fail and present standardized descriptions of model limits so that researchers, and the agents acting for them, can use these tools reliably.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出以五个设计要素界定基础模型知识边界的综述性概念框架。
llm.summary_zh: 该综述介绍生物基础模型与智能体系统的构建方式，并提出数据、架构、训练方案、评估方案和后分析五个设计要素共同界定模型的知识边界。文章梳理了模型在哪些任务上成功或失败，并提出标准化的模型局限性描述。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 它关注何时可以信任基础模型的输出，对研究者及代其工作的智能体可靠使用这些工具有指导意义。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: S1Pert: Scalable Target-Specific Gene Response Prediction with System-One Intelligence
abstract: Predicting transcriptional responses to unseen genetic perturbations is essential for extending CRISPR screens across vast target--gene combinations. However, models can achieve strong aggregate predictive performance by reproducing historical gene-level response frequencies without adequately distinguishing the effects of different perturbations. Reliable prediction at the transcriptome scale is further challenged by uncertain response labels and redundant computation across millions of target--gene pairs. We present S1Pert, a System-One framework for target-specific gene response prediction with non-autoregressive online inference. S1Pert combines directional Welch tests and equivalence testing to distinguish statistically supported responses from inconclusive observations. A frozen System-One encoder extracts reusable semantic representations of perturbation targets, query genes, and historical evidence. Compact pair-specific interactions are then computed and cached offline. A lightweight hierarchical cross-attention decoder integrates these representations with cross-target pairwise ranking and synchronized historical-evidence dropout to reduce reliance on gene-level response frequencies. Extensive experiments demonstrate that S1Pert improves target-specific response discrimination while maintaining reliable prediction and efficient inference across diverse cellular contexts. These findings highlight the potential of System-One decision learning for scalable perturbation-response prediction beyond historical gene-level response tendencies. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/liujiawen-jpg/S1Pert.

llm.novelty_zh: 结合方向性Welch检验与等效性检验界定响应标签，并通过跨靶点排序与历史证据丢弃降低对基因响应频率的依赖。
llm.summary_zh: S1Pert用于预测靶点特异的基因转录响应，采用冻结的System-One编码器提取语义表征，并通过轻量级分层交叉注意力解码器进行非自回归推理。实验显示其改善了靶点特异性区分，同时保持高效推理，代码已公开。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 它针对基因层面响应频率的捷径问题提出改进，有助于更真实地评估扰动响应预测。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: More Genes, Faster Inference: Efficient Large-Panel Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) prediction from histology aims to infer spatially resolved gene expression profiles directly from tissue images. This is a challenging problem that is currently often addressed with complicated model architectures, additional inputs, and complicated training procedures, while remaining limited to fixed, small gene panels. This raises a natural question: Is there an efficient method for large-panel ST prediction? Here, we present GeneFlow, a simpler yet effective framework for large-scale spatial gene expression prediction that unifies flow-matching generative modeling with structured multimodal fusion. Specifically, GeneFlow first encodes both histological morphology and cross-gene interactions in spatial spots through histology and gene tokenizers. The model directly predicts spatial gene expression, rather than an intermediate velocity field, while being trained with a velocity-based flow-matching objective. We show that, even without relying on heavy generative pipelines, GeneFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple ST benchmarks, with up to 56.8% gains in 1,000-gene prediction. Extensive experiments further show that GeneFlow produces biologically meaningful spot profiles while reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude, thereby improving efficiency and scalability, particularly in clinical settings. We believe GeneFlow provides an opportunity for leveraging widely available histology images for downstream biological discovery. Code is available at: https://github.com/ZZhangsm/GeneFlow

llm.novelty_zh: 将 flow matching 目标与组织形态及基因 token 融合，直接预测大基因面板的空间表达。
llm.summary_zh: GeneFlow 用组织学图像与基因 tokenizer 分别编码形态和基因间相互作用，并以 velocity 型 flow matching 目标直接预测空间基因表达。在多个空间转录组基准上取得较好结果，1000 基因预测最高提升 56.8%。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 以较低计算成本从常见病理图像预测大基因面板的空间表达，便于利用已有图像资源。
llm.limitations_zh: 与虚拟细胞或扰动建模关联较弱，摘要未列出具体基准名称与各数据集上的绝对指标。

title: HoloGene: Learning to Lift Sliced Spatial Transcriptomics to Holistic 3D Gene Fields
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) provides spatially resolved gene expression measurements, but most 3D ST datasets are acquired as independently processed 2D sections. Computational approaches span slice registration and integration, explicit or generative interpolation, and coordinate-field modeling. Within the last family, implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a continuous, coordinate-queryable parameterization, but standard isotropic coordinate encodings do not explicitly reflect that serial-section measurements are dense in-plane and sparse along the axial direction. We present HoloGene, an anisotropic conditional INR framework for estimating continuous 3D gene-expression fields from pre-registered ST sections. Its central contribution is an acquisition-aware factorization that couples dense in-plane synthesis with sparse axial evolution using established GAE, FiLM, pseudo-label supervision, and CORAL components. HoloGene compresses high-dimensional expression profiles into a graph-autoencoder latent manifold, uses pseudo-label-derived signature conditioning to provide coarse intra-section context, and applies depth-dependent FiLM modulation to model axial variation. A signature-stratified correlation-alignment regularizer encourages cross-slice covariance alignment in latent features. Using held-out measured sections as cross-sectional references, HoloGene improves reconstruction accuracy and biological preservation metrics compared with general-purpose INRs and adapted spatial-transcriptomics baselines. These results support anisotropic conditional modeling as a practical strategy for estimating 3D expression fields from discontinuous ST sections. Code is available at https://github.com/Szym29/HoloGene.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出各向异性的条件隐式神经表示，将平面内稠密与轴向稀疏的采样特性显式建模，用于估计三维基因表达场。
llm.summary_zh: 作者提出HoloGene，将图自编码器潜空间、伪标签签名条件和深度相关的FiLM调制结合，从已配准的空间转录组切片估计连续三维基因表达场。在保留实测切片作为参考的评估中，该方法的重建精度和生物学保真指标优于通用INR和已有空间转录组基线。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作为非连续空间转录组切片的三维重建提供了一种面向采样结构的建模思路。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及方法在不同组织或不同切片间距下的稳健性。

title: OCCAM: Improved Single-Cell Representation Learning and Perturbation Effect Prediction
abstract: Predicting the effects of genetic perturbations requires models that generalize beyond observed cell contexts and gene combinations. We introduce Occam, a multilayer perceptron (MLP) framework for representation learning and perturbation-effect prediction. Occam combines cell representations learned through denoising with gene interaction, text, and protein-sequence features. It achieves the highest aggregate representation scores for perturbation information and cell-type preservation with batch integration. In cross-context few-shot prediction, a perturbation and a cell context are each observed during training, but never together. Occam better captures the measured response patterns for these unobserved combinations than four retrained competitors or direct transfer of the same perturbation's measured effects from other training cell lines. Without fine-tuning, Occam best distinguishes perturbations among the evaluated models and simple baselines in cell lines held out from predictor training, across seen and unseen assays. Predicting expression levels accurately in these settings remains challenging. For double perturbations, which target two genes simultaneously, Occam composes learned single-gene responses to better capture the combined response and reduce expression error compared with competing models and summed single-gene effects. These gains extend to both strongly additive and weakly additive responses. Together, these results support simple MLPs for cell representation learning and perturbation-effect prediction across contexts and gene combinations.

llm.novelty_zh: 以MLP融合去噪细胞表征与基因互作、文本和蛋白序列特征，属于已有组件的组合。
llm.summary_zh: Occam是一个MLP框架，将去噪学习得到的细胞表征与基因互作、文本和蛋白序列特征相结合，用于表征学习与扰动效应预测。摘要称其在跨情境少样本预测（扰动与细胞情境在训练中从未同时出现）、未见细胞系和双扰动任务中，优于四个重新训练的竞争模型及直接迁移基线，但表达水平的精确预测仍然困难。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 说明简单MLP配合合适特征在扰动预测中仍具竞争力，可为基准设计提供参照。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要明确指出精确预测表达水平仍然困难

title: ST-FateFlow: Continuous Gene-Spatial Reconstruction with Differentiation-Potential Learning from Time-Resolved Spatial Transcriptomics
abstract: Time-resolved spatial transcriptomics provides a powerful view of dynamic biological processes by measuring cellular states together with their spatial organization across time. However, destructive profiling and experimental cost restrict observations to a few discrete time points collected from independent samples, with no known cell pairing across time. This makes it difficult to reconstruct gene expression and tissue organization at unobserved stages and to characterize differentiation-associated dynamics. Here, we introduce ST-FateFlow, a flow-matching framework for continuous gene-spatial dynamics and differentiation-potential learning. ST-FateFlow jointly learns gene-expression and spatial-coordinate velocity fields, enabling interpolation of missing time points and continuous modeling of transcriptional evolution and tissue remodeling. In parallel, it independently learns a time-conditioned differentiation potential, whose values organize cell states along inferred differentiation progressions and support the analysis of differentiation-associated transcriptional changes. Across multiple time-resolved spatial transcriptomics datasets, ST-FateFlow effectively captures coordinated gene-expression and spatial dynamics. Case studies further show that the learned potential landscapes are consistent with known developmental and regenerative trajectories and help identify candidate genes associated with differentiation progression.

llm.novelty_zh: 将 flow matching 用于时间分辨空间转录组的基因表达与空间坐标联合速度场建模，并同时学习时间条件的分化势能，以对未观测时间点进行连续插值。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作针对时间分辨空间转录组数据只有离散时间点、且无法跨时间配对细胞的限制，提出 ST-FateFlow，用 flow matching 联合学习基因表达和空间坐标的速度场，实现缺失时间点的插值与组织重塑的连续建模。同时，模型独立学习时间条件的分化势能，用于沿推断的分化进程组织细胞状态，并在发育和再生案例中展示其与已知轨迹的一致性。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 它把动态虚拟细胞的思路（从离散观测推断连续状态演化）延伸到空间组织层面，对发育与再生研究有一定参考价值。该工作与扰动建模关系较弱，更偏向发育轨迹插值。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出具体数据集、基线方法及定量指标，无法判断相对已有方法的提升幅度，案例验证的范围也较有限。

title: MitoWorld: A Stochastic World Model of the Single-Cell Cycle under Genetic Perturbation
abstract: A cell observed after a gene knockdown has an uncertain future, both in how its appearance will evolve and when it will divide. Existing approaches predict endpoints or population-level changes without jointly modeling individual trajectories and division timing. In this work, we present MitoWorld, a stochastic world model that generates these future appearances as continuous evolution in a Gaussian reference latent, terminated by a division hazard and converted into images by a conditional diffusion renderer. The ordinary transition provably preserves its Gaussian reference, tying its noise to its dynamics; paired observations identify its discrete transition where stationary marginals cannot. The hazard turns division timing into a survival likelihood that can be tested against real cycle lengths. On 325 held-out MitoCheck tracks spanning 17 knockdowns and a control, MitoWorld lowers FID by 34.6\% and the video metric JEDi by 45.6\% relative to the strongest baselines. Its latent-space prediction intervals achieve near-nominal 90\% coverage, are 35\% narrower than those of a model with freely fitted noise. The hazard also yields cell-cycle length distributions with KS distance close to the model-based finite-sample reference. Testable single-cell stochastic dynamics thus offer a generative tool for time-lapse perturbation screens.

llm.novelty_zh: 将基因扰动下单细胞的外观演化与分裂时间统一建模：潜空间高斯参考过程加分裂风险函数（survival likelihood），再由条件扩散模型渲染为图像，是虚拟细胞随机世界模型的新思路。
llm.summary_zh: MitoWorld 提出一个随机世界模型，在高斯参考潜空间中连续演化细胞状态，并以分裂风险函数终止轨迹，再通过条件扩散渲染器生成未来图像。在 MitoCheck 的 325 条留出轨迹（17 种敲低及对照）上，相对最强基线 FID 降低 34.6%、视频指标 JEDi 降低 45.6%，潜空间预测区间覆盖率接近名义 90%，细胞周期长度分布与有限样本参考接近。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把单细胞动态的轨迹、分裂时间与扰动响应统一到可检验的随机模型中，为延时显微扰动筛选提供生成式工具。对虚拟细胞从终点预测转向过程建模有参考意义。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要仅在单一数据集 MitoCheck（图像、17 种敲低）上验证，未说明基线的具体细节，且与组学类虚拟细胞模型的可迁移性未知。

title: ReliFlow: Reliability-Calibrated Residual Transport for Combinatorial Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
abstract: Predicting the transcriptional response to combined perturbations requires distinguishing interactions between interventions from errors in their individual effect estimates. The latter become more pronounced when single-perturbation evidence is sparse or withheld. We introduce a conditional flow-matching model that estimates the reliability of single-gene effects from training-only cross-fitting and uses those estimates to calibrate the additive source distribution. The velocity is decomposed into a known correction of the additive reference and a learned residual transport field. On Norman genetic perturbations, reduces mean absolute error (MAE) from 0.142 to 0.131 for unseen combinations of observed singles and from 0.198 to 0.178 when constituent singles are withheld. On held-out ComboSciPlex drug combinations, MAE decreases from 0.191 to 0.176. Non-additive residual correlation improves from 0.574 to 0.638, and component ablations identify the contribution of reliability weighting. The results indicate that accounting for uncertain constituent effects improves generalization to unseen genetic and chemical combinations, with a moderate increase in training cost.

llm.novelty_zh: 用交叉拟合估计单基因效应的可靠性，并以此校准加性参考分布，再学习残差传输场。
llm.summary_zh: 提出ReliFlow，用条件流匹配预测组合扰动的转录响应，并以可靠性校准的加性源分布与残差传输场建模。作者在Norman遗传扰动和ComboSciPlex药物组合上报告MAE下降，并称在构成单扰动缺失时仍有改进。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 把单扰动效应估计的不确定性纳入组合扰动模型，有助于区分交互作用与估计误差。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要报告的MAE改进幅度较小，训练成本增加，且只在两个数据集上验证。

title: SCOPE: Single-Cell Omics Prediction from Histology via RNA-Protein Prior Enhancement
abstract: Predicting the RNA and protein content of cells from routine H&E images could extend spatial molecular profiling to existing slide archives. However, both H&E-spatial proteomics and H&E-spatial transcriptomics paired datasets are limited by the number of available markers and the insufficient availability of high-quality, cell-resolved data. We present SCOPE (Single-Cell Omics Prediction via RNA-protein prior Enhancement), a unified framework that leverages biologically complementary information between RNA and proteins to address the limited availability of single-omics supervision. Our key insight is that, although RNA and proteins represent distinct molecular modalities, their biological relationships provide valuable shared knowledge that can benefit single-omics prediction tasks. To this end, SCOPE introduces biologically informed biomarker priors to enhance shared gene-level representations, enabling knowledge transfer across RNA and protein modalities through gene-protein correspondence and molecular associations. By exploiting these complementary relationships, SCOPE enables both prediction tasks to benefit from a shared backbone enriched with cross-omics biological knowledge. Furthermore, its biomarker correlation design facilitates the prediction of unseen markers, extending spatially resolved molecular profiling beyond directly supervised targets. Across test datasets spanning 16 organs, SCOPE improves the average RNA Pearson correlation over the strongest baseline by 8.8%. On two external protein cohorts, it improves the average Pearson correlation over the strongest baseline by 9.7% for seen markers and 11.9% for unseen markers.
affiliations: Beijing University of Civil Engineering and Architecture

llm.novelty_zh: 借助 RNA 与蛋白之间的生物学先验共享骨干网络，从 H&E 图像同时预测单细胞 RNA 与蛋白表达并外推未见标志物。
llm.summary_zh: SCOPE 从常规 H&E 图像预测细胞的 RNA 与蛋白表达，通过基因-蛋白对应关系与分子关联引入生物学标志物先验，使两类预测任务共享富含跨组学知识的骨干网络。在覆盖 16 个器官的测试数据上，其 RNA Pearson 相关系数相对最强基线平均提高 8.8%；在两个外部蛋白队列上，已见与未见标志物分别提高 9.7% 与 11.9%。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 有望把空间分子谱分析扩展到已有的 H&E 切片档案中。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: Elysium: Simulation-Free Unbalanced Schrödinger Bridges
abstract: Reconstructing cellular dynamics from snapshots is challenging because the destructive nature of single-cell measurements makes tracking the same cells over time impossible. Cellular dynamics are inherently stochastic and involve changes in population size through proliferation and apoptosis. Growth-based methods represent population change as a rate on the density, which does not assign exits and entries to individual cells. Unbalanced Schrödinger bridges model individual events, but neural solvers for killed diffusion bridges simulate trajectories during training. We introduce Elysium, a simulation-free solver that jointly learns state transition and mass change. Using a killed Brownian reference and its time reversal, Elysium constructs direct regression objectives from an optimal endpoint coupling and conditional bridge distributions, without simulating trajectories during training. We show that the minimizers of the expected training objectives recover the optimal unbalanced Schrödinger bridge. Empirically, Elysium reconstructs state transitions, population size, and event distributions on simulated benchmarks with known killed-diffusion ground truth, outperforming existing deterministic and bridge-based solvers. On single-cell time courses, it interpolates cell state distributions at unobserved time points, tracks population expansion and contraction, and captures biphasic drug-response dynamics.

llm.novelty_zh: 将 killed Brownian 参考过程与其时间反演结合，构造无需训练期间模拟轨迹的直接回归目标，联合学习状态转移与质量（增殖/凋亡）变化，即无模拟的非平衡 Schrödinger bridge 求解器。
llm.summary_zh: 论文提出 Elysium，一种无需模拟的 unbalanced Schrödinger bridge 求解器，用于从单细胞快照重建细胞动力学，同时学习状态转移和细胞数量变化（增殖与凋亡）。作者证明训练目标的极小化元恢复最优 unbalanced Schrödinger bridge，并在带已知 killed diffusion 真值的模拟基准上优于确定性与 bridge 类方法。在单细胞时间序列上，该方法可插值未观测时间点的细胞状态分布、追踪群体扩张与收缩，并刻画双相药物响应动态。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作针对细胞群体动力学建模中个体事件（增殖、凋亡）缺失的问题，给出了可避免训练期轨迹模拟的方案，对基于快照的动态建模和药物响应时程分析有直接参考价值。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要中的实验主要基于模拟基准和有限的单细胞时间序列，未说明在大规模真实数据、高维基因表达空间及扰动预测任务上的泛化表现。

title: Horizontal Flow Matching for Single-Cell Spatiotemporal Dynamics
abstract: Learning the spatiotemporal dynamics of cells from spatial transcriptomics requires connecting snapshots of different cells acquired in different coordinate frames. A rotation or translation of a section can appear as cell movement and distort the inferred correspondence. We introduce horizontal flow matching, which learns changes in tissue organization, molecular state, and cell abundance up to shared rigid motion. The dynamics follow a continuity--reaction equation whose action assigns no cost to shared rigid motion, and the resulting horizontal projector removes this component from spatial prediction errors during learning and from predicted velocities during generation. An equivalent endpoint problem jointly estimates correspondence and relative pose in Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao geometry and yields analytic paths whose velocity and growth serve as regression targets. Regressing these targets recovers the horizontal dynamics under ideal population conditions. Our model, HORIZON, uses an equivariant transformer to predict velocity and growth from the current tissue, so that a tissue can be generated continuously from a single initial snapshot. On a simulated tissue observed in perturbed coordinate frames, alignment improves reconstruction and projection reduces rigid drift. On four spatial transcriptomics time courses, HORIZON reconstructs tissue geometry, gene expression, and cell abundance more accurately than existing spatial and unbalanced trajectory methods, and interpolates held-out developmental stages.

datasets_used: four spatial transcriptomics time courses (unnamed in abstract)
llm.novelty_zh: 将共享刚体运动视为不计代价的「水平」分量，用水平投影算子在流匹配的训练与生成中同时去除坐标系旋转/平移带来的伪运动，并在 WFR 几何下联合估计对应关系与位姿。
llm.summary_zh: 该文提出 horizontal flow matching，用于从空间转录组时间序列中学习组织结构、分子状态与细胞丰度随时间的变化，并在学习与生成中用水平投影器剔除共享刚体运动。模型 HORIZON 使用等变 Transformer 预测速度场与生长率，可从单张初始切片连续生成组织动态。摘要称其在模拟组织和四个空间转录组时间序列上，于几何、基因表达、细胞丰度重建及留出发育阶段插值方面优于现有方法。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 空间转录组时间序列中的坐标系不一致是长期存在的混杂问题，该文把它形式化为可投影去除的几何分量，为空间动态建模提供了有原则的处理方式。对于构建可生成组织动态的虚拟细胞模型，这一思路具有参考价值。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及具体基线名称、定量提升幅度、数据规模以及代码或权重发布情况，且未涉及扰动预测任务，向虚拟细胞扰动建模的外推证据有限。

title: GRADPlace: Geometry-Based Routing-Augmented Differentiable Placement for Routability Optimization
abstract: Routability-driven placement needs gradients that show how cell movement redistributes routing demand. Cell inflation exploits routing feedback only indirectly, and differentiable methods rely on black-box congestion predictors or on virtual-cell congestion fields frozen between routing updates. We present GRADPlace, which represents probability-weighted candidate routes as movable horizontal and vertical segments. Routing feedback sets their probabilities, while their geometry and expected demand evolve with cell coordinates. An electrostatic routing objective propagates gradients through this geometry to connected cells, complementing cell inflation. On the ISPD 2015 benchmarks, our reproduced Xplace-route and published DCGP results have on average 3.37x and 2.56x as many design-rule violations as GRADPlace, with more vias and comparable routed wirelength.

llm.novelty_zh: 将概率加权的候选布线建模为可移动线段，用于可布线性优化的可微布局。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作提出 GRADPlace，将候选布线表示为随单元坐标变化的线段，并通过静电布线目标把梯度传回相连单元。在 ISPD 2015 基准上，对比方法的设计规则违例数约为其 2.56 至 3.37 倍，且通孔更多。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 与虚拟细胞主题无关，仅在“virtual cell”这一术语上重合。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及在更多设计规模与工艺节点上的适用性。

title: GABIF: An Adaptive Guided Graph Denoising Framework for Antibody Conditional Inverse Folding
abstract: Antibodies play a central role in the human immune system, and their design is critical for vaccine development, therapeutic intervention, and improving human longevity. However, the vast combinatorial search space of antibodies poses a fundamental challenge for de novo discovery. Recent advances in deep learning, particularly denoising diffusion models, have demonstrated strong potential in protein inverse folding. Nevertheless, existing approaches are largely constrained to learning from natural antibody repertoires, thereby generating sequences that closely resemble natural antibodies. Such similarity, however, does not necessarily translate into improved functional performance in downstream applications. In this work, we develop a novel generative protein design model that enables the generation and optimization of antibody sequences tailored to specific downstream tasks and target metrics. Besides training on given an antibody dataset, we guide the generative model by an antibody-antigen binding affinity predictor for conditional discrete diffusion. The model is pre-trained on a given antibody dataset. Meanwhile, an antibody-antigen binding affinity predictor is incorporated as a conditional signal in a discrete diffusion framework, where a regressor serves as the conditional probability to guide the learning of the amino acid probability distribution of sequences under the objective of affinity optimization. In silico experiments demonstrate that our antibody design model achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art approaches, while the proposed regressor effectively improves binding affinity, as validated by an independent external predictor. Furthermore, our results highlight that the combination of finetuning and supervised guidance provides a powerful paradigm for adapting pretrained models to downstream tasks.

llm.novelty_zh: 将抗原-抗体亲和力回归器作为条件信号引入离散扩散模型，用于抗体序列的目标导向生成。
llm.summary_zh: GABIF在预训练的抗体离散扩散模型中引入结合亲和力预测器作为条件信号，使序列生成偏向亲和力优化。计算实验显示其生成性能与现有方法相当，且独立外部预测器验证显示亲和力得到提升。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为将预训练生成模型适配到下游设计目标提供了预训练加监督引导的可行范式。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要仅报告计算机模拟实验，未报告湿实验验证。

title: LeCellModel: Interpretable Density Estimation over the Gene Expression Manifold
abstract: Representation learning for single-cell RNA-seq has been evaluated by the identities representations capture -- cell types, lineages, perturbations -- rather than how faithfully they model the distribution of cell states on the gene expression manifold. As a result, density estimation, rare-state detection, perturbation scoring, and gene-level attribution are bolted onto frozen embeddings as separate models, disconnected from the geometry of the data. We argue that modeling the distribution of cell states should be the primary objective, and that representation quality follows from it. Building on LeJEPA, whose SIGReg objective enforces a provably optimal isotropic Gaussian latent, we introduce LeCellModel, which reads the encoder's Jacobian log-volume (JEPA-SCORE) under this Gaussian latent as a relative typicality score. Across several datasets, LeCellModel outperforms established methods on the scIB benchmark for representation quality. Furthermore, we show that LeCellModel enables detection of rare expression states using JEPA-SCORE as a typicality measure, applying it to a controlled cytokine panel, where it identifies stimulated cells across minority fractions and tracks pathway-response magnitude. We introduce gene-level interpretability of the typicality score -- to our knowledge, the first method for analyzing JEPA-SCORE in feature space. Leveraging this framework, LeCellModel recapitulates the known association of a profibrotic macrophage program with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, and discovers a CD177+ activated regulatory T cell subpopulation previously described only in tumor contexts. Both findings emerge directly from the geometry of the learned embedding, without relying on supervised annotations.

llm.novelty_zh: 将单细胞表征学习的主目标从身份识别转向对基因表达流形上细胞状态分布的密度估计，并基于LeJEPA的SIGReg各向同性高斯潜空间，用编码器Jacobian对数体积（JEPA-SCORE）作为典型性分数，同时首次提供该分数在基因特征空间的可解释性分析。
llm.summary_zh: 论文提出LeCellModel，以LeJEPA的SIGReg目标约束出的各向同性高斯潜空间为基础，把编码器的Jacobian对数体积定义为JEPA-SCORE，作为细胞状态的相对典型性分数。该分数在scIB表征质量基准上被报告优于已有方法，并可用于稀有表达状态检测（如细胞因子刺激实验）以及基因层面的归因解释。作者还称其在无监督条件下复现了促纤维化巨噬细胞程序与特发性肺纤维化的已知关联，并发现了一类CD177+活化调节性T细胞亚群。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把密度估计、稀有态检测和基因归因统一到同一个嵌入几何框架中，为虚拟细胞模型提供了不依赖监督标签的细胞状态分布建模思路。其在真实疾病和免疫数据上的发现也显示了方法的实际探索价值。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出scIB对比的具体基线、数据规模、消融实验及代码开放情况，且未涉及扰动响应预测等虚拟细胞核心任务的直接评估，结论的稳健性难以仅凭摘要判断。

title: How Far Can Linear Go? BiPert, a Unified Framework for Single-Cell Perturbation Modelling
abstract: Understanding how genetic perturbations affect cellular behaviour is essential for studying gene function and regulatory mechanisms. Large-scale CRISPR screens measure these effects across thousands of genes, but cover relatively few cellular contexts. Predicting perturbation responses in unseen cell types and identifying perturbed genes from their transcriptional effects therefore remain challenging. Here, we show that both tasks can be addressed through a common linear decomposition of transcriptional responses into shared and perturbation-specific components. Building on this principle, we introduce BiPert, a simple linear framework for both forward perturbation prediction and inverse identification. For forward prediction, BiPert outperforms existing methods that use no external biological knowledge when predicting gene expression changes in unseen cell lines. Its few-shot extension, BiPert-FS, adapts to new cell lines using as few as ten measured perturbations. For inverse identification, BiPert-ID identifies perturbed genes from single-cell expression profiles, outperforming deep-learning methods in unseen cell lines and donors. We further show that perturbations whose effects transfer more consistently across cellular contexts are also easier to identify, even after controlling for perturbation effect size. Together, these results establish a connection between perturbation transfer and identification, and demonstrate that simple linear models provide strong, interpretable baselines for both tasks.

llm.novelty_zh: 将转录组响应线性分解为共享成分与扰动特异成分，并用同一线性框架统一处理正向扰动预测（BiPert/BiPert-FS）与逆向扰动基因识别（BiPert-ID），同时建立扰动迁移性与可识别性之间的联系。
llm.summary_zh: 论文提出 BiPert，将基因扰动的转录响应线性分解为共享与扰动特异两部分，用于预测未见细胞系中的表达变化（并提出仅需约十个扰动即可适配新细胞系的 BiPert-FS），以及从单细胞表达谱反推被扰动基因的 BiPert-ID。作者报告其在未见细胞系与供体上优于不使用外部生物学知识的方法和深度学习方法，并指出跨细胞背景迁移更一致的扰动也更易识别。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把正向扰动预测与逆向扰动识别统一在一个可解释的线性框架下，并为简单线性模型在虚拟细胞任务中提供了强基线参考，对评估复杂深度模型的必要性有直接启示。扰动迁移性与可识别性的联系也为实验设计与跨情境泛化提供了新视角。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提供具体数据集规模、基线细节与统计检验，且线性模型的表达能力在复杂非线性调控场景中的局限未被讨论。

title: Beyond Hard Tokens: Predictive Memory for Multimodal Protein Generation
abstract: Multimodal protein language models unify sequence and discrete structural tokens via iterative masked decoding, offering a promising paradigm for joint protein design. However, standard decoders rely on a memoryless mask reset at each iteration: only a sparse subset of newly committed hard tokens is carried forward, while all remaining unresolved sites are reset to an identical [MASK] embedding. In open-ended co-generation where neither modality provides a fixed external anchor, this stateless transition limits single-step refinement depth and deprives both tracks of stable cross-step soft anchors, leading to slow convergence or degenerative repetitive collapse. Observing that uncommitted predictions evolve with pronounced temporal coherence rather than erratic noise, we introduce Predictive Memory (PredMem), a training-free self-conditioning recurrence that carries these soft beliefs across steps. At each step, PredMem summarizes raw logits into a probability-weighted Top-$k$ expectation embedding at every residue and affinely interpolates it into eligible masked inputs on the next step at zero extra denoiser cost. Across DPLM-2, DPLM-2.1, and ESM3, PredMem raises unconditional sequence-structure co-generation success by 3.6, 17.7, and 48.7 percentage points, respectively, while improving the quality-diversity trade-off and suppressing repetitive mode collapse. Controlled diagnostics show that these gains stem primarily from early trajectory stabilization in unanchored cross-modal co-evolution rather than extra compute or simple entropy reduction, establishing PredMem as an efficient inference mechanism for multimodal discrete generation.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出免训练的 Predictive Memory（PredMem），在迭代掩码解码中把未确定位置的 Top-k 概率加权期望嵌入作为软信念跨步传递，替代每步重置为 [MASK] 的无记忆方式，用于多模态蛋白序列-结构共生成。
llm.summary_zh: 本文针对多模态蛋白语言模型（DPLM-2、DPLM-2.1、ESM3）迭代掩码解码中每步重置未确定位置为 [MASK] 的问题，提出免训练的自条件递归机制 PredMem，将原始 logits 汇总为 Top-k 概率加权期望嵌入并在下一步插值到待掩码输入中。实验显示其在无条件序列-结构共生成成功率上分别提升 3.6、17.7、48.7 个百分点，并缓解重复性模式崩溃。该工作属于蛋白设计方向，与虚拟细胞核心圈关联较弱。

title: Optimal Transport Meets t-SNE: Integrated Visualization without Batch Effects in OT-tSNE
abstract: Visual exploration is an integral step in understanding the structure of datasets. However, systematic variation between datasets collected under different conditions, known as batch effects, can obscure shared structure and complicate their joint visualization. Existing methods often rely on cross-batch nearest-neighbor relations to integrate the batches. Yet, these local correspondences can be unreliable for challenging cross-batch geometries. We propose optimal-transport t-SNE (OT-tSNE), which replaces nearest-neighbor-based matching with globally coupled affinities derived from entropic optimal transport. Controlled synthetic experiments demonstrated that nearest-neighbor-based methods can deteriorate, while optimal-transport affinities and OT-tSNE embeddings remain robust. Across seven real single-cell datasets, we benchmarked OT-tSNE against a broad range of integration and visualization methods and found that it achieves a Pareto-efficient trade-off between batch mixing and biological conservation, and integrates batches particularly well.

llm.novelty_zh: 用熵正则最优传输得到的全局耦合亲和度替代 t-SNE 中基于最近邻的跨批次匹配，使批次整合式可视化在复杂跨批次几何下更稳健。
llm.summary_zh: 该文提出 OT-tSNE，用熵最优传输的全局耦合亲和度取代基于最近邻的跨批次匹配，以缓解批次效应对联合可视化的干扰。合成实验显示最近邻方法在困难几何下会退化，而 OT 亲和度更稳健；在七个真实单细胞数据集上，该方法在批次混合与生物学保守之间取得帕累托较优的权衡。该工作属于单细胞数据可视化与批次整合，与虚拟细胞建模只有间接关系。

title: Bayesian Learning of Spatially Heterogeneous Causal Structure in Spatial Transcriptomics
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics preserves the location of each expression profile, making it possible to study how gene regulatory networks differ within a tissue. Across regions of a tissue, regulatory relationships may vary and even reverse direction, so identifying the causal relationships in a specific pathological region can provide insight into therapeutic targets. We propose SpaDAG, a Bayesian method for learning spatially varying causal directed acyclic graphs. By defining the graphs on a triangulation of the tissue, SpaDAG allows each edge to have its own spatial pattern and even to reverse direction across regions. We show that the graphs nonetheless remain fully identifiable, and develop an MCMC sampler that explores them efficiently by reversing an edge over an entire connected region in a single move. SpaDAG outperforms competing methods in simulations with and without direction reversals. In a section spanning a renal cell carcinoma and the adjacent kidney, SpaDAG finds largely different relationships in the two tissues, with those in the tumor concentrated on genes associated with therapeutic targets. Between two of these genes, it identifies a relationship whose direction reverses across the tumor boundary, generating hypotheses about their region-specific coupling. Supplementary materials and code for this article are available online.

datasets_used: renal cell carcinoma and adjacent kidney spatial transcriptomics section (dataset name not given in abstract)
llm.novelty_zh: 在三角剖分上定义空间变化的因果 DAG，允许每条边在不同区域呈现自己的空间模式并整体反转方向，同时证明图仍可识别，并设计了按连通区域整体翻转边的 MCMC 采样器。
llm.summary_zh: SpaDAG 是一种贝叶斯方法，用于学习空间变化的因果有向无环图，使基因调控关系能随组织位置变化甚至反转方向。作者证明了这些图仍可完全识别，并通过区域级边翻转的 MCMC 采样器高效探索模型空间。在模拟和肾细胞癌空间转录组切片中，该方法优于竞争方法，并提示肿瘤与正常组织的调控关系差异及一对靶点基因跨肿瘤边界的方向反转。

title: Resolving cell states in spatial transcriptomics with SCATTER
abstract: A capture spot can contain transcripts from multiple cell types. Differences between spots may reflect changes in cell-type proportions, expression within a cell type, or both, making local cell-type expression difficult to infer from mixed counts. We developed SCATTER to estimate cell-type proportions and relative expression profiles for each cell type at each spot from spatial transcriptomic counts, coordinates, and annotated single-cell reference data. SCATTER weights reference cell profiles using local spatial context, then jointly fits the resulting profiles and cell-type proportions to reconstruct spot counts. Cell2location estimates regularize the proportions. After fitting, SCATTER uses learned gene-specific calibration factors and fitted proportions to allocate observed counts among cell types. In five pseudo-spot benchmarks constructed from imaging data, SCATTER achieved higher cross-spot correlations with measured expression for 82.8-99.8% of evaluated gene-cell type pairs in pairwise comparisons with DestVI, PANDA, and STged. In breast cancer Xenium data, it recovered gene expression associated with the tumor neighborhood and regulon scores. In breast cancer Visium data, inferred stromal and macrophage expression showed distinct associations with neighborhood malignant cell proportions. In multiple sclerosis brain tissue, SCATTER recovered lesion-associated glial expression programs. In colorectal cancer Visium HD data, it mapped cell-type-specific programs at the invasive front and ranked candidate ligand-receptor pairs. SCATTER enables analysis of spatial expression variation within cell types from mixed tissue measurements.

datasets_used: multiple sclerosis brain tissue spatial transcriptomics
pseudo-spot benchmarks constructed from imaging data
llm.novelty_zh: 将空间邻域信息用于加权单细胞参考谱，并结合 Cell2location 正则化的比例估计，实现每个 spot 内各细胞类型的细胞类型特异性相对表达估计。
llm.summary_zh: SCATTER 面向空间转录组中混合 spot 的解卷积问题，同时估计每个 spot 的细胞类型比例和各细胞类型的相对表达谱，并用校准因子分配观测 counts。在基于成像数据构建的伪 spot 基准及多个癌症、多发性硬化等组织数据上，相较 DestVI、PANDA 和 STged 取得更高的一致性相关。该工作属于空间转录组分析方法，与虚拟细胞、扰动建模或细胞基础模型的主线关联较弱。

title: A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
abstract: Pathology foundation models are usually compared by their performance on downstream tasks such as classification and retrieval. While such benchmarks measure how useful a model is, they provide no insight into the biology it represents. We introduce BioScore, a benchmark that quantifies how well an image encoder captures cell identities, with spatial transcriptomics of the same tissue as the reference. A sparse autoencoder splits the encoder's patch embeddings into sparse features, which we cluster into a fixed number of groups. BioScore then measures, for each of 52 cell identities defined by marker genes, how specifically one group follows the identity's expression over the tissue. Because the autoencoder training is fully unsupervised, a match shows that the model represents the cell identity from the image alone. We score 8 pathology foundation models and 3 natural-image models. Every pathology model scores above every natural-image model (0.299--0.371 \vs 0.214--0.232), and paired tests separate three tiers among the pathology models. Unlike a supervised probe, BioScore needs no labels, builds its reference from the data and scores even from few sections, yet it ranks the encoders as a probe does. Its per-identity breakdown indicates which cell identities each encoder captures or misses.

llm.novelty_zh: 用空间转录组的细胞身份标记基因作为参考，以无监督稀疏自编码器特征聚类来评估病理基础模型是否捕获细胞身份，无需标签即可给出按细胞类型拆分的生物学评分。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作提出 BioScore 基准，用同一组织的空间转录组作为参考，衡量病理图像编码器对 52 种由标记基因定义的细胞身份的捕获程度。方法通过稀疏自编码器将 patch 嵌入拆分为稀疏特征并聚类，再按每种细胞身份评估特征组与表达模式的对应性；在 8 个病理基础模型和 3 个自然图像模型上，病理模型整体优于自然图像模型，且能区分出三个性能梯队。该工作属于病理基础模型评测，与虚拟细胞主题为外围关联。

title: scRM: A single-cell foundation model trained on scRNA-seq reads
abstract: Single-cell foundation models currently learn from gene count matrices, which are discretized, species-specific summaries that discard the RNA sequence, splice-site usage, 3 ′ UTR isoform identity and the mutational information present in the underlying sequencing reads. Here we introduce single-cell raw data pretraining, a framework that trains foundation models directly on sequencing reads, requiring no read alignment or count matrix, allowing any trained model to be applicable to arbitrary species. Our first model in this framework, the single-cell read model scRM, pairs two transformer encoders with a hierarchy of attention pools and contains 1.2 million parameters. We trained it as a JEPA on 3,000 mouse neuron cells on a single H100 in one hour, and benchmarked it zero-shot against leading single-cell foundation models with orders of magnitude more parameters and training cells. Our results show that our lightweight model reaches the performance of existing models on all tasks, and exceeds every one of them on perturbation detection tasks whose detection requires sequence-level detail. To our knowledge, scRM is the first single-cell foundation model trained on sequencing reads, demonstrating that raw data pretraining is not only feasible but competitive at a fraction of the computational cost. We anticipate that scaling this framework and exploring alternative architectures will unlock biological information inaccessible to count models and extend the dataset-specific pretraining it already makes possible. The source code is available at https://github.com/altoslabs/scRM.

llm.novelty_zh: 首次直接在测序原始reads上做单细胞基础模型预训练，无需比对和计数矩阵，并以JEPA目标训练。
llm.summary_zh: 提出单细胞原始数据预训练框架与其首个模型scRM，参数量为120万，在3000个小鼠神经元细胞上以JEPA训练。作者称其零样本性能与规模大得多的现有模型相当，并在依赖序列细节的扰动检测任务上超越所有对比模型。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 提出了不依赖计数矩阵、可跨物种应用的基础模型训练路线，且计算成本很低。
llm.limitations_zh: 训练数据仅为3000个小鼠神经元细胞，规模化与其他架构的效果尚待验证。

title: Cross-modal transfer enables zero-shot prediction of drug responses across cell types
abstract: Genetic perturbation responses capture the functional consequences of gene-level interventions, providing functional information for drug-response prediction beyond baseline gene expression. Within the same cellular context, genetic and chemical perturbations engage shared regulatory networks, providing a biological basis for transferring response information between perturbation modalities. Here we introduce GRAFT, a framework that combines genetic-to-chemical transfer with cross-context prediction to infer drug-induced transcriptional responses without drug measurements in the target context. Across benchmarked LINCS and external contexts, GRAFT improved response correlation, directional agreement and magnitude reconstruction over competing methods, particularly for drugs with context-dependent responses. GRAFT-Adapt further refines predictions of unmeasured responses using a small number of drug measurements from the target context. GRAFT-Atlas spans 13 cellular contexts and 7,856 drug catalog entries, comprising 102,128 predictions for drug–context combinations. The atlas captured recognizable pharmacological neighborhoods, shared functional programs, context-dependent transcriptional changes and structural–functional associations supported by molecular docking. Across ten iPSC lines from distinct donors, GRAFT identified candidate inter-donor differences, with functional support for selected candidates from measured genetic perturbation responses. Together, GRAFT enables perturbation-informed prediction and comparison of drug responses across cellular contexts.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出从遗传扰动到化学扰动的跨模态迁移框架，并构建覆盖13个细胞背景的药物响应预测图谱。
llm.summary_zh: GRAFT将遗传扰动响应迁移到化学扰动，在无药物测量的目标细胞背景中预测药物诱导的转录响应。在LINCS及外部背景的基准上，其相关性、方向一致性和幅度重建均优于竞争方法，GRAFT-Adapt还能用少量药物测量进一步校正预测。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 它为跨细胞背景的药物响应预测和供体间差异比较提供了可操作的框架。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: A single-cell multimodal foundation model enables cross modality analysis between transcriptome and chromatin
abstract: Most single-cell studies measure either gene expression or chromatin accessibility, and connecting the two usually requires fitting a model to each study. Here we present MUTUAL (MUltiome Transfer in a Unified Aligned Latent space), which keeps the single-cell foundation models scFoundation and EpiAgent frozen, combines their embeddings with linear summaries of each modality and learns a shared RNA– ATAC space from 3.0 million paired cells of 400 public multiome datasets. Applied without refitting to ten datasets not used for training, MUTUAL matched cells’ RNA and ATAC profiles more accurately than methods fitted on other donors of the same dataset, annotated ATAC-only cells more accurately and transferred transcription-factor motif activity to RNA-only cells beyond what cell-type assignment provides. In a maturation series of stem-cell-derived islets, motif activity predicted from RNA largely reproduced the measured stage-wise changes when other libraries of the series served as the reference. MUTUAL makes public multiome data directly usable by single-modality studies.

llm.novelty_zh: 在冻结的 scFoundation 与 EpiAgent 嵌入之上学习共享的 RNA–ATAC 潜空间，无需对新数据重新拟合即可迁移。
llm.summary_zh: MUTUAL 保持两个单细胞基础模型冻结，结合各模态的线性汇总，在 400 个公开多组学数据集的 300 万个配对细胞上学习共享潜空间。应用于十个未参与训练的数据集时，其 RNA–ATAC 配对匹配精度高于在同数据集其他供体上拟合的方法，ATAC 细胞注释也更准确。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作使公共多组学数据可直接用于单模态研究，降低了跨模态分析的建模成本。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及在更多物种或其他模态组合上的泛化表现。

title: LOTUS: lineage-aware optimal transport reconstructs continuous clonal fate dynamics
abstract: Destructive sampling in single-cell sequencing obscures ancestor–descendant relationships, limiting the continuous reconstruction of cell-fate dynamics. Here we present Lineage-aware optimal transport for unbalanced single-cell dynamics (LOTUS), a framework that integrates time-resolved transcriptomic snapshots with clonal lineage information from engineered barcodes or endogenous T cell receptor clonotypes. LOTUS couples clone-level optimal transport with neural unbalanced transport to model continuous cellular state change, population growth and clonal propagation under lineage-consistent constraints. In branching simulations, LOTUS reduced lineage-inconsistent transport relative to benchmark methods, lowering off-target routing from 4.94–14.84% to 1.10%. On LARRY lineage-barcode scRNA-seq of hematopoiesis, LOTUS reconstructed branching trajectories, improved early neutrophil–monocyte fate-boundary prediction, and inferred multi-fate progenitors and fate-biased meta-clones, linking their distinct fate potentials to inferred epigenetic priming. On CellTagging scRNA-seq of fibroblast reprogramming, it distinguished reprogrammed from failed trajectories and prioritized fate-associated perturbation genes. In longitudinal scRNA-seq and TCR-seq of malaria-responsive memory (CD45RA-) CD4+ T cells, it preserved endogenous clonotype structure and reconstructed TR1 dynamics and regulatory networks. LOTUS thus converts lineage-resolved single-cell snapshots into interpretable, continuous models of fate dynamics and their regulatory programs.

llm.novelty_zh: 将克隆谱系约束与神经非平衡最优传输结合，重建连续的克隆命运动力学。
llm.summary_zh: LOTUS整合时间分辨转录组快照与条形码或TCR克隆谱系信息，通过克隆级最优传输和神经非平衡传输建模连续状态变化。模拟中它降低了谱系不一致的错误传输，并在真实数据中重建了分支轨迹与命运偏向的祖细胞。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 它把谱系信息引入动力学建模，有助于理解细胞命运决定及其调控程序。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: Single-cell perturbation prediction near experimental reproducibility with GENESIS
abstract: Single-cell perturbation atlases now measure cellular responses across millions of cells, but the number of possible combinations of biological contexts, perturbations, doses and other experimental variables make exhaustive measurements infeasible. Here, we present GENESIS (Generative ENErgy-based Single-cell Intervention Simulator), a generative framework that predicts single-cell response distributions directly from the covariates defining an experimental condition. GENESIS uses a lightweight neural network trained with the energy score, a strictly proper scoring rule for distributions. We introduce an experiment-calibrated evaluation framework in which prediction error is interpreted relative to the reproducibility of repeated measurements of the same condition. Across the Tahoe-100M small-molecule atlas and a large PBMC cytokine atlas, GENESIS significantly outperforms existing generative models and statistical baselines and approaches experimental reproducibility on independently repeated conditions. Importantly, GENESIS remains accurate when trained on only a fraction of the available experimental conditions or cells, and generated profiles recover experimentally observed context-dependent transcriptional programs. At comparable training-cell budgets, GENESIS achieves more accurate predictions when measurements span more experimental conditions rather than profiling fewer conditions more deeply. Together, these findings suggest a complementary strategy for perturbation studies: broader, lower-depth measurements can expand experimental coverage, while GENESIS augments sparsely sampled populations and predicts responses in unmeasured conditions.

llm.novelty_zh: 用能量得分直接学习单细胞响应分布，并提出基于重复测量可复现性的实验校准评估框架。
llm.summary_zh: GENESIS 是一个基于能量得分（严格正常评分规则）训练的轻量神经网络，直接从实验条件的协变量预测单细胞响应分布。在 Tahoe-100M 小分子图谱和大型 PBMC 细胞因子图谱上，它明显优于现有生成模型与统计基线，并接近独立重复条件的实验可复现性；仅用部分条件或细胞训练时仍保持准确，且提示更广的条件覆盖优于更深的单条件测量。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为扰动图谱的实验设计提供了可量化的策略：广覆盖、低深度测量加模型补全。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未具体说明模型对全新化合物等分布外条件的泛化上限。

title: ExPert infers causal perturbations from cell states across biological and clinical contexts
abstract: Pooled single-cell CRISPR screens have driven substantial effort toward models predicting the response to a perturbation. We posed the inverse question: which perturbation produced an observed cell state? Here we developed ExPert (Extracting Perturbations), which learns one prototype per perturbation in a latent space shared by 12 cellular contexts, trained on 8,964 perturbations and 19.5 million cells, and ranks 19,895 candidate genes per query, over half absent from training. ExPert more than doubled held-out-context recall over the best existing method with 1,000-fold less compute, and transferred without retraining to drugs, protein degradation and combinations. In alcohol-associated liver disease it implicated mRNA export, unchanged in expression, and we experimentally confirmed nuclear poly(A) retention and isoform switching. In primary mitochondrial disease it recovered the affected complex from blood, localized the signal to monocytes, and flagged a misdiagnosed control. Perturbation atlases can thus be queried in reverse, from state to likely driver.
affiliations: Robert H. Lurie Comprehensive Cancer Center of Northwestern University
Carl R. Woese Institute for Genomic Biology

llm.novelty_zh: 把扰动预测反过来，从观察到的细胞状态推断最可能的扰动驱动因子，并在共享潜空间中为每个扰动学习原型。
llm.summary_zh: ExPert在12个细胞背景共享的潜空间中为每个扰动学习一个原型，用于由观察到的细胞状态反推扰动。它在留出背景上的召回率比最佳现有方法提高一倍以上，计算量少约千倍，并能无需重训迁移到药物、蛋白降解和组合扰动。作者还实验证实了酒精相关肝病中核内poly(A)滞留与异构体切换的机制线索。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 它把扰动图谱用于逆向查询，有助于从疾病细胞状态中定位潜在驱动因素和诊断线索。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: Spectral Adaptive Repositioning for Flow-Based Single-Cell Perturbation Modeling
abstract: Predicting transcriptome-wide cellular responses to genetic and biomolecular perturbations is central to functional genomics and therapeutic target discovery. Existing methods assign gene positional encodings derived from arbitrary orderings or static co-expression masks built from unperturbed cells, and cannot capture the functional rewiring induced by perturbations. We present SPEAR, a generative framework built on two complementary positional mechanisms. Spectral positional encoding grounds each gene’s position in the geometry of the co-expression network via continuous coordinates derived from the graph Laplacian. Adaptive repositioning then derives each gene’s position from its perturbation-conditioned hidden state at every layer, allowing the attention genes exert on one another to reorganize without explicit supervision. Evaluated on genetic, pharmacological, and cytokine perturbation benchmarks, SPEAR demonstrates excellent recovery of differential gene-expression, distributional structure, and perturbation-specific identifiability. SPEAR also captures latent positional relationships that closely map to known transcription factor-target interactions. https://github.com/shouryaverma/SPEAR
affiliations: Purdue University Institute for Cancer Research

llm.novelty_zh: 结合基于共表达图拉普拉斯的谱位置编码与随扰动隐状态逐层更新的自适应重定位。
llm.summary_zh: 提出SPEAR，一种基于流的生成框架，用谱位置编码与扰动条件下的自适应重定位表示基因在注意力中的位置。作者称在遗传、药理与细胞因子扰动基准上可恢复差异表达与分布结构，且潜在位置关系与已知转录因子-靶基因相互作用相对应。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 用动态位置表示扰动引起的功能重连，并与转录因子调控结构相互印证。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出与基线的定量比较，位置关系与TF-靶基因一致性的统计检验未提及。

title: Resolving how genetic perturbations act through gene regulatory paths
