abstract: Perturb-seq measures transcriptional responses to thousands of genetic perturbations, but each gene's response mixes the contributions of many regulatory paths, so how a perturbation acts cannot be resolved from expression alone, however large the model. Here we present REGA-perturb, which supplies this missing information rather than adding model complexity: reference epigenomes define a scaffold of possible transcription factor (TF)-regulatory element-gene paths, and perturbation responses, pooled through shared latent programs, determine how each path is used, requiring only RNA measurements. Across three CRISPR interference screens totaling 2.4 million cells, REGA-perturb inferred TF-target relationships that agreed with ChIP-seq binding with a gain over random more than four times that of the best existing method, separated candidate direct from indirect targets, and predicted targets of TFs withheld from training. It also inferred perturbation-induced changes in TF activity not reflected in TF transcript levels, and resolved perturbation-specific regulatory rewiring in which opposing regulatory changes cancel at the expression level.

llm.novelty_zh: 用参考表观基因组构建 TF-调控元件-基因路径骨架，仅依赖 RNA 数据推断扰动如何使用这些路径。
llm.summary_zh: REGA-perturb 将参考表观基因组给出的转录因子-调控元件-基因路径与扰动响应经潜在程序池化后相结合，推断各路径的使用方式。在三个总计 240 万细胞的 CRISPRi 筛选中，其推断的 TF-靶标关系与 ChIP-seq 结合一致，并能区分直接与间接靶标。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 指出扰动响应中的表达变化混合了多条调控路径，并提供了解析这些路径的思路，有助于机理理解。
llm.limitations_zh: 方法依赖参考表观基因组来构建路径骨架，摘要未说明在缺乏相应表观数据的细胞类型或物种中的适用性。

title: Perturbation-induced gene programs map the hidden regulatory architecture of complex diseases
abstract: Steady-state molecular profiles incompletely capture the regulatory programs through which genetic variation influences complex disease, particularly programs that emerge only when cells are perturbed. Here, we introduce Perturbscape, a computational framework that learns multiscale gene programs for individual perturbations in a CRISPR Perturb-seq screen using linear and nonlinear contrastive approaches alongside complementary program-learning methods, and integrates them with human genetics to prioritize disease-relevant genes, perturbations and downstream regulatory pathways. Across 15,859 perturbation-by-context profiles from 7 Perturb-seq systems and 53 complex diseases and traits (mean GWAS N=291K), perturbation-induced programs showed up to 4.3-fold higher heritability informativeness than analogous steady-state multi-tissue gene prioritization, and retained significant conditional heritability informativeness across all 34 matched cell system–trait comparisons after accounting for steady-state prioritization. Preserving perturbation-specific programs further yielded 2.5–5.3-fold higher trait relevance scores than programs derived from control cells, pooled perturbations or differential-expression summaries. In K562, Perturbscape-prioritized genes showed stronger enrichment for rare-variant burden genes than steady-state prioritization and were supported by orthogonal enhancer CRISPRi screens. In HepG2, LDL cholesterol-associated perturbation– induced programs specifically revealed statin-responsive pathways not significantly enriched by steady-state PoPS prioritization, supported by pharmacological transcriptional responses and population plasma proteomics. Perturbscape also recovered blood-related trait-conditioned trans-regulatory relationships that were specifically supported by population trans-eQTLs in IFN-γ-stimulated monocytes (OR = 1.30, P=1.6e-05). Perturbscape further revealed developmental-stage-specific convergence between monogenic diabetes regulators and polygenic T2D risk during pancreatic islet differentiation, and neuronal-subclass-specific autism-associated regulatory programs in vivo . Together, these findings establish perturbation-induced gene programs as a complementary layer of disease-relevant regulatory information, revealing genetically informative pathways and context-specific regulatory relationships incompletely represented by steady-state molecular atlases.
affiliations: Louis V. Gerstner, Jr. Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences

llm.novelty_zh: 用对比学习从CRISPR Perturb-seq中学习扰动诱导的基因程序，并与人群遗传学结合用于疾病相关基因排序。
llm.summary_zh: Perturbscape从15,859个扰动-情境图谱中学习扰动诱导的多尺度基因程序，并与53种复杂性状的GWAS结合。与稳态基线相比，其遗传信息性最高提升4.3倍，并在K562、HepG2等系统中揭示了稳态方法未能发现的他汀应答通路及发育阶段特异的调控关系。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作显示扰动诱导的程序是稳态图谱之外的补充层，能揭示具有遗传信息性的调控通路，对连接扰动数据与疾病遗传有重要参考。
llm.limitations_zh: 多数验证依赖特定细胞系与性状的组合，跨情境的稳健性仍需更多独立验证。

title: Single-cell geometry of drug responses across malignant glioma states
abstract: Malignant gliomas exhibit substantial transcriptional heterogeneity: AC-, OPC-, NPC- and MES-like states can coexist within the same tumor, and a drug affecting one state may leave others relatively unaffected. Whether these states respond in a shared direction, or diverge, is rarely tested directly, since drug response is usually summarized by one score that collapses this heterogeneity. A public single-cell RNA-sequencing resource of drug-treated glioma slice cultures (391,444 cells) is reanalyzed here to test this directly. After restricting to 252,106 transformed glioma cells, 43 treatment-vehicle comparisons from 19 TissueID-defined units are evaluated for response-direction coherence (C, similarity of state-conditioned treatment vectors) and change in state separation (K, state-centroid contraction or expansion). C proves to be the reproducible signal: it survives high-confidence state filtering (r=0.931), an independently selected 500-gene space (r=0.634), the published Neftel modules (r=0.783) and non-overlapping gene cross-fitting (r=0.809), and exceeds two null models in 41 of 43 comparisons, a result that also holds across the 19 biological units themselves (19 of 19 positive; P=3.8e-6). Within-drug coherence exceeds between-drug coherence in all 52 drug pairs and all 11 multi-drug units (P=0.000488): response direction is drug-specific, not generic. K tells a different story: stable only when the feature space is fixed, it loses concordance whenever that space shifts, with only about half of comparisons separating from the null. Malignant glioma states largely agree on the direction of drug response even when they disagree on its magnitude.

llm.novelty_zh: 将药物响应拆分为跨胶质瘤细胞状态的响应方向一致性（C）与状态分离变化（K）两个指标，检验响应方向是否具有药物特异性。
llm.summary_zh: 作者在公开的药物处理胶质瘤切片培养单细胞数据（约25万个恶性细胞）上，比较43组药物与对照的状态条件响应向量。结果显示恶性胶质瘤各状态对药物响应的方向基本一致，且方向具有药物特异性，而状态分离变化的结论对特征空间较敏感。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作说明单一汇总评分会掩盖肿瘤内部状态异质性，为设计考虑多状态的药物响应评估提供了分析视角。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及除特征空间敏感性之外的其他局限，且分析基于已有公开数据而非新的扰动实验。

title: Where single-cell foundation models help: a public-data benchmark of annotation, in silico perturbation and gene regulatory inference
abstract: Single-cell foundation models (FMs) are proposed as general tools for cell-type annotation, in silico perturbation and gene-regulatory-network inference. We benchmarked five FMs (scGPT, Geneformer V1 and V2, Nicheformer, scFoundation), four newer FMs, CellOracle, supervised perturbation models and task-matched simple baselines on public data, from Perturb-seq screens of cell lines and primary T cells to a brain organoid screen, the developing mouse cortex and lung cancer biopsies, under an analysis plan fixed before the new results. FMs helped most when labels were transferred across species: Nicheformer reached 0.98 accuracy from human to mouse lung, above every baseline (at most 0.94), and fine-tuned Geneformer V2 reached macro-F1 0.88 from mouse to human, against at most 0.74. In K562, zero-shot perturbations captured the direction of real responses (up to 76% of perturbations), Geneformer V2 tracked CRISPRa effect sizes with its overexpression protocol (rho = 0.30), and its networks recovered tumour differential expression better than co-expression. Within a species, FM embeddings did not exceed principal components. In silico deletions followed target expression and, across seven screens with replicate-level ground truth, met the predefined criterion in none of 81 tests, although in K562 and RPE1 the measured effects replicated between libraries. In contrast, the gene vectors of seven of eight FMs, including three newer models, added to expression features, predicted which knockdowns have large effects in an independent genome-wide K562 screen (rho between 0.34 and 0.44, against 0.26 with expression alone). We release the benchmark and its checks as the fmaudit package.

datasets_used: Perturb-seq screens of cell lines (K562, RPE1)
llm.novelty_zh: 在预先注册的分析计划下，用公开数据系统评测多种单细胞基础模型在细胞注释、in silico 扰动和基因调控网络推断三项任务上的表现，并发布可复现的 fmaudit 基准与检验工具包。
llm.summary_zh: 该研究在公开的 Perturb-seq、CRISPRa、类器官、小鼠皮层和肺癌活检等数据上，对五种及四种较新的单细胞基础模型、CellOracle、监督扰动模型及简单基线进行了基准评测。结果显示基础模型仅在跨物种标签迁移中优势明显，在同物种内不超过主成分；in silico 缺失在 81 项检验中均未达到预设标准，但基因向量在独立全基因组 K562 筛选中能增强对大效应敲低的预测。论文同时发布了基准及检验代码 fmaudit。

title: Autonomous generalizability auditing of scientific foundation models
abstract: Determining where scientific foundation models generalize beyond their development data is essential for reliable use, but aggregate benchmarks obscure performance limits and rigorous audits are difficult to conduct routinely. Here, we introduce AutoSPECTRA, a coding-agent protocol for systematic generalizability auditing. To inform its design, we reviewed 38 studies across five biological domains and evaluated coding agents, which generated hypotheses and empirical analyses but applied inconsistent standards for judging evidence. We then structured AutoSPECTRA around measurable generalization axes, prespecified analyses, controlled comparisons and independent confirmation. Across four biological foundation models, audits linked performance to protein sequence composition and relatedness to pretraining data (ESMFold2), representation of perturbations in training (STATE), effective spatial resolution (CONCH), and residue-level genomic, evolutionary and structural context (AlphaMissense). Agents also evaluated alternative explanations and rejected unsupported hypotheses. AutoSPECTRA provides a systematic approach to discovering and testing the limits of scientific foundation models.

llm.novelty_zh: 用编码代理执行预先设定分析、受控比较与独立确认的生成性审计协议，系统评估科学基础模型的泛化边界。
llm.summary_zh: AutoSPECTRA 是一种由编码代理执行的泛化性审计协议，围绕可度量的泛化维度、预先设定的分析、受控比较与独立确认来组织流程。作者综述了五个生物领域的 38 项研究以指导设计，并将其应用于四个生物基础模型，包括 ESMFold2、STATE、CONCH 与 AlphaMissense。审计发现性能与蛋白序列组成、预训练数据相似性、训练中的扰动表征、空间分辨率及残基层面的背景等相关，并能拒绝缺乏支持的假设。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为系统检验科学基础模型的适用范围提供了可复用的审计流程。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要指出，未经结构化的编码代理在判断证据时标准并不一致。

title: RAPTORGraph: graph-based pathway modeling for causal discovery in single-cell perturbations
abstract: Experiments involving the perturbation of individual cells are central to understanding cellular mechanisms and can accelerate drug discovery. Causal representation learning allows us to uncover the latent factors that regulate biological systems and predict the impact of novel perturbations. Unfortunately, existing methods fail to address intervention spillover in a closed-world setting where intervention targets are known a priori, such as in Perturb-seq experiments, due to their reliance on dense encoders. Furthermore, incorporating curated biological pathways into the model imposes a confirmatory bias, forcing it to explain the data through preexisting pathways and reducing the set of hypotheses the model can explore, while discarding novel signals that lie outside the annotated pathways. In this work, we introduce RAPTORGraph, a β -variational autoencoder with a GraphPathway encoder that explicitly models complex gene-to-gene interactions within learned pathways. Moreover, our model’s preconditioning isolates the influence of perturbed genes, yielding clean, single-node latent interventions required for identifiable causal discovery and eliminating spillover. Finally, we train the model on data preprocessed with optimal-transport alignment, which guarantees a well-defined mapping between control and perturbed samples and further stabilizes the learned latent representations. We demonstrate that RAPTORGraph improves state-of-the-art performance on downstream analyses of unseen perturbations, such as non-additive interactions, while performing competitively on objective metrics, such as mean squared error and maximum mean discrepancy. The source code is available at https://github.com/sXperfect/RAPTORGraph. Author summary Understanding how genes work together can help explain changes in cell behavior and guide the search for treatments. Yet testing every possible combination of genetic changes is impractical. We developed a computer model to predict how individual cells respond to changes that have not been tested experimentally. We address two problems: existing models can obscure how a change leads to a predicted outcome and overlook differences between individual cells. In our model, each genetic change enters through a single starting point, and its effects can spread through a network learned from the data. This allows us to examine how a predicted response develops. We also match cells from separate groups with and without genetic changes, helping our model retain the diversity of cellular responses. In tests on two datasets, we improved predictions of responses to genetic perturbations. On the Norman et al. dataset, we also improved predictions of responses to combined genetic changes whose effects could not be explained by adding the effects of the individual changes. We also used the model to suggest genetic changes that could explain an observed cellular response. Our approach could help researchers choose informative experiments and investigate how genes jointly shape cell behavior.
affiliations: Centro de Investigación Biomédica en Red de Cáncer
CAIMed - Niedersächsisches Zentrum für KI und Kausale Methoden in der Medizin

llm.novelty_zh: 将基于通路的图编码器嵌入beta-VAE，并用最优传输对齐对照与扰动细胞，使每个扰动以单节点隐空间干预的形式作用。
llm.summary_zh: RAPTORGraph是一个beta-VAE，其GraphPathway编码器显式建模学习到的通路内基因间相互作用，并通过预处理使扰动基因的影响局限在单一节点，以减少干扰溢出。模型在最优传输对齐的数据上训练，在未见扰动（包括非加性相互作用）的下游分析上相对现有方法有所提升，同时在MSE与MMD指标上保持竞争力。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 尝试在Perturb-seq的封闭设定中实现可辨识的因果扰动建模，同时保留未被注释通路覆盖的新信号。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: XAMPGen: An Interpretable Super Intelligence Pipeline For Novel Antimicrobial Peptide Discovery
abstract: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) are short peptides with a broad spectrum of activity against bacterial pathogens, representing a promising avenue for combating the growing threat of antibiotic resistance. This study focuses on two main components: 1) generative super intelligence (GenSI) and 2) utilizing explainable super intelligence (XSI). We fine-tuned ProGen, a decoder-only protein language model, on known AMPs to generate novel peptide sequences with strong antimicrobial properties. Generated candidates were screened with an AMP classifier and filtered based on predicted minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC), along with human insights into AMP structure and activity in bacterial membranes. A final set of peptides was selected for synthesis and experimental testing. Biological assays confirmed antimicrobial activity in all generated and tested peptides, while fluorescence and circular dichroism measurements characterized membrane binding and peptide structure. We then applied XSI techniques to interpret the generative model and derive biological insights. Specifically, layer probing was used to identify cornerstone layers that encode functionally critical information. Self-attention analysis within these layers revealed residue-level interdependencies and patterns underlying antimicrobial functions, which we evaluated against well-characterized AMPs from the literature. We further examined associations between amino acid sequence patterns and binding properties in bacterial membrane mimics, relating these observations to biological activities in cell-based assays. These analyses provide insight into the model's decision-making process. This builds confidence that the learned amino acid interdependencies have physico-chemical significance, as applied to AMPs, and may facilitate the discovery of novel AMPs with therapeutic potential. This work demonstrates that interpretable generative language models can support rational AMP discovery.
affiliations: National Institute of Standards and Technology
Institute for Bioscience and Biotechnology Research

llm.novelty_zh: 将微调后的蛋白语言模型生成与层探测、自注意力等可解释分析结合，设计并实验验证新型抗菌肽。
llm.summary_zh: 作者在已知抗菌肽上微调ProGen生成候选序列，经分类器与最低抑菌浓度预测筛选后合成测试，所有测试肽均显示抗菌活性。随后通过层探测与自注意力分析解读生成模型，并考察其学到的氨基酸相互依赖与细菌膜结合性质之间的关联。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了可解释生成语言模型支持抗菌肽理性设计的实验可行路径。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: Mapping the regulatory wiring of endothelial cell differentiation reveals a critical role for Hippo mechanosignaling
abstract: At each step of development, stem cells encounter a branching decision to differentiate into one type of cell or another. This decision is executed through the action of competing gene programs that specify different cellular identities. Consequently, creating a comprehensive map of the gene programs that drive each branching step of human cell differentiation remains a long-sought goal of developmental and stem cell biology. Here, we introduce a framework combining genome-wide CRISPR screens, single-cell readouts, and gene program inference to systematically discover and characterize regulators of cell differentiation. This framework includes a method for CRISPR perturbations paired with single-cell RNA-seq called circular capture Perturb-seq (CC-Perturb-seq), which improves gRNA detection from split-pool combinatorial indexing protocols and enables perturbing many candidate regulators to map their effects on gene programs. We applied this framework to map how human pluripotent stem cells differentiate into arterial endothelial cells (ECs), and identified 174 regulators that promote or inhibit EC differentiation. By tracking gene programs across three stages of differentiation, we resolved when and how regulators divert cells toward alternative fates. This map revealed an unexpected requirement for the Hippo mechanosignaling pathway in EC specification. During lateral mesoderm differentiation, Hippo mechanosignaling was required to activate ETV2 , the master transcriptional regulator of endothelial identity. Inhibiting Hippo blocked ETV2 even in the presence of VEGF and diverted progenitors to a mesenchymal fate in vitro . Likewise, Hippo signaling was required for maximal etv2 expression in developing zebrafish embryos. Conversely, pharmacologically activating the Hippo pathway increased the purity of both arterial and venous EC differentiation in vitro . Our framework thus identifies novel regulators of endothelial cell differentiation, improves stem-cell differentiation protocols via manipulation of mechanosignaling, and provides a generalizable platform for mapping the regulatory wiring of human development.
affiliations: Stanford Maternal and Child Health Research Institute
Institute for Stem Cell Biology and Regenerative Medicine

llm.novelty_zh: 提出CC-Perturb-seq方法改进CRISPR扰动与单细胞测序的结合，并用于绘制内皮分化的调控基因图谱。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作提出CC-Perturb-seq，改进了与split-pool单细胞测序结合的CRISPR扰动检测，并在人多能干细胞向动脉内皮分化中筛选出174个调控因子。研究发现Hippo机械信号通路是ETV2激活和内皮特化所必需的，斑马鱼胚胎中也得到支持。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作揭示了内皮分化中的机械信号调控，并可能改进干细胞分化方案。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: Plate design confounds donor variation and model evaluation in single-cell perturbation screens
abstract: SUMMARY Single-cell screens of immune cells from many donors are used to study why individuals respond differently and to benchmark response models. Each donor–perturbation combination typically occupies one well, controls are grouped, and donors share one layout, so technical effects can look biological. Using a 90-cytokine screen, two compound screens, four cohorts and simulations, we show that well effects explain most replicate-control variation in abundant cell types, controls carry a shared offset, and identical control wells differ by hundreds of differentially expressed genes at a standard threshold, about as many as two receptor-negative proteins do. Negative controls, design-aware estimators and perturbation-specific evaluation change the interpretation of four recent analyses. A deep-learning model that scores below a perturbation-agnostic predictor under standard evaluation outperforms a simple baseline on perturbation-specific differences in two of three cell types (significantly in one with stricter controls), but predicts less well the component shared with inert wells.

llm.novelty_zh: 揭示孔板布局效应会混淆供体差异与模型评估，并提出阴性对照、设计感知估计量与扰动特异性评估。
llm.summary_zh: 作者基于 90 种细胞因子筛选、两个化合物筛选、四个队列与模拟数据发现，孔效应解释了丰度细胞类型中大部分重复对照的变异，且相同的对照孔之间可出现数百个差异表达基因。采用阴性对照、设计感知估计量与扰动特异性评估后，四项近期分析的解释发生改变；在三种细胞类型中的两种上，一个在标准评估下不如无扰动预测器的深度模型，在扰动特异性差异上优于简单基线。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 提示单细胞扰动筛选的评估需要排除技术混杂，才能正确解释供体差异与模型能力。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要指出该深度模型对与惰性孔共享的成分预测较差。

title: scDisentangle: sequential disentanglement for single-cell perturbation response prediction
abstract: Predicting the transcriptional response of single cells to perturbation is a central goal of single-cell modeling, with broad application to analysis and experimental design. Existing methods often fail to beat simple baselines and offer little insight into how biological variation is organized. We present scDisentangle, a model that decomposes single-cell expression into observed attributes and a sequence of residual components, generating counterfactuals that preserve source cell identity. scDisentangle outperformed current models and naive baselines on cytokine stimulation, liver infection, and unseen combinatorial genetic perturbations, on which accuracy was largely independent of how closely a response resembled the average perturbation effect. In an immune checkpoint inhibitor-associated myocarditis cohort, cell-resolved counterfactuals predicted donor-specific intracardiac CD8+ T cell states from peripheral blood. In a castration-regeneration prostate atlas, predictions recapitulated luminal dynamics and progenitor-marker kinetics upon androgen add-back. scDisentangle’s coarse-to-fine latent structure aligned with hematopoietic lineage organization, with early levels capturing a less differentiated core progressively refined into cell-type-specific programs.

llm.novelty_zh: 把单细胞表达分解为可观测属性与逐级残差成分，并生成保留源细胞身份的反事实表达。
llm.summary_zh: scDisentangle 将单细胞表达拆分为观测属性与一系列残差成分，用于生成保留源细胞身份的反事实，以预测扰动响应。作者在细胞因子刺激、肝感染和未见组合遗传扰动等数据上优于现有模型与简单基线，并在心肌炎队列和前列腺再生图谱中完成了供体特异性及动态预测。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 在扰动响应预测中兼顾精度与对生物变异组织方式的解释，具有较好的应用前景。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及计算成本、对超大规模数据的扩展性或失败案例。

title: Language-guided domain adaptation improves protein sequence representations for antimicrobial resistance analysis
abstract: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in bacterial pathogens complicates infectious disease management. Protein sequences encode molecular features underlying resistance functions such as antibiotic inactivation and drug efflux, providing a basis for investigating bacterial AMR. Protein language models can extract transferable representations from these sequences. However, general purpose protein language models have limited capacity to represent AMR-associated sequences, while task-specific tools often address individual prediction problems. These limitations highlight the need for protein representations that better capture resistance associated functions and can be reused across complementary tasks, supporting systematic AMR analysis from sequence variation to functional relationships among proteins. We developed BacLLM, a language-guided protein representation framework that integrates annotation derived functional knowledge into protein language model representations for AMR analysis in bacterial pathogens. Through sequence enhancement, semantic enrichment of UniProt annotations, and cross modal contrastive learning, BacLLM transfers LLM encoded annotation priors into the sequence encoder, enabling sequence only inference after training. Compared with baseline models, BacLLM provided more informative representations of resistance associated sequences, achieving a mean F1 score of 0.956 across six AMR benchmarks with logistic regression, 2.7 percentage points above the strongest baseline. It also captured resistance associated mutational signals at single residue resolution and preserved taxonomic relationships not reflected by phenotype based clinical groupings. Moreover, BacLLM recovered resistance associated functional organization within a TolC centered protein association network, prioritizing proteins with low sequence identity to TolC but predicted structural similarity to TolC. Extending the same representation framework to an intervention oriented application, BacLLM also improved strain level phage host matching for phage therapy candidate prioritization. Together, these findings establish BacLLM as a reusable protein representation framework for analyzing resistance associated sequence variation and functional organization, with applications in AMR surveillance and phage candidate prioritization.
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Genomics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

llm.novelty_zh: 将大语言模型生成的功能注释先验通过跨模态对比学习迁移到蛋白序列编码器，实现仅依赖序列的耐药分析。
llm.summary_zh: BacLLM结合UniProt注释的语义增强与跨模态对比学习，把大语言模型的注释先验迁移到蛋白序列编码器中，训练后仅凭序列即可推断。在六个抗菌素耐药基准上，其逻辑回归平均F1为0.956，比最强基线高2.7个百分点，并可用于菌株层面的噬菌体宿主匹配。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为细菌耐药相关蛋白的序列表征提供了可复用框架，并可拓展到噬菌体治疗候选的筛选。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: Virtual dynamics of spatiotemporal single-cell interactions
abstract: Building virtual cells and tissues requires reconstructing how interacting cell populations evolve in space and time, yet spatial omics experiments provide only sparse snapshots of this process. Here, we introduce CytoBridge, a computational method that reconstructs continuous virtual cell dynamics from discrete spatial transcriptomic data. Starting from a joint transcriptomic–spatial space, CytoBridge learns stochastic trajectories of cell states, positions, and population sizes through an unbalanced mean-field Schrödinger bridge formulation that explicitly incorporates cell–cell interaction as a dynamical driver. A time-varying interaction graph built from spatial proximity and ligand–receptor priors allows the velocity to be decomposed into an interaction component estimated from observed neighborhoods and ligand–receptor features, and an intrinsic-context component that captures intrinsic regulatory processes and unmeasured contextual influences. Applied to five datasets across three spatial transcriptomics platforms and spanning development, regeneration, and neurodegeneration, CytoBridge accurately generates tissue dynamics at unmeasured time points, follows ligand–receptor signaling through measured and unmeasured stages, and supports hypothesis-generating in silico perturbation. CytoBridge provides a general method for turning heterogeneous spatiotemporal transcriptomic measurements into continuously evolving virtual tissues.

llm.novelty_zh: 用非平衡均场薛定谔桥并把细胞间相互作用作为动力学驱动项，同时纳入配体-受体先验。
llm.summary_zh: 提出CytoBridge，从离散的空间转录组数据重建连续的虚拟细胞动力学，学习细胞状态、位置与群体规模的随机轨迹。作者在五个数据集与三个空间平台上验证其可在未测时间点生成组织动态，并支持配体-受体信号的追踪与计算机模拟扰动。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 把空间邻域相互作用显式纳入虚拟组织动力学，直接服务于虚拟组织建模。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出与基线的定量比较数值，计算模拟扰动的结论需实验验证。

title: Multicellular Perturb-seq Reveals Lineage-Specific Transcriptional Control During Human Cardiac Organoid Development
abstract: Heart development requires the coordinated differentiation of multiple cell lineages, including cardiomyocytes (CMs) and endothelial cells (ECs). Transcription factors (TFs) orchestrate lineage specification, morphogenesis, and maturation, yet how cardiac and vascular TFs shape multicellular organization and their interactions remain poorly understood. Many TFs exhibit pleiotropic and stage-dependent effects across cardiac lineages, particularly in cardiac progenitor cells, suggesting the presence of shared regulatory networks that synchronize cardiac and vascular programs during development and in response to stress. Human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC) differentiated cardiac organoid provides a physiologically relevant 3D model to study these multicellular interactions, enabling simultaneous differentiation of ECs and CMs within a human genetic context. When combined with CRISPR interference (CRISPRi)–based Perturb-seq, this system allows systematic, high-throughput dissection of TF-driven regulatory programs at single-cell resolution. In this study, we investigated how cardiac and vascular TFs coordinate lineage commitment and the cross-lineage signaling in human cardiovascular differentiation.

llm.novelty_zh: 在 hiPSC 分化的心脏类器官中，用 CRISPRi 介导的 Perturb-seq 系统筛选心脏与血管转录因子。
llm.summary_zh: 作者利用 hiPSC 分化的心脏类器官（同时含心肌细胞与内皮细胞），结合 CRISPRi 介导的 Perturb-seq，研究心脏与血管转录因子如何协调谱系承诺及跨谱系信号。摘要仅给出研究背景与目的，未报告具体结果。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了研究多细胞发育调控的湿实验平台，与计算建模的直接关联较弱。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及具体结果、数据规模或分析方法。

title: Inferring gene regulatory networks from single-cell perturbation data by optimizing causal reach of latent mediator dynamics
abstract: Resolving the causal structure of gene regulatory networks is central to understanding cellular regulation. Pooled CRISPR screens with single-cell RNA readouts measure the transcriptional consequences of many interventions in parallel, providing a powerful resource for causal discovery. Combinatorial designs that perturb multiple regulators per cell increase throughput and can reveal responses that single-gene perturbations do not. However, inferring causal gene networks from these experiments remains challenging because gene regulatory interactions are nonlinear, dynamic, and often involve feedback. Thus, attributing the combined effect of several perturbations to individual regulators remains difficult. Additionally, transcriptional regulation is ultimately carried out by proteins, while single-cell perturbation datasets generally measure only RNA levels. Existing methods often simplify regulatory dynamics or rely on assumptions that conflict with gene regulation, such as acyclicity. Moreover, current evaluation practices usually rely on expression prediction error, which is readily computable in real datasets, but does not necessarily reflect graph quality. A complementary metric is needed to assess inferred regulatory connections using observed perturbation responses in real data. To address these challenges, we present CausalODE, a differentiable framework for learning causal graphs from single-cell perturbation data. Our approach incorporates three central insights to improve upon previous methods. First, genes that are differentially expressed when a gene is perturbed should be downstream of the target gene in the regulatory network; we quantify this property with a metric we term causal reach. Second, causal interactions involve transient cellular responses in RNA transcription, splicing, and degradation. Third, gene regulatory interactions are mediated by proteins, whose levels are not directly measured in single-cell RNA-seq experiments. Building on these insights, CausalODE learns a graph that optimizes the causal reach metric, captures transient cellular responses to perturbation, and explicitly models the latent dynamics of protein levels. Together, these components allow nonlinear responses, feedback loops, and time-lagged regulation. Across simulated Perturb-seq datasets with different sparsities and graph structures, CausalODE improves AUPRC and precision among top-ranked edges compared with baselines and competing methods, while achieving competitive AUROC. We introduce a metric to evaluate the causal reach of inferred graphs on real data by measuring how well the graphs explain differentially expressed genes in single-cell perturbation experiments. Using this metric, CausalODE outperforms the strongest competing method or baseline by approximately 60% on the CaRPool-seq knockdown dataset and 80% on the Norman et al. activation dataset. Its top-ranked edges generally show greater enrichment for high-confidence evidence from cell-type-matched ChIP-seq, CollecTRI, and regulatory STRING than those of other methods. The inferred graphs also distin-guish non-additive from approximately additive genetic interactions in held-out perturbation pairs. Finally, ablation analyses show that optimizing causal reach improves performance on held-out perturbations, and the learned latent regulator activities track simulated protein dynamics, with median temporal correlations ranging from 0.79 to 0.99.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出因果可达性（causal reach）指标，并用可微ODE学习兼顾瞬态响应与蛋白潜动态的因果基因图。
llm.summary_zh: CausalODE 是一个可微框架，从单细胞扰动数据学习因果基因调控图，优化 causal reach 指标，并显式建模 RNA 转录、剪接和降解的瞬态响应以及蛋白质潜在动态，可处理非线性、反馈和时滞调控。在模拟 Perturb-seq 以及真实的 CaRPool-seq 与 Norman 激活数据上，相对最强基线分别提升约60%和80%。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 使扰动数据中的因果基因网络推断可以基于真实数据上的可观测响应进行评估。
llm.limitations_zh: 真实数据上的评估依赖作者提出的新指标，摘要未说明其与其他图质量指标的一致性。

title: Predicting Transcriptional Responses to Unseen Compounds through Context Modeling and Multi-View Transfer
abstract: Predicting drug-induced transcriptional responses could support in silico screening of new compounds, yet existing models barely use the compound: on a drug-blind L1000 benchmark, removing the drug input from seven published models changes accuracy by at most 0.012 Pearson correlation. They capture shared cellular and experimental variation while overlooking the compound-specific signals that distinguish drug effects. We present UnDetect, a framework that separates contextual variation from compound effects to predict responses to transcriptionally unprofiled compounds. UnDetect integrates chemical structure, annotated targets, mechanisms of action and Cell Painting morphology into a normalized multi-view kernel that accommodates incomplete compound information, and transfers residual responses within and across profiled cell lines, so that pharmacological and phenotypic relationships inform predictions beyond chemical similarity. On a drug-blind benchmark, where the paired control reveals the assay plate, UnDetect is the only model to beat a network that ignores the compound, in every fold; on a within-plate score that is zero for any compound-blind prediction, it reaches 0.117 against 0.092 for the strongest published model. On DeepCE's benchmark it reaches 0.602 Pearson correlation against the reported 0.491. Transfer across cell lines improves 28 of 28 LINCS L1000 and, at the two higher doses, 47 and 49 of 50 Tahoe-100M cell-line evaluations. These results show that separating context from compound effects and integrating complementary compound information improves transcriptional prediction and extends the utility of perturbation atlases for virtual screening.
affiliations: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

llm.novelty_zh: 用多视角核整合化学结构、靶点、作用机制与 Cell Painting 形态，并在细胞系之间迁移残差响应。
llm.summary_zh: UnDetect 将上下文变化与化合物效应分离，借助归一化的多视角核整合化学结构等信息，预测未转录分析化合物的响应。在 drug-blind 基准和 DeepCE 基准上相对最强已发表模型提升明显（如 Pearson 0.602 对 0.491），并在 LINCS L1000 与 Tahoe-100M 上跨细胞系迁移成功。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 在公认基准上对药物响应预测有明确提升，并拓展了扰动图谱在虚拟筛选中的用途。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未说明对完全新颖化合物结构或其他数据类型的泛化能力，实际虚拟筛选效果仍有待验证。

title: scCont: Interpretable Contrastive Learning for Functional Characterization of Cellular State Transitions
abstract: Timecourse single-cell RNA (scRNA) datasets have become indispensable biological tools for studying and uncovering the underlying regulatory processes driving continuous cell-state transitions such as the epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition. However, these highly fluid, non-linear gene program dynamics remain difficult to disentangle. While deep neural network models can effectively map complex topologies, they are biological black boxes, lacking the gene-level interpretability required by experimental practitioners. Here, we introduce scCont, a fully unsupervised contrastive learning framework for extracting interpretable functional transition units from scRNA-seq data. Rather than relying on explicit temporal labels or clustering priors, scCont uses an unsupervised k-nearest neighbors approach to project local transcriptomic neighborhoods into a low-dimensional embedding. During post-training analysis, scCont employs Shapley network attribution to determine gene-latent relationships, mapping latent dimensions directly into functional gene programs. We quantitatively and qualitatively validate this representation by demonstrating that scCont captures biologically interpretable dynamics more effectively than baseline methods such as LDVAE. Evaluated across 13 diverse EMT timecourse datasets and four simulated datasets, scCont exposes interpretable functional dynamics and effectively maps context-dependent functional groups, helping to bridge the gap between deep learning representation and translational biological utility. scCont is an open source software available on GitHub ( https://github.com/nramani611/scCont ).

llm.novelty_zh: 以无监督kNN对比学习结合Shapley归因，将EMT时序单细胞数据的潜在维度映射为可解释的功能基因程序。
llm.summary_zh: 作者提出scCont，用无监督近邻对比学习将局部转录组邻域投影到低维嵌入，再用Shapley网络归因建立基因与潜在维度的对应关系。在13个EMT时序数据集和4个模拟数据集上，scCont的可解释动态结果优于LDVAE等基线。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作尝试在细胞状态转变分析中同时兼顾表征能力与基因层面的可解释性，便于实验人员理解转录程序。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及下游生物学验证的具体结果，也未说明与其他更新方法的系统比较。

title: Label-free flow operators and stability operators from single-cell time courses: what local dynamical operators can and cannot identify
abstract: Local Jacobians of single-cell dynamics are used to locate unstable cells along trajectories, but what they identify from measured data has rarely been tested against independent truth. We present scJDO2, which separates two per-cell operators by the time information they require: a score operator, the Hessian of a score-matched log density, available from any snapshot; and a flow operator, the Jacobian of a drift fitted to a measured velocity, here estimated label-free from a sampled time course by entropic optimal transport. Both are summarized in a shared operator space of magnitude-free descriptors, with the invariance of each stated, and evaluated with pre-registered tests. On synthetic data calibrated to six real datasets, the flow operator from the time course alone separated fate-bifurcation cells from committed cells on held-out seeds (AUC 0.89–1.00) with a-priori settings; tuning on development seeds overfit. On LARRY lineage-traced hematopoiesis, its fitted drift predicted the clonal displacement of barcoded cells beyond population movement (Spearman 0.56, permutation p < 0.001; 0.50 after removing the mean shift) and a held-out sampling day better than mean-displacement and no-movement baselines (energy distance 0.69, 95 % CI 0.66–0.73, vs 0.87 and 0.88); lineage thus validates the velocity, not λ□. Mini-batch transport reproduced dense transport (velocity cosine 0.9998) and scaled to all 130,887 cells (transport 5 min and 2.5 GB; drift fit and Jacobians 21 min and 1.3 GB). On an independent simulator it detected two of three bifurcations and two of three cycles and never reported instability on linear trajectories. Several readings failed. Neither operator recovers the values of the true Jacobian; the flow operator’s leading eigenvalue ranks branching cells empirically. The flow operator depends on the transport metric and inverts on Factor Analysis. Operator archetypes isolated bifurcation cells but did not outperform expression clustering and were unstable across fit seeds. The score operator did not predict CRISPRi knockdown responses or sister-cell fate coherence. A confirmatory test of transition timing could not be constructed, and diffusion is not identifiable at typical sampling intervals. The released software reports these diagnostics. Changes from v56 Two operators, matched to the time information measured (new). v56 used one drift field learned by diffusion score matching (DSM) on pseudotime. v57 (scJDO2) distinguishes the score operator J_score = β□² log p (from a snapshot; it describes the curvature of the cell-state density) from the flow operator J_flow = ∂f/∂z of a drift f fitted to a measured velocity (time-course optimal transport, lineage, metabolic labeling or RNA velocity). Operator space (new); archetypes (carried over). Both operators are summarized by magnitude-free descriptors in one operator space; spectral descriptors of the flow operator are invariant under any linear change of coordinates, two eigenvector-based descriptors only under orthogonal ones. Operator archetypes were introduced in scJDO v1 [1] and are carried over; v57 fits them in the new operator space and tests them against true regimes. Label-free OT flow operator, evaluated (new). Flow operators are estimated from a time course alone (entropic OT between sampling days → barycentric velocity → drift → Jacobian) and evaluated on held-out seeds, an independent simulator and lineage barcodes, and scaled to a full dataset. OT velocities and Jacobians of OT-learned drifts have precedent [2–4]; the evaluation is what is new. Identifiability analysis (new): representation, clock, rotation, stationarity, diffusion and composition, with an explicit list of what was tested and not supported. Correction: v56 recommended Factor Analysis (FA) as the default representation. This does not hold for flow operators: the OT flow operator inverts on FA (fork AUC 0.04–0.53) and needs a variance-weighted transport space (PCA of log-normalized counts, 10–20 components). FA remains acceptable for the DSM drift of the v56 analyses. New benchmarks: a generator calibrated to six real datasets, an independent simulator (dyngen), held-out seeds and pre-registered gates throughout. Not carried over: the scJDO v1 analyses of v56 (iPSC reprogramming operator handoffs, hematopoiesis, Dynamo/SpliceJAC concordance, synthetic benchmarks of the v1 machinery, constructed obstruction, bifurcation-saddle limit and K562 Schrödinger-bridge feasibility) are not repeated here. They were obtained with a different operator (a DSM drift fitted on pseudotime), remain available in version 56 of this preprint, and are not re-evaluated in this version.

llm.novelty_zh: 把单细胞局部动力学算子拆分为快照可得的 score operator 与时间序列估计的 flow operator，并以预先设定的检验评估其可识别性。
llm.summary_zh: scJDO2 用熵最优传输从单细胞时间序列估计漂移场并计算 flow operator，同时从快照数据计算 score operator。在 LARRY 谱系追踪数据上，流算子对克隆位移的预测超出群体整体运动，且优于均值位移与无运动基线。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作明确区分了哪些动力学量可以从数据中识别，为从单细胞轨迹推断细胞不稳定性提供了诊断标准。
llm.limitations_zh: 多数诊断失败：算子不能恢复真实 Jacobian，扩散项在典型采样间隔下不可识别，且算子原型不优于表达聚类并对拟合种子不稳定。

title: Host control and regulation of human anellovirus persistence
abstract: Anelloviruses are the most abundant and diverse eukaryotic viruses known to infect humans and can persist throughout our lifetimes. Despite their ubiquity, the host factors governing their physiologic distribution and abundance remain poorly understood. Here, we construct a viral pangenome of 2,023 strains to quantify anellovirus DNA in >1.1 million participants spanning three genetic biobanks. Genome-wide association studies identify 121 loci linked to viral persistence, predominantly via immune regulation by NF-κB signaling. Further, we associate variable anellovirus detection with conditions characterized by immune dysfunction, including lymphoid malignancies. By screening 3.2 petabases of human single-cell sequencing data, we identify myeloid progenitors in the bone marrow as a prominent site of anellovirus transcription in vivo. Finally, Perturb-seq of anellovirus proteins reveals that anellovirus ORF2, particularly from Alphatorquevirus, attenuates TNF-α-induced NF-κB signaling, connecting host genetic variation, cellular context, and viral immunomodulation to characterize the persistence of the eukaryotic human virome's most abundant component.
affiliations: Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique

llm.novelty_zh: 在超过110万人群中定位与病毒持续相关的宿主遗传位点，并用Perturb-seq验证ORF2的免疫调节作用。
llm.summary_zh: 研究构建了2023株的病毒泛基因组，在110万余名参与者中开展GWAS，识别121个与病毒持续相关的位点，主要通过NF-κB免疫调控起作用。另通过单细胞数据与Perturb-seq发现骨髓髓系祖细胞是主要转录部位，ORF2可减弱TNF-α诱导的NF-κB信号。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示宿主遗传与免疫功能如何影响人类病毒组的持续状态，对免疫失调相关疾病研究有启示。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: LUCID: joint cell typing and neighbour-aware decontamination of segmented spatial transcriptomics
abstract: Cell profiles in segmented spatial transcriptomics are contaminated by RNA of neighbouring cells and by segmentation errors that merge two cells. LUCID is a multinomial mixture model that jointly assigns a type to each cell, tests whether its profile mixes two types and estimates the fraction of counts coming from its neighbours. An external reference is adapted to the platform, an identifiability rule protects a cell's own signal and the test is calibrated by parametric bootstrap. LUCID works with or without a reference, runs on CPUs and returns integer counts for all genes. On three public Visium HD datasets (mouse brain, human colorectal cancer, mouse liver) and in simulations built on them, LUCID removed contamination from other cell types as well as two-step pipelines, including RCTD followed by DecontX, flagged fewer contaminated cells as mixed, emptied no cell and preserved minority lineages where one cell type dominates.

llm.novelty_zh: 将细胞类型指派、两类型混合检验与邻近细胞污染比例估计联合在一个多项混合模型中，并用参数化自助法校准，同时修正分割错误造成的合并细胞。
llm.summary_zh: LUCID 是一个多项混合模型，用于分割后的空间转录组数据：它同时为每个细胞分配类型、检验其表达谱是否混合了两种类型，并估计来自邻近细胞的 counts 比例。在三个公开的 Visium HD 数据集（小鼠脑、人结直肠癌、小鼠肝）及其模拟数据上，它比 RCTD 加 DecontX 的两步流程更好地去除其他细胞类型的污染，标记为混合的污染细胞更少，且不会清空任何细胞。该工作属于空间组学数据预处理与细胞类型注释，与虚拟细胞建模的关联较间接。

title: BioMeme: biological response memory for virtual cells
abstract: Virtual cells predict responses to unmeasured perturbations, but neural models absorb measurements into weights, require retraining and cannot cite supporting experiments. Here we introduce biological response memory, replacing a learned state-to-response layer with a memory of measured experiments. BioMeme predicts next-dose responses in a new cell type from measured lower-dose states, recalling similarly responding compounds in that cell and the same compound in a reference cell line. Each prediction is an exact weighted sum of named measurements, and memory updates with one linear solve. In all nine preregistered comparisons across three screens, memory predicted response direction better than the learners it replaced. In U2OS, BioMeme outperformed input-matched ridge, adapted chemCPA and a neural layer in memory’s place, and matched a full-panel network reading reference responses directly (error within 3.4%). Transfer was compound-specific, lowering error by 21.2% against at most 1.8% for wrong compounds, and replicated in reserved MCF7 data. With 20 references, fitting took seconds on one CPU thread, at least 420 times faster than neural tuning and fitting. Adding its prediction to one measured well cut that well’s error by 27–31%. Biological response memory establishes a design principle for virtual cells any laboratory can update, inspect and run.

llm.novelty_zh: 用已测实验构成的响应记忆替代神经网络中的可学习状态-响应层，预测可溯源且更新只需一次线性求解。
llm.summary_zh: 作者提出 BioMeme，在新细胞系中依据较低剂量的已测状态预测下一剂量响应，通过召回响应相似的化合物及参考细胞系中的同一化合物进行预测。在三个筛选数据的九项预注册比较中，记忆方法的响应方向预测优于被替代的学习器；在 U2OS 中其表现与全面板网络相当（误差在 3.4% 以内），拟合速度比神经调参快至少 420 倍。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为虚拟细胞提供可引用、可检查、易更新的预测范式，计算成本低，便于实验室直接复现。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及该方法在更多细胞类型或化合物类别上的适用边界。

title: Disentangled generative modeling of single-cell perturbation responses across dynamic cellular states
abstract: Single-cell perturbation studies are increasingly conducted across complex, multi-condition biological systems, offering a powerful lens into how interventions reshape cell states and molecular programs. However, standard computational models compress single-cell profiles into unified representations where treatment effects are obscured by cell division, lineage progression, donor variation, and cellular stress. Here, we present Disentangled Variational Inference for Perturbation Response (PertVI), a deep generative model that separates baseline mitotic phase, cellular state, and batch effects from treatment-induced shifts while isolating aberrant off-manifold responses in orthogonal anomaly space. This structured design tackles two inter-twined tasks: (1) quantifying treatment-induced changes in cell-state composition, and (2) inferring state-gated transcriptional changes in response to treatment. Across simulated bench-marks, PertVI accurately disentangles coupled biological axes and recovers weak treatment signatures. In conditional chemical and genetic screens of primary human CD8+ and CD4+ T cells, PertVI separates memory-precursor adjuvants from toxic phenocopies, resolves co-clus-tered regulators into directional kinetic trajectories and biphasic rebounders obscured by standard workflows, and reveals that treatment-induced phenotypic shifting is decoupled from broad transcriptional perturbation responses and instead governed by state-specific impulses. Altogether, PertVI brings unique mechanistic granularity to single-cell perturbation response modeling, serving as a proof of principle for biology-informed, structure-guided variance disentan-glement in dynamic cellular systems.

llm.novelty_zh: 在变分推断中显式分离细胞周期、细胞状态、批次与处理效应，并用正交异常空间隔离离流形的异常响应。
llm.summary_zh: 提出PertVI，一种解耦的深度生成模型，把处理引起的状态变化与基线因素分开，并把离流形的异常响应放入正交空间。作者在模拟数据和原代人CD8+/CD4+ T细胞的化学与遗传筛选中展示了其对调控因子轨迹与毒性表型的区分能力。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为扰动响应的机理解读提供了结构化的方差分解思路，有助于区分有益与毒性的表型。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出与其他模型的定量比较，验证主要集中在T细胞系统。

title: Gene-level structure of prior knowledge and perturbation responses informs target-level predictability in prior-informed models
abstract: Background Predictive models of transcriptional responses to unseen genetic perturbations increasingly incorporate biological prior knowledge. However, it remains unclear how well prior knowledge reflects each target’s perturbation-response relationships and how closely prior-derived measures track target-level predictive performance. Here, we develop a gene-similarity framework to quantify agreement among eight sources of biological prior knowledge and between prior knowledge and co-function or co-regulation relationships derived from six Perturb-seq datasets. Results In genome-wide and essential-gene screens, prior agreement accounted for 30–47% of the variance in co-function agreement and 35–43% in co-regulation agreement. Agreement with Perturb-seq responses was higher for essential genes, lower for transcription factor and signaling genes, and varied with gene expression characteristics and cellular context. We compared prior agreement and prior-derived train–test similarity with measures based on the observed test response in tracking target-level predictive performance. Across three prior-informed models, predictions were more accurate for targets whose observed perturbation-response relationships better matched prior knowledge and that were more similar to training perturbations. Notably, prior agreement and prior-derived train–test similarity, calculated without the test response, tracked relative differences in target-level predictive performance. The strength of these associations varied across models and datasets and, for train–test similarity, across prior sources. Conclusion Our framework reveals gene- and context-level heterogeneity in how biological knowledge aligns with perturbation responses, and provides an a priori basis for assessing relative perturbation predictability before perturbation responses are measured.

llm.novelty_zh: 用基因相似性框架量化八类先验知识与 Perturb-seq 响应的一致性，并用先验派生指标预测目标层面的可预测性。
llm.summary_zh: 研究比较八种生物先验知识与六个 Perturb-seq 数据集中共功能、共调控关系的一致性。先验一致性与先验派生的训练-测试相似度，能够跟踪三个先验模型在目标层面的预测性能差异，且计算时无需测试响应。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为在测量扰动响应之前评估可预测性提供了先验依据，有助于模型选择。
llm.limitations_zh: 关联强度随模型与数据集而变化，训练-测试相似度还依赖先验来源，摘要未给出在更多数据集上的验证。

title: LingoCell interprets gene perturbations through natural language and tissue niches
abstract: Single-cell foundation models are general tools for resolving cell identities and disease states, but struggle to interpret changes in expression magnitude in biological language, to transfer to sparse spatial measurements, and to explain cellular niches. We introduce LingoCell, a foundation model connecting single-cell and spatial transcriptomics. It aligns cell representations with language while keeping gene expression editable, supporting cell annotation, cross-batch integration, description generation, and disease-language readouts of single-gene and combinatorial in silico perturbations. Extended to tissues, it annotates cells without single-cell references, learns identity-conditioned niche embeddings, and performs spatial in silico perturbation by replacing and editing neighbor expression. In lung adenocarcinoma, LingoCell revealed synergistic disease responses to jointly weakening alveolar differentiation programs and strengthening malignant programs. In colorectal cancer, it revealed different programs conveyed by the same fibroblast state to T cells, macrophages, and tumor cells. LingoCell provides a unified framework for prioritizing target combinations and stromal intervention programs.
affiliations: Institute of Medical Science, The University of Tokyo

llm.novelty_zh: 将细胞表征与语言对齐并保持基因表达可编辑，同时支持空间邻域中的基因扰动模拟。
llm.summary_zh: LingoCell是连接单细胞与空间转录组的基础模型，将细胞表征与语言对齐并保持基因表达可编辑，支持细胞注释、批次整合、描述生成以及单基因和组合in silico扰动的疾病语言读出。扩展到组织层面后，它可在无单细胞参考时注释细胞，并通过替换邻近细胞表达进行空间扰动；在肺腺癌和结直肠癌中分别揭示了协同疾病响应和不同的基质到免疫细胞程序。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 将语言接口与可编辑表达结合，为靶点组合优先排序和基质干预提供可解释的假设。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: In situ single-cell CRISPR screens uncover context-dependent rewiring of glioma states and immune recruitment
abstract: In vivo single-cell CRISPR screens can resolve perturbation effects in native tissues, but few combine cell-type-restricted delivery, somatic tumor initiation, and combinatorial perturbation. Here we developed an RCAS-TVA-based single-cell CRISPR screening approach coupling oncogenic transformation with single- or dual-guide perturbation in defined neural progenitors. In glioma, tumor suppressor loss produced distinct genotype-dependent transcriptional states, including an NF1 -loss-associated increase in mesenchymal programs. Introducing a fixed Cdkn2a (ARF) perturbastion altered malignant-cell state composition, immune-cell abundance, and the effects of additional tumor-suppressor perturbations, including increased representation of Pten - and Rb1 -deficient cells, suggestive of the relief of an ARF-dependent genetic barrier. These perturbations converged on transcriptional states resembling pharmacologic p53 activation in human glioblastoma. Across mouse tumors and human glioblastoma models, this response was associated with increased astrocyte-like state representation. These findings establish a framework for single-cell analysis of context-dependent somatic perturbations during tumor initiation in vivo.

llm.novelty_zh: 在体RCAS-TVA单细胞CRISPR筛选，将致癌转化与单或双导向RNA扰动耦合在神经祖细胞中。
llm.summary_zh: 研究建立了RCAS-TVA体内单细胞CRISPR筛选方法，在神经祖细胞中同时进行肿瘤起始与单或双向导RNA扰动。结果显示胶质瘤中不同抑癌基因缺失产生不同的转录状态，Cdkn2a(ARF)扰动改变了恶性细胞状态组成与免疫细胞丰度，相关转录态与人源胶质母细胞瘤中药理学p53激活相似。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为体内肿瘤起始阶段的体细胞扰动分析提供实验框架，但其主体为湿实验，与虚拟细胞建模的直接关联较弱。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: Sequence context and partner availability specify divergent cell fates from a single transcription factor
abstract: ⁺CD45⁺ state using separate enhancers for each; TFAP2C abolished adipogenic conversion. Motif density and partner composites therefore assemble a factor's instructive output in the receiving cell.

llm.summary_zh: 摘要文本被截断，仅保留片段。片段提到以独立增强子形成 CD45 阳性状态，以及 TFAP2C 可消除脂肪细胞转化。作者总结认为基序密度与伙伴复合体共同决定受体细胞的指令性输出。
