No single method performed best across all settings: performance depended on the task, spatial resolution, and tissue characteristics, and strong pairwise alignment did not necessarily translate into reliable three-dimensional reconstruction. Evaluation metrics captured complementary aspects of alignment quality, highlighting the importance of using multiple criteria for comprehensive assessment. These findings provide practical guidance for method selection and identify priorities for improving the accuracy, scalability, and accessibility of spatial omics alignment.
affiliations: Department of Biostatistics, Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, Baltimore, MD, USA

datasets_used: experimental spatial transcriptomics datasets (unnamed in abstract)
simulated spatial transcriptomics datasets with known coordinates
llm.novelty_zh: 系统比较15种空间组学切片对齐与配准算法，并引入带已知坐标的模拟数据来直接评估几何精度，新意主要在评测设计而非新方法。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作对15种组织切片对齐与配准算法进行了系统基准评测，覆盖成对对齐、三维重建、跨分辨率对齐和图谱配准四类任务，使用真实与模拟空间转录组数据。评估指标包括空间域与细胞类型对应、空间基因表达相似性、计算可扩展性及易用性。结论显示不存在通吃的最优方法，且成对对齐效果好并不等于三维重建可靠。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 三维空间组学图谱构建依赖切片对齐，该基准为方法选择提供了实用指导，并指出多指标评估的必要性。对虚拟细胞工作而言，它属于空间数据预处理层面的间接相关工作。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未说明模拟数据的具体构建方式、数据集规模及各算法的具体排名结果，也未提及是否公开基准代码与数据。

title: Cell-type label errors inflate neighborhood effects and can reverse niche claims in spatial transcriptomics
abstract: Niche analyses ask how a cell's neighbors shape its expression beyond its type. The type comes from a label, and labels are imperfect. Here we show that label errors inflate neighborhood effects and can reverse niche claims. A mislabeled cell still expresses its true type, and because cells of a type sit near one another, the neighborhood is credited with what the label misses. Standard practice, which calls labels on the modeled counts and selects cells by them, hid, exaggerated, or reversed this inflation. Labeling one half of each cell's counts and modeling the other revealed it in nearly every population of six datasets. On semi-synthetic colon data, a labeler that over-called one fibroblast subtype reversed claims of the niche method Niche-DE; new draws of the counts and errors spread at random over subtypes almost never did. Our software, nichepeek, reports the direction of this bias in a user's data.

datasets_used: six spatial transcriptomics datasets (unnamed in abstract)
llm.novelty_zh: 首次系统指出细胞类型标签误差会在空间转录组邻域（niche）分析中系统性放大邻域效应，并可能反转结论；提出用一半计数打标签、另一半建模的诊断方法及配套软件 nichepeek。
llm.summary_zh: 该研究指出空间转录组 niche 分析中，细胞类型标签误差会因同类细胞空间聚集而被错误归因于邻域效应，从而夸大甚至逆转 niche 结论。作者通过将计数拆分为标签与建模两部分进行诊断，并在六个数据集及半合成结肠数据上验证该偏差，同时发布了用于估计偏差方向的软件 nichepeek。该工作聚焦空间组学分析的方法学偏差，与虚拟细胞、扰动建模的核心主题关系较弱。

title: ELLA-mix: Detecting Cell-to-Cell Heterogeneity in Subcellular RNA Localization
abstract: Subcellular RNA localization can differ between cells expressing the same gene, yet most analyses summarize transcript positions with a single gene-level pattern. We propose ELLA-mix, a finite mixture model for identifying cell subpopulations with distinct radial localization patterns from imaging-based spatial transcriptomics data. Transcript positions are normalized relative to the cell boundary and modeled using flexible spline densities within a count-conditioned nonhomogeneous Poisson process framework. Conditioning on each cell's transcript count separates differences in localization from differences in abundance. We estimate component densities and cell memberships using an expectation-maximization algorithm and select the number of patterns using the Bayesian information criterion, restricting consideration to models with stable cell assignments and sufficiently distinct components. Simulation studies evaluated the type I error and power of the test for nonuniform localization, as well as the accuracy of selecting the number of mixture components and estimating their radial distributions. ELLA-mix correctly selected the number of components in most simulated settings. In seqFISH+ mouse fibroblasts, ELLA-mix identified distinct cell subpopulations for genes previously assigned a single localization class; genes showing such variation were enriched for endoplasmic reticulum and extracellular matrix functions. In Xenium ovarian cancer tissue, more peripheral localization patterns were associated with higher proportions of proliferating cells, particularly in S phase. These results show how modeling cell-to-cell variation can reveal localization patterns and biological associations obscured by gene-level summaries.

llm.novelty_zh: 将细胞间RNA亚细胞定位差异用有限混合模型刻画，并在给定转录本计数的条件下用非齐次泊松过程区分定位与丰度差异，以发现定位模式不同的细胞亚群。
llm.summary_zh: 该文提出ELLA-mix，一种有限混合模型，用于从基于成像的空间转录组数据中识别具有不同径向定位模式的细胞亚群，并以细胞计数条件化的非齐次泊松过程和样条密度建模转录本位置。在seqFISH+小鼠成纤维细胞和Xenium卵巢癌组织中，该方法发现了按基因汇总时被掩盖的细胞间定位异质性。该工作属于空间转录组统计分析方法，与虚拟细胞或扰动建模主题仅间接相关。

title: Differential gene expression profiling of lumbar disc degeneration in the RuDDS cohort
abstract: Lumbar disc degeneration disease (LDDD) is a major structural cause of low back pain, one of the leading causes of disability worldwide, and has no disease-modifying treatment. We performed RNA sequencing of 72 intraoperative intervertebral disc samples from the Russian disc degeneration study (RuDDS) cohort, comparing severe (Pfirrmann grades IV-V) with moderate (grade III) degeneration. We identified 731 differentially expressed genes (DEGs; 347 upregulated and 384 downregulated in severely degenerated discs) in the 57 samples that passed quality control. Upregulated DEGs were enriched for extracellular matrix organisation, ossification, and TGF-beta; and Hippo signalling, whereas downregulated DEGs were enriched for immune and inflammatory processes. We identified five differentially active transcription factors, including the TGF-beta; effectors SMAD3 and SMAD4 and the osteogenic regulator DLX5. Of the five, only DLX5 was also a DEG. DEGs were enriched for LDDD-associated genes from Open Targets (odds ratio = 1.68, P = 3.37 * 10-6). Connectivity mapping against the LINCS L1000 database showed that histone deacetylase inhibitors and glucocorticoids reverse the signature of severe degeneration. Together, these results point to TGF-beta-driven fibrotic and osteogenic remodelling as the dominant transcriptional feature of severe disc degeneration, and prioritise candidate genes and compounds for functional validation.
affiliations: Institute of Cytology and Genetics, Siberian Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences
Siberian Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences
Central Scientific Research Institute of Traumatology and Orthopedics
Novosibirsk Scientific Research Institute of Traumatology and Orthopedics. Ya.L. Tsivyan

llm.novelty_zh: 首次对RuDDS队列中72份腰椎间盘样本做RNA-seq，比较重度与中度退变的差异基因，并通过LINCS L1000连通性图谱提出可逆转重度退变特征的化合物（HDAC抑制剂、糖皮质激素）。
llm.summary_zh: 该研究对RuDDS队列的72份术中腰椎间盘样本进行RNA测序，比较Pfirrmann IV-V级与III级退变，识别出731个差异表达基因，上调基因富集于细胞外基质重塑与TGF-beta、Hippo通路，下调基因富集于免疫炎症过程。作者还利用LINCS L1000连通性分析提示HDAC抑制剂和糖皮质激素可逆转重度退变特征，并以此筛选候选基因与化合物。该工作属于疾病转录组学分析，与虚拟细胞或扰动建模核心方向关系较弱，仅在化合物反向签名部分与药物发现相关。

title: SYNDRI: Context-aware removal of transcript spillover in imaging-based spatial transcriptomics
abstract: Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures gene expression at single-cell resolution, but imperfect segmentation often misassigns transcripts between neighboring cells, a problem known as transcript spillover. This spillover is niche-dependent and can therefore confound downstream analyses that rely on niche-specific differential expression. True spillover cannot be directly quantified in experimental ST data, so existing correction methods infer contamination indirectly from transcript positions or expression structure. Here we introduce SYNDRI, a post-segmentation correction method that frames spillover detection as a supervised, gene-level classification task. We develop SYNDRI-SIM to generate labeled training data by simulating spillover between spatially mapped scRNA-seq profiles. SYNDRI uses a transformer to predict gene-level spillover probabilities conditioned on each cell's expression, identity, and local neighborhood, without requiring transcript-level coordinates or deconvolution. On held-out simulated data, SYNDRI achieves an AUPRC of 0.86, compared with 0.64 for the next-best method. Across MERFISH, CosMx, and Xenium datasets, SYNDRI achieves the highest aggregate performance across metrics of cell-type separation, reference similarity, and preservation of within-cell-type heterogeneity. In a CosMx lung cancer dataset, SYNDRI removes nearly all potentially contaminating tumor and macrophage markers from differential expression between tumor-associated and stromal fibroblasts while retaining native fibroblast markers. These results demonstrate the utility of learning from simulated spillover to improve the interpretation of spatial gene expression.

llm.novelty_zh: 将成像空间转录组的转录本溢出校正转化为基于模拟数据训练的监督式基因级分类任务，并用 transformer 结合邻域信息预测溢出概率。
llm.summary_zh: 该文针对成像式空间转录组中分割误差导致的转录本溢出问题，提出后分割校正方法 SYNDRI，并配套 SYNDRI-SIM 在空间定位的 scRNA-seq 图谱之间模拟溢出以生成带标签训练数据。在 MERFISH、CosMx 和 Xenium 数据上，SYNDRI 的综合表现优于现有方法，并能在 CosMx 肺癌数据中去除差异表达中的污染标记基因。该工作属于空间转录组数据预处理，与虚拟细胞、扰动建模或细胞基础模型的主题关联较弱。

title: Do single-cell foundation models need 512 dimensions for one number?
abstract: Single-cell foundation models represent counts through high-dimensional value embeddings or ranked feature tokens. We asked how many dimensions counts need and what network computes. In a controlled Transformer, a four-dimensional value track separated from a wide gene-identity backbone retains nearly all masked-prediction net gain; a straight line replaces pretrained value curves with little transfer loss. Across evaluated cohorts, clamping detected-gene values retains most gain in annotation, surface-protein prediction and perturbation-shift consistency, consistent with the prevalence of single-molecule counts. A two-feature encoder combining tie-free rank and within-cell standardized magnitude improves controlled retraining and preserves annotation when grafted onto pretrained scGPT. Gene offsets and three linear cell-level scalars approximate masked prediction and predict responses to count thinning; depth leads in the controlled model, while cell type leads in scGPT. Matched controls show that attribution, attention, dictionary and probe readouts can reflect depth, gene frequency, hub degree or directions that transfer little output.

llm.novelty_zh: 首次系统检验单细胞基础模型中计数值嵌入是否需要高维表示，提出四维值通道与结合 rank 和细胞内标准化幅度的双特征编码器，并用匹配对照揭示归因与注意力等解释工具可能反映深度或基因频次而非真实输出。
llm.summary_zh: 该研究在受控 Transformer 中把计数值表示压缩到四维值通道并与宽基因身份主干分离，发现其仍保留几乎全部掩码预测收益；直线替代预训练值曲线的迁移损失也很小。作者还提出结合 rank 与细胞内标准化幅度的双特征编码器，并在 scGPT 上嫁接验证，同时用匹配对照质疑归因、注意力、字典和探针等解释性读出的可靠性。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作直接质疑单细胞基础模型中数值编码的必要性，并给出受控实验，对理解 scGPT 类模型的内部机制有参考价值。其关于解释性工具可能反映深度或基因频次假象的警示，也对该领域的模型诊断方法具有提醒意义。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出具体数据集名称、规模和基线的量化对比，跨队列结论的普适性与扰动任务上的提升幅度难以从摘要判断。

title: A noise-corrected metric for evaluating spatial transcriptomics predicted from histology
abstract: Deep learning methods that predict spatial transcriptomics from histology offer scalable molecular profiling of clinical cohorts. However, conventional correlation metrics overstate prediction quality across whole sections by crediting models for recognizing broad tissue regions, and understate fine-scale prediction quality because sampling noise dominates sparse RNA counts. To resolve this, we introduce the reproducible-signal correlation (RSC) metric. RSC randomly splits RNA counts into two halves to separate reproducible signal from sampling noise across spatial scales and within tissue regions or cell classes. Across 12 spot-level and three single-cell methods, RSC revealed that most models capture broad tissue patterns but largely miss differences between neighboring spots or cells, which whole-section correlation overlooks. Within malignant cells, RSC distinguished methods that genuinely capture part of the cell-to-cell heterogeneity from those whose scores across all cells were inflated by cell-type composition. Guided by RSC, we designed a pairwise difference loss between neighboring spots that improved fine-scale predictions on average across 11 models. RSC thus provides a foundation for benchmarking predictions, guiding model design and determining which spatial analyses histology can support.
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

llm.novelty_zh: 提出 reproducible-signal correlation（RSC）指标，通过随机二分 RNA 计数来区分可复现信号与采样噪声，从而在不同空间尺度和细胞类别内评估组织学预测空间转录组的精细尺度质量，并据此设计了相邻 spot 间的成对差异损失。
llm.summary_zh: 该文指出从组织学图像预测空间转录组的常用相关性指标会因识别大范围组织区域而高估整体预测质量，同时因稀疏计数的采样噪声而低估精细尺度预测质量。作者提出 RSC 指标，并在 12 种 spot 级和 3 种单细胞方法上评测，发现多数模型只捕捉宽泛组织模式，难以区分相邻 spot 或细胞的差异。基于 RSC 设计的相邻 spot 成对差异损失在 11 个模型上平均改善了精细尺度预测。该工作属于空间转录组预测的评测方法学，与虚拟细胞的核心主题只有间接关系。

title: Niche-FATE: niche-aware inference of cell-state transitions from spatiotemporal data
abstract: Cell-state transitions depend on intrinsic transcriptional programmes and local signals. Existing spatiotemporal mapping methods largely match cells by expression or position, not by received signals. Here we introduce Niche-FATE, an optimal transport framework integrating gene expression, spatial neighbourhoods and inferred ligand-receptor signalling to estimate transition probabilities and prioritise fate-associated signals. In simulations with changing tissue organisation, Niche-FATE improved fate inference and recovery of known fate-determining signals (mean AUPRC of 0.46 versus 0.29 for the best-performing alternative). In digit tip regeneration, Niche-FATE reduced inconsistent regenerative-to-scar transition assignments from 28% without niche information to 7%. Niche-FATE also improved developmental transition inference in mouse organogenesis. In two mouse models of Alzheimer's disease, Niche-FATE linked predicted microglial transitions to local signalling, recovered amyloid plaque associations without plaque-location input and predicted transitions from disease-associated towards homeostatic-like states. Niche-FATE enables researchers to resolve divergent cellular outcomes and investigate their associated signalling environments.
affiliations: Danish Research Institute of Translational Neuroscience (DANDRITE), Nordic EMBL Partnership for Molecular Medicine, Aarhus University, Aarhus, Denmark

llm.novelty_zh: 将空间邻域与推断的配体-受体信号整合进最优传输框架，用接收到的信号而非仅表达或位置来匹配细胞并估计命运转移概率。
llm.summary_zh: 本文提出 Niche-FATE，一个结合基因表达、空间邻域和推断配体-受体信号的最优传输框架，用于估计细胞状态转移概率并排序与命运相关的信号。在模拟、指间断端再生、小鼠器官发生以及两种阿尔茨海默病小鼠模型中，该方法均优于不含生态位信息的基线。该工作属于细胞命运推断与空间时序建模，与虚拟细胞的动态建模相关，但不直接涉及扰动预测。

title: Functional cooperation, adaptation and synchronization of subcellular processes in cellular neighborhoods as inferred from spatial transcriptomics
abstract: Tissue-level functions emerge from pathway activities distributed across neighboring cells. Yet analyses of spatial transcriptomics mostly focus on cell type composition or signaling through ligand-receptor pairs, leaving spatial relationships between effector processes undescribed. We inferred networks of functionally interacting subcellular processes (SCPs) that are independent of shared gene products and lie beyond sibling relationships defined in parent-child hierarchies. Using those networks for the analysis of published spatial transcriptomics datasets from human kidney biopsies, we identified functionally related SCP activities between a tissue spot and its neighbors. Identified pairs of adjacent SCPs indicate functional cooperation, e.g. basement membrane assembly and cell-matrix adhesion, functional adaption, e.g. complement synthesis and inhibition, and functional synchronization, e.g. folate cycle and cobalamin metabolism or pre-mRNA splicing and nuclear mRNA export. Two independent null models, shuffling of SCP labels within the network and shuffling of spots on the tissue slice, distinguish pairs that are functionally non-random and pairs that are additionally enriched within the immediate neighborhood, separating local from tissue-wide coordination. Our results suggest that tissue physiology reflects not only cell type composition but also functional coordination between neighboring regions.
affiliations: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai

datasets_used: published spatial transcriptomics datasets from human kidney biopsies (names not given in abstract)
llm.novelty_zh: 用基于通路/亚细胞过程（SCP）的功能相互作用网络分析空间转录组，并以两种零模型区分组织内局部与全局的功能协同，而非传统的细胞类型组成或配体-受体通讯。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作从空间转录组数据中推断亚细胞过程（SCP）之间的功能相互作用网络，并将其应用于人类肾活检的已发表数据集，识别相邻组织斑点之间的功能协作、适应与同步关系。通过两种独立零模型（SCP 标签打乱与组织切片斑点打乱）区分功能非随机的过程对与在邻域内额外富集的过程对。该研究聚焦组织生理的空间功能协调，与虚拟细胞或扰动建模主题关系较弱。

title: Distance-stratified benchmarking of variant-effect predictors on β-lactamase deep mutational scanning data
abstract: Mutations far from the active site of antibiotic-resistance enzymes can change resistance, but it is unclear what information predicts their effects. We asked how the performance of a protein language model (ESM2), a structure-based stability predictor (ThermoMPNN) and simple structural descriptors changes with distance from the catalytic residues, using deep mutational scanning data for the {beta}-lactamases TEM-1 (four assays) and VIM-2 (one assay). We measured Spearman correlation and AUROC within distance bins, with bootstrap intervals over positions. In TEM-1, ESM2 accuracy fell with distance (Stiffler assay: {rho} = 0.72 below 8 [A] and 0.42 beyond 20 [A]), while the stability score rose ({rho} = 0.41 to 0.70). Adding stability to a model of ESM2, solvent accessibility and neighbour count improved cross-validated {rho} by 0.02 below 8 [A] and 0.10 beyond 20 [A], and the combined model did not decline with distance. The pattern held across binning schemes, in a continuous-distance model, and when any one of five contiguous distal stretches was removed. Two TEM-1 assays are nearly duplicates, and the Deng assay was too noisy to be informative. VIM-2 has only seven positions beyond 20 [A] and showed no detectable trend within 20 [A], so it neither supports nor contradicts the TEM-1 pattern. Nine distal TEM-1 positions remained more sensitive than the models predicted. In TEM-1, predicted stability was more informative than the language model far from the catalytic site, and the language model was stronger near it. Distance-stratified reporting could add to variant-effect benchmarks. The study is exploratory and uses one structure and one phenotype per assay.

llm.novelty_zh: 首次按与催化位点的距离分层评估蛋白语言模型（ESM2）与结构稳定性预测器（ThermoMPNN）在β-内酰胺酶DMS数据上的表现，提出距离分层报告的基准做法。
llm.summary_zh: 该研究以TEM-1（四个测定）和VIM-2（一个测定）的深度突变扫描数据为对象，考察ESM2、ThermoMPNN稳定性评分及简单结构描述符的变异效应预测性能如何随与催化残基距离变化。结果显示，在TEM-1中ESM2远端预测能力下降，而稳定性评分远端表现上升；二者结合的模型在远端提升明显且不随距离衰减。研究为探索性工作，每个测定仅使用一个结构和一种表型。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作指出变异效应预测器的整体指标可能掩盖距离相关的差异，提出距离分层报告可作为蛋白变异基准的补充。对理解远端突变影响抗性的机制及蛋白模型的适用范围有参考价值。
llm.limitations_zh: 研究仅基于一个结构和每个测定一种表型的探索性分析，VIM-2远端位点很少，且两个TEM-1测定高度相似，结论的普适性有限。

title: A method to disentangle enhancer-gene interactions from latent factors in single-cell multi-omics data
abstract: Mapping regulatory elements to their target genes in the cell types relevant to disease is essential for interpreting non-coding variants identified by genome-wide association studies. Single-cell multiome data, which simultaneously measure accessible chromatin and gene expression per cell, allow such peak-gene links to be inferred within individual cell types. However, shared technical and biological variation across genes and peaks, such as cell cycle, cell quality, and inter-sample differences, creates spurious links, while including sample covariates to control for this variation inadvertently removes true genotype-driven links. To address this trade-off, we developed CREMAP (Covariance-of-Residuals-based Enhancer-gene Mapping), a statistical method that estimates shared variation as latent factors from the data and adjusts for them before testing each peak-gene pair. Using CRISPRi perturbation experiments and fine-mapped eQTLs as validation benchmarks, we demonstrate that CREMAP improves the accuracy of inferred peak-gene links compared with existing methods across two cell lines and 13 cell types from human bone marrow, brain, and kidney. In kidney proximal tubule cells, CREMAP retains eQTL-supported and allele-specific links that standard approaches miss when samples are included as covariates. Furthermore, its latent factors capture previously unrecognized global signatures, including a tubular injury program. CREMAP thus enables accurate cell-type-specific peak-gene mapping from single-cell multiome data while preserving genuine genetic regulatory effects.
affiliations: Boston Children's Hospital & Harvard Medical School
Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology

datasets_used: single-cell multiome data (human bone marrow, brain, kidney)
llm.novelty_zh: 通过从数据中估计共享技术/生物学变异的潜在因子并在检验每个 peak-gene 对之前进行校正，避免了直接加入样本协变量时误删真实基因型驱动链接的问题。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作提出 CREMAP，用于在单细胞多组学（single-cell multiome）数据中推断细胞类型特异的增强子-基因连接。方法通过残差协方差估计潜在因子并校正后再检验每个 peak-gene 对，在 CRISPRi 与 fine-mapped eQTL 基准上优于现有方法。该工作属于基因调控/非编码变异解释范畴，与虚拟细胞仅间接相关。

title: ChronoClone links temporal clonal behavior to lineage output and mutation responses
abstract: Distinct stem cell clones can yield similar lineage outputs via different developmental trajectories or dynamics and respond differently to perturbation. Here, we introduce ChronoClone, an unsupervised method that groups single-cell clones by time-resolved cell-state composition into metaclones. Benchmarked against simulated ground-truth scenarios, ChronoClone demonstrates high noise tolerance compared to existing methods. Applied to an adult mouse hematopoietic lineage-tracing dataset, ChronoClone showed that clones producing the same lineage mature at different speeds, a difference the original study did not examine. Furthermore, using WT metaclones as a baseline reference for Dnmt3a- and Npm1c-mutant sister-clones, ChronoClone uncovered hidden, clone-specific mutation responses including slowed maturation and lineage composition shifts. By connecting temporal dynamics, perturbation responses, and ancestral molecular states, ChronoClone adds temporal cell-state dynamics into clonal analysis.

llm.novelty_zh: 将时间分辨的细胞状态组成用于无监督地将单细胞克隆聚类为 metaclone，并以 WT metaclone 为参照揭示 Dnmt3a、Npm1c 突变姐妹克隆的克隆特异性响应（成熟变慢、谱系组成改变）。
llm.summary_zh: ChronoClone 是一种无监督方法，依据时间分辨的细胞状态组成把单细胞克隆分组为 metaclone，在模拟数据上表现出较高的噪声耐受性。将其应用于成年小鼠造血谱系示踪数据时，发现产生相同谱系的克隆成熟速度不同，并揭示了 Dnmt3a 与 Npm1c 突变克隆的克隆特异性响应。该工作侧重于造血干细胞克隆动力学分析，与虚拟细胞或扰动响应预测的建模目标只有间接关系。

title: XenoType: Decoding cellular identity in breast cancer histology through molecular supervision
abstract: Characterizing the cellular composition of the tumor microenvironment from histological images is fundamental to understanding cancer biology and informing treatment decisions. Deep learning has enabled automated nuclear detection and classification from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images, yet cell classifiers remain largely confined to broad morphological categories owing to a reliance on manual annotations. Recent efforts have used spatial molecular measurements to supervise histological classification, but these approaches often require separate tissue sections or produce altered H&E staining, and the resulting cell-type annotations depend on subjective choices such as marker selection and clustering parameters. Here we develop XenoType, a framework that classifies cells into seven molecularly informed categories directly from routine histology, trained using paired same-section Xenium spatial transcriptomics. Cell-type annotations are reconciled from four single-cell RNA-sequencing references, reducing dependence on marker choices. Across eight held-out breast tissue sections, XenoType outperformed commonly used CellViT++ retrained on the same molecular annotations under both four-class (macro-F1: 0.703 vs. 0.569) and seven-class (macro-F1: 0.571 vs. 0.403) taxonomies, with the largest gains for myoepithelial (F1: 0.175 to 0.572) and endothelial cells (F1: 0.395 to 0.682). Molecular measurements are required only during training; at inference, XenoType uses the H&E image alone. Model-reference agreement increased consistently with annotation confidence, and XenoType generalized to an independently profiled breast tissue section from a different spatial transcriptomics platform, supporting scalable cell-type mapping from routine histology without per-specimen molecular profiling.

datasets_used: single-cell RNA-sequencing references (four, unnamed in abstract)
llm.novelty_zh: 利用同切片配对的 Xenium 空间转录组数据作为分子监督，训练只需 H&E 图像即可推断七类细胞身份的模型，并用多份 scRNA-seq 参考对注释进行共识化以减少标记基因选择的主观性。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作提出 XenoType，利用同一切片的 Xenium 空间转录组作为训练监督，从常规 H&E 图像中将细胞分为七个分子定义的类别，推理时仅需图像。在八个乳腺组织切片上，其宏 F1 显著优于在相同分子注释上重训的 CellViT++，并能泛化到另一平台的独立切片。由于研究对象是组织学图像上的细胞类型映射，与虚拟细胞主题只有间接关系，故归为非核心、非外围圈。

title: scOnion: Cross-Modal Concordance-Aware Joint Analysis of Cells and Features in Single-Cell Multiomic Data
abstract: Single-cell multiomic assays jointly profile gene expression and chromatin accessibility in the same cells, enabling direct analysis of cross-layer coordination. However, agreement between modalities varies across cells, and existing integration methods often emphasize shared structure, potentially averaging away cell-specific cross-modal discordance that carries biological signal. Here we present scOnion, a concordance-aware computational framework that quantifies cross-modality agreement and propagates this information into downstream analyses. Starting from paired low-rank representations obtained by spectral integration, scOnion computes per-cell concordance scores, a concordance-aware joint cell embedding, and an induced cross-modal feature embedding. The cell embedding preserves structure strongly represented in either modality, improving cell-type and state resolution, while the feature embedding scores candidate regulatory element(rE)-to-gene (rE2G) pairs. Across immune, neural, and developmental functional genomic datasets, scOnion's concordance patterns are reproducible and cell-resolved, with low-concordance cells enriched for modality-specific structure. scOnion also prioritizes candidate rE2G pairs, including distal links, with stronger support from external Hi-C contacts and fine-mapped eQTL data than the baseline linkage methods. In a B-cell fate bifurcation study, scOnion reveals remodeling of concordance and rE2G coupling during lineage commitment. scOnion embeds ~70,000 cells and computes rE2G links on CPU in 30 minutes, extends naturally to other multiomic assays such as CITE-seq, and is available as open-source software.

llm.novelty_zh: 在谱整合得到的低秩表示上引入逐细胞跨模态一致性（concordance）评分，并用其修正联合细胞嵌入与特征嵌入，从而同时用于细胞分辨率提升和rE2G增强子-基因配对打分。
llm.summary_zh: scOnion 是一个面向单细胞多组学（RNA+ATAC、CITE-seq 等）的一致性感知分析框架，量化每个细胞两种模态之间的一致程度，并将其传递到联合细胞嵌入和跨模态特征嵌入中。摘要报告其在rE2G配对预测上优于基线连锁方法（借助 Hi-C 与 fine-mapped eQTL 验证），并在 B 细胞命运分叉研究中揭示一致性与调控耦合的变化。该工作属于单细胞多组学整合与调控推断方法，与虚拟细胞主题只有间接关联。

title: GASTON-VI efficiently quantifies spatial axes and molecular gradients from multi-sample, multi-modal spatial-omics data
abstract: Many tissues exhibit an underlying spatial axis along which fundamental biological processes occur due to continuous spatial gradients of cell type and molecular state. Modern spatial-omics technologies measure molecular features (e.g. gene/protein expression) at 100,000s-1,000,000s of locations within a two-dimensional (2-D) tissue slice, with large-scale atlases profiling multiple tissue slices of the same organ type across different individuals and biological conditions (e.g. healthy versus diseased). However, existing computational methods for identifying spatial molecular gradients are limited to small spatial transcriptomics datasets (1000s of cells) of a single tissue slice, while methods for integrating multiple samples do not explicitly model spatial axes nor spatial molecular gradients along such axes. Here, we present GASTON-VI, a variational inference (VI)-based deep learning model which efficiently learns an underlying spatial axis and spatial molecular gradients along this axis from multi-sample, multi-condition spatial-omics data of any molecular modality (e.g. transcriptomics, proteomics). GASTON-VI jointly learns (1) a spatial coordinate (the "isodepth") for each individual tissue slice and (2) 1-D spatial modality functions that describe molecular gradients along the isodepth for tissues of the same biological condition, while utilizing a latent variable model to account for batch effects. Further, GASTON-VI implements a statistical test for identifying molecules with differential spatial gradients across biological conditions (e.g. healthy versus diseased). On spatial transcriptomics and proteomics data from the intestine, tonsil, and liver, we show that GASTON-VI recovers spatial axes and molecular gradients along these axes more accurately and efficiently than existing methods. In particular, applied to large-scale spatial transcriptomics and proteomics atlases, GASTON-VI reveals differential spatial gradients of gene expression along the portal vein-central vein axis in fibrotic livers, and differential spatial gradients of protein abundance along the muscularis-lumen axis across different regions of the intestine. Software availability: GASTON-VI is available at https://github.com/chitra-lab/GASTON-VI.

llm.novelty_zh: 用变分推断深度模型同时学习每张组织切片的共享空间轴（isodepth）和沿该轴的一维分子梯度，并兼容多样本、多条件及批次效应，还提供跨条件差异空间梯度的统计检验。
llm.summary_zh: GASTON-VI 是一种基于变分推断的深度学习方法，可从多样本、多条件、多模态（转录组与蛋白组）空间组学数据中学习组织的空间轴（isodepth）及沿该轴的分子梯度，并用隐变量模型校正批次效应。论文在肠道、扁桃体和肝脏数据上表明其在空间轴与梯度恢复上优于现有方法，并在纤维化肝脏和肠道中揭示了差异空间梯度。该工作聚焦组织空间结构分析，与虚拟细胞或扰动建模的关系较间接。

title: A spatiotemporal perturbational atlas of the post-pneumonectomy lung
abstract: Perturbational spatial atlases have begun to map regenerative dynamics in a variety of tissues, yet lung remodeling has not been characterized at comparable spatial and temporal resolution. Post-pneumonectomy lung regeneration (PPLR) provides a tractable mammalian model for tissue regeneration that can be studied in situ. Here, we present a spatiotemporal perturbational atlas of PPLR in Rattus norvegicus, combining single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNAseq), high-resolution spatial transcriptomics (10x Genomics Xenium), and NICHES-based spatial tissue connectomics. We observe three distinct tissue architectures at successive timepoints after pneumonectomy, each characterized by coordinated shifts in local cellular composition and intercellular signaling. At Day 3 (D3), a line of interstitial macrophages colocalizes directly beneath an intact mesothelium among active mechanotransductive and inflammatory signaling. We also observe the unexpected appearance of a transitional remodeling cellular community at D7 which appears largely absent at later timepoints, marked by fibrosis- mimetic signaling. At D14, an alveologenic architecture at distal lung tissue displays a connectivity signature consistent with active de novo growth, distinct from baseline homeostasis. Our findings establish a spatiotemporal map of multicellular architecture during regenerative lung remodeling and introduce a generalizable framework for spatial connectomic analysis to be used in perturbational tissue systems biology.

llm.novelty_zh: 在大鼠全肺切除后再生模型中，结合scRNAseq、Xenium空间转录组与NICHES空间连接组，构建了时间与空间双维度的扰动组织图谱，并提出可推广的空间细胞连接组分析框架。
llm.summary_zh: 该研究以大鼠全肺切除（pneumonectomy）为组织级扰动，结合单细胞测序、Xenium高分辨率空间转录组和NICHES空间组织连接组，描绘了术后D3、D7、D14三个时间点的肺再生多细胞结构变化。文中报告了间质巨噬细胞、D7短暂出现的纤维化样信号社区以及D14的肺泡新生结构等发现。该工作属于组织再生生物学的实验图谱，与虚拟细胞的扰动建模关系较间接，故归为外围圈。

title: Sustained LDL-C Lowering Reveals Selective Expansion of Fibroblast Subpopulations with Distinct Regulatory and Matrix Programs During Atherosclerosis Remodeling
abstract: Background: Smooth muscle cells (SMCs) and SMC-derived cells contribute to atherosclerotic plaque stability through matrix production and fibrous cap formation. Recent studies have also identified distinct fibroblast populations in atherosclerotic lesions, but how these populations respond to sustained LDL-C lowering and contribute to plaque remodeling remains poorly understood. Methods: We combined serial histological assessment, SMC lineage tracing, and single-cell RNA sequencing to examine vascular stromal cell and lesion structural responses during 20 weeks of sustained LDL-C lowering in mice with established atherosclerosis. Regulatory network analysis and computational perturbation predictions were supported by KLF3 and FOXD1 silencing in cultured mouse and human aortic fibroblasts. Results: LDL-C lowering led to rapid reductions in macrophage content and cleaved gasdermin D, followed by decreased necrotic core area and increased collagen content and fibrous cap thickness, with minimal change in lesion area. During this remodeling, SMC-derived cell populations changed little. In striking contrast, CD26⁺ and FMOD⁺ fibroblast subtypes increased by 5 weeks and remained elevated through 20 weeks, with increased fibroblast-associated signals in the intima and fibrous cap. These populations showed distinct matrix programs, with ECM glycoprotein and regulatory programs enriched in CD26⁺ fibroblasts and collagen and proteoglycan programs in FMOD⁺ fibroblasts. Regulatory network analysis identified KLF3 and FOXD1 as candidate master regulators of CD26⁺ and FMOD⁺ fibroblasts, respectively. Silencing either factor reduced selected matrix-associated and proliferation transcripts and impaired scratch closure in mouse and human aortic fibroblasts, while KLF3 silencing also increased selected inflammatory genes. Exploratory human genetic analyses identified associations of KLF3-region and FOXD1 variation with coronary artery disease. Conclusions: These findings reveal fibroblast subtype-specific responses during sustained LDL-C lowering and identify KLF3 and FOXD1 as candidate transcriptional regulators of fibroblast matrix-associated and inflammatory functions relevant to plaque remodeling and stabilization.
affiliations: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai

llm.novelty_zh: 提出 KLF3 与 FOXD1 分别是 CD26+ 与 FMOD+ 成纤维细胞的候选主调控因子。
llm.summary_zh: 作者在小鼠持续降低 LDL-C 20 周的模型中，用组织学、谱系追踪与单细胞测序研究血管成纤维细胞亚群变化。在培养的小鼠与人主动脉成纤维细胞中，沉默 KLF3 或 FOXD1 可降低基质相关转录本并抑制划痕闭合，另有探索性遗传关联分析。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了降脂后斑块重塑中成纤维细胞亚型的差异响应，为动脉粥样硬化研究提供了候选调控因子。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要指出遗传关联分析仅为探索性，且未说明结论向人体的外推程度。

title: Engineering dynamic interkingdom communication between synthetic organelles and mammalian systems
abstract: Engineering intracellular microbes to function as synthetic organelles, or quasiorganelles, opens new avenues for controlling mammalian cell fates and function through programmable and quantitative interkingdom communication. Here, we develop a bioluminescent reporter platform to quantify the magnitude, kinetics, persistence, and spatial distribution of transcriptional regulation in mammalian host cells directed by quasiorganelles. Using an attenuated, flavin-auxotrophic Listeria monocytogenes chassis (LINQ1) engineered to deliver synthetic transcription factors, we demonstrate approximately 100-fold activation of mammalian reporter genes, with distinct kinetics and dynamics for the tetracycline transactivator and Gal4 systems. In transgenic reporter mice, LINQ1 induced approximately 25-fold reporter activation across multiple organs, with activity persisting beyond three weeks in some animals. In mice bearing triple-negative breast tumors, LINQ1 activated intratumoral transcription and, incidentally, transiently suppressed tumor growth, although responses diminished with repeated administration. These findings establish a quantitative foundation for engineering interkingdom communication in vivo to advance a new paradigm in which programmable microbial systems function as synthetic organelles to direct mammalian cell fates and function for therapeutic benefit.
affiliations: The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center
Tokyo Metropolitan Institute of Medical Science

llm.novelty_zh: 利用减毒、黄素营养缺陷型 Listeria monocytogenes（LINQ1）作为"合成细胞器"向哺乳动物细胞递送合成转录因子，并以生物发光报告系统在体外、转基因小鼠和三阴性乳腺肿瘤中定量转录激活的幅度、动力学与持续性。
llm.summary_zh: 该研究构建了生物发光报告平台，用于定量细菌类"合成细胞器"（quasiorganelle）在哺乳动物宿主细胞中引导的转录调控。作者使用工程化 Listeria 底盘 LINQ1 递送 tetracycline transactivator 与 Gal4 等合成转录因子，在细胞、转基因小鼠及三阴性乳腺肿瘤模型中观察到约 100 倍（细胞）和约 25 倍（小鼠器官）的报告基因激活。该工作属于合成生物学与跨界通讯工程，与虚拟细胞、扰动建模或细胞基础模型并无直接关联。

title: GNEval: A Context-Specific Benchmark for Gene Network Inference with Single-Cell Foundation Models
abstract: Gene network (GN) inference plays a critical role in understanding gene relationships and their roles in biological functions and diseases. Existing single-cell GN inference methods often rely on limited data from individual studies. Single-cell foundation models, pretrained on large and diverse datasets, provide a range of gene-gene association signals that offer a promising basis for GN inference. However, it remains unclear which GN properties these signals capture and how they compare with domain-specific methods. To address this gap, we introduce GNEval, a unified benchmark for evaluating pretrained model derived gene associations for network inference. We benchmark 21 gene representations and association scores from 11 models, including static gene embeddings (S), contextual embeddings (C), and gene-gene attention scores (A). GNEval assesses inferred networks based on their consistency with functional and perturbational evidence, including 14 Perturb-seq datasets across diverse cell systems, perturbation types and data sizes. The results reveal substantial heterogeneity across evaluation tasks and models. Rankings based on Gene Ontology and Perturb-seq evidence were nearly uncorrelated (Spearman {rho} = -0.05). Context-independent representations showed a substantial advantage in recovering functional relationships ({Delta}AUROC = 0.13), whereas context-dependent gene associations improved recovery of perturbation-associated differential expression relationships by 3.8x. The domain-specific method achieves relatively strong performance on both evidence types, offering a better balance across the two evaluations than most foundation-model-derived networks. Overall, gene representations and association scores show task-specific strengths, highlighting the need for task-aware selection and integration with domain-specific methods.

llm.novelty_zh: 首次系统地把单细胞基础模型产生的基因-基因关联（静态嵌入、上下文嵌入、注意力分数）作为基因网络推断的对象，用功能证据与扰动证据统一评测。
llm.summary_zh: 作者提出 GNEval 基准，评估 11 个单细胞基础模型衍生的 21 种基因表征与关联分数在基因网络推断中的表现。评测同时依据 Gene Ontology 功能关系和 14 个 Perturb-seq 数据集的扰动差异表达证据。结果显示不同任务和模型之间差异显著：功能证据与扰动证据的排名几乎不相关，上下文无关表征擅长功能关系，上下文相关关联擅长扰动关系，领域专用方法在两类证据上较为均衡。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作为“用虚拟细胞基础模型做基因网络推断”提供了统一评测标准，并明确指出不同模型在功能与扰动证据上的取舍，对模型选择和与领域方法整合有直接指导意义。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未说明基准的具体数据规模细节、扰动数据的标准化处理方式，以及结论在不同细胞系和扰动类型之外的泛化能力。

title: scXOrGAN: A Generative Framework for Cross-Organ Single-Cell Transcriptomic Translation
abstract: Gene expression profiles of organs provide important insights into their health and disease states. However, while some organs can be sampled only through invasive procedures, others, such as blood, are readily accessible. Existing methods for predicting gene expression in one organ from another typically work with bulk or averaged profiles, obscuring cell specific differences. Translation at single-cell resolution is more challenging, because individual cells in the source and target organs lack direct correspondence. Here, we present scXOrGAN, a generative model that translates single-cell transcriptomes between two organs of the same individual using data that are unpaired at the cell level. scXOrGAN combines two variational autoencoders that share a latent space with cycle consistency, adversarial training and distribution matching. Across three organ pairs (ileum to rectum, blood to bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) in COVID-19, and blood to heart in heart failure), the generated gene expressions closely matched the real target cell profiles of held-out donors and preserved cell-to-cell variation. Notably, generated BALF macrophages exhibit expression of COVID-19-associated genes that are nearly absent in source blood cells, while generated cardiac fibroblasts express genes upregulated in heart failure.
affiliations: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology

llm.novelty_zh: 在无细胞级配对的条件下，用共享潜空间的双 VAE 结合循环一致性、对抗训练与分布匹配，实现同一个体两器官间的单细胞转录组翻译。
llm.summary_zh: scXOrGAN 提出一个生成模型，在同一个体的两个器官之间进行单细胞转录组翻译，训练数据在细胞层面无配对。模型由两个共享潜空间的 VAE 组成，并结合循环一致性、对抗训练和分布匹配。在 ileum 到 rectum、COVID-19 中 blood 到 BALF、heart failure 中 blood 到 heart 三组器官对上，生成表达与留出供体的真实目标细胞较为接近，并保留了细胞间变异。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把跨器官预测从 bulk 或平均水平推进到单细胞分辨率，并能生成难以直接采样器官（如心脏）的细胞表达，对由易取样组织推断难取样组织状态有参考价值。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确给出与其他跨器官翻译方法的定量基线比较，也未说明代码或数据是否公开，且方法主要是已有组件的组合，偏向应用型。

title: Adaptive Representations for Real-World Enzyme Optimization
abstract: Protein fitness landscapes are highly rugged, giving rise to complex optimization landscapes. Bayesian optimization (BO) with Gaussian processes (GPs) is widely used in protein engineering for its sample efficiency and calibrated uncertainty estimates. Here, we study a joint fine-tuning framework of a protein language model (PLM) and a GP across enzyme fitness landscapes that span various distinct mutation regimes encountered in real-world engineering campaigns. Joint fine-tuning optimizes the PLM and GP parameters together in an uncertainty-calibrated manner, providing an adaptive representation that utilizes the information from previously acquired points in addition to the existing knowledge from pretraining. Across seven combinatorial enzyme landscapes, this approach yields a median relative improvement in top-5% coverage of 45% over one-hot encoding and 120% over mean-pooled static ESM-C embeddings. We further explore several new pooling strategies beyond standard mean pooling within the joint fine-tuning framework and show that mutation-site pooling, which localizes the representation to mutated residues, is the most consistent performer across all landscapes, outperforming both established baselines and alternative pooling schemes. Finally, we show that the finetuned approach makes more effective use of training-split information, yielding better coverage across test-split BO rounds. These results suggest that adapting the representation during a campaign, rather than fixing it in advance, is the better design choice for BO-guided enzyme engineering.

datasets_used: seven combinatorial enzyme fitness landscapes (names not given in abstract)
llm.novelty_zh: 新在将 PLM 与 GP 联合微调用于 BO 过程中的自适应表征，并提出以突变位点为中心的 mutation-site pooling。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作研究在酶适应度景观上对蛋白语言模型（PLM）与高斯过程（GP）进行联合微调，使贝叶斯优化过程中的表征随实验轮次自适应更新。在七个组合式酶景观上，相对 one-hot 与均值池化的静态 ESM-C 嵌入，top-5% 覆盖率的中位相对提升分别为 45% 和 120%。作者还比较了多种池化策略，发现聚焦突变位点的 mutation-site pooling 表现最稳定。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把基础模型表征与贝叶斯优化结合，说明在实验活动中更新表征优于固定表征，对蛋白工程的序列-功能优化有参考价值。它属于外围圈（蛋白设计/工程），与虚拟细胞主线的关联较间接。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确给出所用七个酶景观的名称与规模、计算成本及在湿实验中的前瞻验证，且聚焦于组合突变的回溯式模拟。

title: Inferring transcriptional bursting dynamics from scSLAM-seq data
abstract: Transcription is a bursty, stochastic process. How transcriptional regulators reshape bursting dynamics during cellular responses remains poorly understood, largely because most single-cell RNA sequencing experiments measure only steady-state RNA abundance. Here, we present buRst, a probabilistic framework that infers burst frequency, burst size, and RNA degradation rates from metabolically labeled single-cell RNA sequencing (scSLAM-seq) during acute perturbations, without assuming steady state. It jointly models labeling measurements and RNA dynamics, propagating uncertainty from sparse labeling data into kinetic estimates. We applied buRst to acute MYC depletion in two melanoma cell lines. MYC amplified burst size in a manner scaling with its promoter occupancy, whereas it reduced burst frequency genome-wide, independently of occupancy. As a result, only strongly bound genes showed net activation, reconciling models of MYC as a selective activator and as a global amplifier of transcription.
affiliations: Faculty of Informatics and Data Science, University of Regensburg, Regensburg, Germany | Institute of Virology and Immunobiology, Julius-Maximilians-Universitae

datasets_used: scSLAM-seq data from two melanoma cell lines (acute MYC depletion)
llm.novelty_zh: 将转录爆发频率、爆发大小与RNA降解速率的推断扩展到非稳态的急性扰动场景，并联合建模标记测量与RNA动力学、传递不确定性。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作提出buRst概率框架，利用scSLAM-seq代谢标记数据在急性扰动下推断转录爆发频率、爆发大小和RNA降解速率，无需稳态假设。作者将其应用于两种黑色素瘤细胞系中的急性MYC耗竭实验，发现MYC依据启动子结合强度放大爆发大小，并在全基因组范围降低爆发频率。由此，只有强结合基因表现出净激活，调和了MYC作为选择性激活因子与全局转录放大因子的两种模型。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将单细胞转录动力学推断从稳态快照推进到扰动过程中的动态参数估计，为理解调控因子如何改变转录过程提供机理层面的工具。其对MYC的发现也为扰动响应建模提供了具体的生物学约束。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要仅涉及两种黑色素瘤细胞系和单一扰动因子（MYC），未体现跨数据集或与其他动力学推断方法的系统基准比较，泛化性有待验证。

title: Reconstructing regulatory histories of cell fate decisions from single-cell lineage and multi-omics
abstract: Understanding how distinct cell identities emerge from common progenitors requires access to regulatory histories that molecular snapshots cannot directly reveal. We introduce RegArch, a probabilistic framework integrating transcriptomic profiles, chromatin-derived evidence, and time-scaled cell lineages to reconstruct terminal and unobserved ancestral gene regulatory networks (GRNs). These lineage-resolved networks enable characterization of regulatory reorganization, prioritization of differentiation-associated and branch-biased regulators, and identification of constitutive, lineage-associated, and state-restricted modules. Simulations demonstrate ancestral network recovery and improved terminal GRN inference. In Caenorhabditis elegans, inferred ancestral GRNs combined with measured regulator expression generated target-expression signatures preferentially matching their corresponding progenitor profiles. EMS lineage analyses identified a shared regulatory module and branch-enriched modules with distinct ancestral representation. In zebrafish hearts sampled after injury, developmental ancestry informed endocardial- and epicardial-associated candidate regulator prioritization. RegArch thus generates testable hypotheses about the regulatory origins of cellular diversity.
affiliations: School of Mathematics, Sun Yat-sen University, Guangzhou, China; Guangdong Province Key Laboratory of Computational Science, Sun Yat-sen University, Guangzhou,

datasets_used: C. elegans EMS lineage data (single-cell transcriptomic with lineage)
llm.novelty_zh: 将时间缩放的细胞谱系与转录组和染色质证据结合，用概率框架重建未观测祖先细胞的基因调控网络，这一"调控历史"视角较新。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作提出 RegArch 概率框架，整合转录组、染色质衍生证据和时间缩放的细胞谱系，重建终末及未观测祖先状态的 GRN。模拟数据显示祖先网络可被恢复且终末 GRN 推断有所改善，并在 C. elegans EMS 谱系和斑马鱼损伤后心脏数据中给出与祖先谱系相关的候选调控因子与模块。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作尝试从谱系与多组学数据推断细胞命运决定的调控历史，为理解细胞多样性起源提供可检验假设。它属于发育生物学中的 GRN 推断，与虚拟细胞的扰动建模只有间接关联。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提供定量基准对比、具体指标和代码/数据可用性，实际验证主要集中在少数发育模型系统上，与扰动预测类虚拟细胞任务的关联较弱。

title: FunDLM: A Foundation DNA Language Model for Fungi
abstract: Background: Fungi are important pathogens and biotechnology resources, but lack a broadly applicable fungal DNA language model. Models trained on diverse fungal genomes can support functional interpretation of genomic variants and a broad range of genomic tasks. Results: We introduce FunDLM, a family of four DNA language models pre-trained on 426 fungal reference assemblies spanning 217 genera and 14.3 Gb of sequence. Without task-specific training, FunDLM-Medium-1024bp distinguished phenotype-associated missense variants of Saccharomyces cerevisiae from synonymous controls with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.875. It performed comparably to Evo 2, a generalist model with about 15 times more parameters, and better than Nucleotide Transformer v3. The model also recognized mutations that disrupt start codons or introduce premature stop codons in S. cerevisiae and the blast fungus Pyricularia oryzae. Its scores for missense variants, computed from DNA alone, correlated with those of protein language models in S. cerevisiae and two Fusarium species (Pearson correlation 0.57-0.75). After fine-tuning, FunDLM-Small-1024bp identified supernumerary chromosome sequences in four Pyricularia isolates not used for training (average precision 0.884), and FunDLM-Medium-1024bp recognized centromeres on a chromosome withheld from training (AUROC 0.908). Fine-tuned models also predicted three histone modifications in an isolate and on chromosomes not used for training (AUROC 0.910-0.996). Conclusions: FunDLM provides reusable sequence representations for assessing functional impacts of fungal variants as well as annotation of genomic and epigenomic features. The released models, data, code, and benchmarks support applications across fungal species.

datasets_used: fungal reference assemblies (426 genomes, 217 genera, 14.3 Gb)
Pyricularia oryzae isolates (supernumerary chromosomes, centromeres, histone modifications)
new_dataset_names: FunDLM pretraining corpus of 426 fungal genomes (unnamed in abstract)
FunDLM benchmark suite for fungal variant and epigenomic tasks (unnamed in abstract)
llm.novelty_zh: 首个面向真菌、跨217属426个参考基因组预训练的DNA语言模型家族，并配套发布模型、数据与基准，但思路上属于基因组序列基础模型而非细胞层面建模。
llm.summary_zh: 作者基于426个真菌参考基因组（14.3 Gb）预训练了四个DNA语言模型FunDLM，在无任务训练的零样本设置下，用于区分酿酒酵母错义突变与同义突变（AUROC 0.875，与Evo 2相当，优于Nucleotide Transformer v3），并能识别起始密码子和提前终止密码子突变。微调后，模型还可用于稻瘟病菌超数染色体、着丝粒及组蛋白修饰的注释。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 这是真菌领域较完整的基因组语言模型资源，提供可复用的序列表征与变异功能评估基准；虽然不直接涉及虚拟细胞或扰动建模，但对真菌功能基因组学研究有参考价值。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要中的评估主要集中在酿酒酵母和稻瘟病菌等少数物种，且以DNA序列层面的变异效应和表观特征为主，未涉及细胞状态或扰动响应的直接建模。

title: Task-aligned foundation model representations enable single-cell cytokine response inference
abstract: Inferring cellular responses from single-cell transcriptomes requires interpreting changes relative to an appropriate baseline while retaining cell-type context. Here we present CYTAP, which adapts frozen single-cell foundation model embeddings for cytokine-response inference by combining donor-adjusted receiver states with deviations from matched control centroids. CYTAP uses a shared classifier to assign relative single-cell response scores across 90 cytokines and supports unpaired analyses using counterfactual control references. Baseline-relative representations improved held-out-donor prediction with both State SE and scFoundation. Across independent perturbation datasets, CYTAP prioritized applied cytokines, including when receptor transcripts were sparsely detected, and ranked administered cytokines among the top ten in both in vivo datasets. In an unpaired COVID-19 cohort, inferred responses were associated with severity, and IL-6 response scores correlated with plasma IL-6 concentrations. These findings support the use of biologically defined references to adapt pretrained representations for functional response inference.
affiliations: Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH)

llm.novelty_zh: 将冻结的单细胞基础模型嵌入与对照质心偏差（基线相对表征）结合，并用共享分类器对90种细胞因子做单细胞响应打分，同时支持基于反事实对照的非配对分析。
llm.summary_zh: CYTAP 在冻结的单细胞基础模型（State SE、scFoundation）嵌入之上，结合供体校正后的受体细胞状态与匹配对照质心的偏差，构建细胞因子响应推断框架。模型用共享分类器对90种细胞因子给出单细胞相对响应分数，并支持使用反事实对照的非配对分析。在留出供体预测、独立扰动数据集以及未配对COVID-19队列中，该方法均有相应表现，其中IL-6响应分数与血浆IL-6浓度相关。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作说明基于生物学定义参考的基线相对表征可以让预训练细胞基础模型更好地用于功能响应推断，且能扩展到非配对的临床队列。对细胞因子相关的虚拟细胞与免疫扰动建模有直接参考价值。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出与其他方法的定量对比幅度、数据集规模及代码可用性信息，且临床相关性仅基于COVID-19队列的少量相关性证据。

title: SparseKG‐Flow: A Virtual Cell Generative Architecture Unifying Structural Causal Models and Knowledge Graph Priors for Single‐Cell Drug Perturbation Prediction
abstract: Predicting single‐cell responses to new drugs is essential for mechanism‐aware virtual cell modeling, yet existing models often fail on unseen drugs or cell types by relying on memorized correlations rather than transferable mechanisms. SparseKG‐Flow addresses this out‐of‐distribution (OOD) challenge as a generative architecture integrating three inductive biases: a sparse drug‐effect encoder with Gumbel–Softmax gating, a heterogeneous graph adapter for drug–target–pathway knowledge, and a mechanism‐guided residual flow decoder. On Tahoe‐100M, it achieves Pearson of 0.942 and 0.920 under Test‐NewDrug and Test‐NewCell settings, respectively, outperforming the next‐best baseline by 16.6% and 14.8%. It also reduces error by 89.0% and 91.7%, respectively, and more than doubles held‐out‐drug top‐gene recovery (Overlap@50 = 0.210). Frozen‐model evaluation on high‐grade serous ovarian cancer patient data provides preliminary evidence of transfer beyond the Tahoe‐100M panel. Ablations confirm all components aid OOD generalization, with the molecular knowledge adapter contributing the most. SparseKG‐Flow further reorganizes pharmacological priors into interpretable, task‐trained representations and highlights Abemaciclib, Capmatinib, and Gemcitabine in A549 analysis. It thus serves as both an accurate perturbation predictor and a mechanism‐grounded virtual cell platform for therapeutic prioritization.
affiliations: Centre in Artificial Intelligence Driven Drug Discovery, Faculty of Applied Sciences, Macao Polytechnic University, Macau, China.
Zhongshan School of Medicine, Sun Yat-sen University, Guangzhou, China.
School of Biological Sciences, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, Singapore.
Engineering Research Centre of Applied Technology on Machine Translation and Artificial Intelligence, Macao Polytechnic University, Macau, China.

llm.novelty_zh: 将稀疏药物效应编码、药物-靶点-通路异构图先验与机制引导残差流解码器整合进虚拟细胞生成模型。
llm.summary_zh: SparseKG-Flow 是面向单细胞药物扰动预测的生成式架构，整合稀疏药物效应编码器、药物-靶点-通路异构图适配器与机制引导残差流解码器。作者在 Tahoe-100M 的新药与新细胞系设置下分别报告 Pearson 0.942 和 0.920，并通过消融实验及高级别浆液性卵巢癌患者数据的冻结模型评估支持其泛化能力。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法在分布外药物扰动预测中提供了可解释的机制先验整合方案，对虚拟细胞平台的治疗优先级排序有参考价值。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要称患者数据上的迁移证据仅为初步结果，其泛化范围仍有待更多数据验证。

title: Integrative single-cell multi-omics of African ancestry Alzheimer's disease brains reveals APOE ε4-dependent effects on glial translation pathways and neuronal synaptic function.
abstract: Introduction Late-onset Alzheimer's disease (LOAD) is biologically heterogeneous, and apolipoprotein E (APOE) ε4-associated risk varies across ancestries. We investigated molecular mechanisms underlying LOAD and APOE ε4 effects in African ancestry (AA) individuals. Methods Multiomic single-cell transcriptomic and chromatin accessibility profiles were generated from AA brains and integrated to identify differentially expressed genes (DEGs), enriched pathways, transcription factor-cis-regulatory element-DEG (TF-cCRE-DEG) regulatory trios, and variant-disrupted regulatory networks. Results Glial subpopulations were enriched for APOE genotype-dependent DEGs, whereas neuronal subtypes exhibited predominantly APOE-independent LOAD-associated expression changes. APOE expression was upregulated in a microglial subtype of ε4 non-carriers (ε3/ε3). APOE ε4 carriers (ε3/ε4) showed impaired ribosomal and translational pathways, including L13a/GAIT, in specific glial populations. Integration of multiomic data identified numerous LOAD-associated TF-cCRE-DEG trios, particularly in glutamatergic neurons, including prostaglandin D synthase gene regulatory networks. Predicted regulatory-disrupting variants defined TF-cCRE-DEG-single-nucleotide variant quartets. Discussion These findings provide mechanistic insight into APOE-mediated LOAD risk and non-coding regulatory variation in AA populations, highlighting potential precision therapeutic targets.
affiliations: Division of Translational Brain Sciences, Department of Neurology, Duke University Medical Center, Durham, North Carolina, USA.
Center for Genomic and Computational Biology, Duke University Medical Center, Durham, North Carolina, USA.
Duke Molecular Physiology Institute, Duke University Medical Center, Durham, North Carolina, USA.
Department of Medicine, Duke University Medical Center, Durham, North Carolina, USA.
venue: Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association
published_venue: Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association

llm.novelty_zh: 在非洲血统人群中刻画APOE ε4依赖的胶质与神经元效应，属于疾病队列分析，方法上无新意。
llm.summary_zh: 研究整合非洲血统阿尔茨海默病患者脑组织的单细胞转录组与染色质可及性数据，比较不同APOE基因型下的差异表达与调控网络。结果显示胶质细胞受APOE基因型影响较大，神经元变化主要与基因型无关。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为理解APOE在不同祖源人群中的作用提供单细胞层面的证据。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: Integrative Genomic and Stem Cell Frameworks for Variant‐to‐Function Discovery in Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Narrative Review
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a heterogeneous neurodevelopmental condition shaped by de novo protein-truncating variants, inherited missense substitutions, recurrent copy number variations (CNVs), and distributed polygenic risk. These alterations converge on a limited set of neurobiological processes, including synaptic refinement, excitation-to-inhibition balance, chromatin state regulation, and glial-mediated neuroimmune signaling. Experimental paradigms now exist for systematic variant-to-function interrogation through CRISPR-engineered isogenic human pluripotent stem-cell libraries incorporating Cas9 nucleases, programmable transcriptional modulators (dCas9-KRAB and dCas9-VP64), base editors, and prime editing systems. Coupled with single-cell multi-omic platforms such as Perturb-seq, scATAC-seq, and CITE-seq, and with circuit-level phenotyping through multielectrode arrays, calcium imaging, and quantitative morphometry, these systems resolve ASD-relevant cellular states at single-cell and cell-type-specific resolution. In this narrative review, we distinguish deliberately between what these platforms have already established and what remains proposed. To date, a small number of studies constitute the demonstrated evidence base: in vivo Perturb-seq of 35 ASD/neurodevelopmental risk genes in mouse cortex, mosaic knockout of ASD genes in human cortical organoids, the CHOOSE organoid screen of 36 risk genes, assembloid CRISPR screening of 425 neurodevelopmental-disorder risk genes, a 63-line mouse embryonic stem-cell CNV resource, and a CRISPRi screen of 102 ASD risk genes in human induced pluripotent stem-cell (iPSC)-derived microglia implicating ADNP in synaptic pruning. We summarized these in a dedicated comparison table. Against this, integration of polygenic and noncoding architecture, causal-inference frameworks, such as Mendelian randomization and do-calculus, and cross-laboratory reproducibility, remain aspirational rather than realized. We therefore frame the field's principal near-term requirement not as further gene discovery but as harmonized protocols, shared reference lines, arrayed validation capacity, and interpretable statistical frameworks capable of converting perturbation atlases into causal mechanism.
affiliations: Centre for Multidisciplinary Research in Health Science
Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology
Ras al-Khaimah Medical and Health Sciences University

llm.novelty_zh: 属于叙述性综述，对自闭症变异到功能研究的平台与证据进行了梳理，本身无新方法。

title: Artificial intelligence‐driven bioinformatics: From analytical pipelines to model‐centered biological discovery
abstract: Traditional bioinformatic pipelines, which focus on predefined statistical analyses, are increasingly inadequate for handling high‐dimensional, heterogeneous, and context‐rich multi‐omics, spatial, and clinical datasets. Artificial intelligence (AI) is extending modern bioinformatics from predefined analytical pipelines toward learned biological representations, intervention‐oriented modeling, and more automated discovery workflows. This review comprehensively summarizes AI advances across genomic interpretation, single‐cell and spatial transcriptomics, multi‐omics integration, structural bioinformatics, disease stratification, precision medicine, and drug discovery. We categorize underlying AI technologies, including classical machine learning, deep representation learning, generative foundation models, and executable AI agents, and highlight their complementary use cases alongside inherent limitations and failure modes. Building on rather than claiming priority for the model‐centered paradigm described in recent literature, this review contributes a cross‐domain, failure‐aware evaluation framework organized around six unified axes: representation validity, task‐specific incremental value, robustness under biological and technical distribution shift, causal support, resource requirements, and validation/governance readiness. We further discuss key technical and social barriers and hierarchically prioritize future research directions. We conclude that AI complements rather than replaces conventional bioinformatic tools, extending the capacity for hypothesis generation and mechanism‐driven validation. This review provides structured and practical guidance for robust, interpretable, and clinically translatable AI‐driven biological discovery.

title: Graph Representation Learning, Geometric Deep Learning, and Foundation Models for Biological Network Analysis
abstract: Biological systems are inherently relational. Genes, proteins, metabolites, and cells interact through complex networks that encode the molecular logic of development, homeostasis, and disease. However, conventional machine learning methods that operate on tabular or sequence‐based representations are not well‐suited to capture this graph‐structured organization. Graph neural networks (GNNs) and their modern descendants, such as graph transformers, equivariant architectures, and foundation models, provide a framework for learning directly from biological interaction networks. This review provides a broad, methodologically focused overview of graph representation learning and geometric deep learning approaches applied to biological network analysis. It covers graph convolutional networks, graph attention networks, message‐passing neural networks, graph transformers, equivariant networks for three‐dimensional molecular structures, and large‐scale pre‐trained foundation models. We introduce a taxonomy that distinguishes graph‐native, knowledge‐graph, graph‐informed, and non‐graph biological foundation models, and we organize the discussion of architectures around the design decisions that matter for biological networks, such as heterophily, edge direction and sign, edge uncertainty, and oversquashing. We evaluate how these architectures can be applied to key network biology tasks, such as gene regulatory network inference, protein–protein interaction prediction, multi‐omics network integration, and disease gene prioritization, and we compare the problem formulations underlying these tasks. We also compare representational strategies, such as heterogeneous graphs and hypergraphs, to capture the multilayer complexity of biological systems. Benchmarking resources, open software tools, and key datasets used across these tasks are cataloged. We discuss challenges, such as data sparsity, network incompleteness, uncertainty in graph construction, data leakage, negative sampling, biological interpretability, and limited ground‐truth labels, and we provide practical guidance for method selection and validation. This review is intended for computational biologists, bioinformaticians, and machine learning researchers who are seeking an overview and introduction to this field with an emphasis on its applicability to disease‐relevant omics data analysis.

title: DAPT: Inductive Prediction of Transcriptional Outcomes for Multigene Perturbations Under Multi-omics
Single-cell CRISPR screens with CROP-seq: technological advances, applications, and computational insights
abstract: Dissecting the causal relationships between genes and cellular phenotypes remains a major challenge in modern biology. Genetic screening approaches provide a powerful means to systematically link gene function to phenotypic outcomes. Early screening methods, coupled with bulk sequencing or reporter-gene readouts, enabled gene-phenotype mapping but were constrained by low efficiency, off-target effects, and limited scalability. In contrast, pooled screening approaches based on clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR) and coupled with single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enable large-scale genetic perturbation while simultaneously capturing transcriptome-wide responses at single-cell resolution. Early approaches relied on transcribed barcodes, as in Perturb-seq, to link individual cells to their corresponding genetic perturbations. Initial implementations, however, suffered from inefficient guide recovery and barcode switching. These limitations were subsequently addressed through methodological improvements and the development of new approaches, such as CRISPR droplet sequencing (CROP-seq), which introduced the dual use of sgRNAs as both Cas9 guides and molecular barcodes, thereby improving perturbation capture accuracy and screening efficiency. Since its introduction, CROP-seq has been further advanced through improved vector designs, expanded targeting strategies, multimodal molecular readouts, and applications in primary cells, induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), organoids, and in vivo models. This review summarizes the technological evolution and biological applications of CROP-seq and categorizes computational methods according to their roles in noise correction, data preprocessing, perturbation-response analysis, and gene regulatory network inference. Together, these advances highlight the current capabilities, limitations, and future prospects of CROP-seq as a powerful platform for single-cell functional genomics.

title: Reconstructing enzyme engineering: an AI-driven paradigm shift in discovery, optimization, and creation
abstract: Enzyme engineering is undergoing a fundamental transformation driven by advances in artificial intelligence, shifting from labor-intensive experimental campaigns toward data-driven, computationally guided workflows. Traditional approaches-directed evolution and rational design-have achieved landmark successes but remain constrained by the vastness of protein sequence space, the ruggedness of fitness landscapes, and the limited throughput of experimental screening cycles. This review systematically deconstructs the AI-driven methodological revolution across three core tasks of enzyme engineering: discovery, optimization, and creation. For enzyme discovery, we trace the evolution from homology-based sequence alignment (e.g., BLAST) to function-aware semantic retrieval powered by protein language models (PLMs), highlighting how contextual embeddings and multimodal representations (sequence-structure-text) enable the mining of remote homologs and functionally convergent enzymes invisible to traditional tools. For enzyme optimization, we examine how zero-shot evolutionary predictions, few-shot active learning, and machine learning-guided directed evolution are replacing blind mutagenesis with predictive, fitness landscape-navigating strategies that dramatically reduce experimental burden. For de novo enzyme creation, we survey the transition from physics-based computational design to generative AI paradigms-including autoregressive models, inverse folding networks, diffusion models, and multi-track joint generation frameworks-that enable the design of functional enzymes with no natural templates. Throughout, we critically assess persistent bottlenecks, including the paucity of standardized, high-quality training data, the fidelity gap between computational scoring functions and true catalytic fitness, and the challenge of capturing protein conformational dynamics. Finally, we project future directions toward semantic-driven autonomous enzyme engineering, where natural language interfaces, AI agents, and fully automated experimental platforms converge to enable closed-loop, self-optimizing enzyme design with minimal human intervention.

title: A Hierarchical KAN-Augmented Graph Convolutional Model for Inferring Cell-Type-Specific Gene Regulations in Single-Cell Omics.
abstract: Accurate inference of gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from single-cell RNA-seq data remains challenging due to the complexity of transcription factor (TF)-target interactions and the difficulty in capturing both local and global regulatory dependencies. Here, we present GeneKAN, a novel deep learning framework that integrates multiscale graph convolution with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) for robust GRN inference. GeneKAN employs a kernel-based graph convolution module to hierarchically encode gene representations, while KANs model high-order, interpretable TF-target relationships through learnable spline activations. Benchmarking against eleven existing models, and seven scRNA-seq datasets from BEELINE, including diverse cell types, species, and ground-truth networks (ChIP-seq, STRING, LOF/GOF), demonstrates that our proposed GeneKAN achieves state-of-the-art performance in both AUROC and AUPRC. Ablation studies of the proposed model confirm the necessity of each component. Biological validation on human hepatocyte and lung cancer datasets reveals that GeneKAN not only recovers known regulatory interactions with high precision but also identifies functionally relevant hub genes and oncogenic pathways. GeneKAN thus offers a powerful, interpretable, and scalable solution for GRN reconstruction under real-world conditions of data sparsity and noise, with significant potential for advancing systems biology and precision medicine.

title: Breast cancer cell motility speed measurement using in vitro assays: a systematic scoping review of current knowledge.
abstract: Purpose This systematic scoping review evaluates contemporary advancements in the design and clinical application of lab-on-a-chip (LOC) microdevices specialised for measuring breast cancer cell motility parameters. It tracks the engineering frontiers of biomimetic systems and addresses their predictive potential in oncology research. Methods Utilising the PRISMA scoping review framework, a systematic database screening was executed to capture primary research articles published over a twelve-year retrospective window from 2016 to 2026. Sourced literature was subjected to thematic synthesis. The inclusion criteria targeted seven baseline parameters: (1) LOC architectures as functional in vitro assays, (2) dynamic cell migration tracking, (3) structural tumour microenvironment mimics, (4) real-time single-cell velocity quantification, (5) gravity-driven fluidic perfusion setups, (6) cellular plasticity profiling, and (7) oestrogen-linked hormone receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer models. Results The systematic search identified in vitro configurations modelling tumour growth boundaries, localised angiogenesis, lymphatic vessel transport, transendothelial intravasation/extravasation, and organ-specific metastasis niches. Recent design advances emphasise three-dimensional (3D) matrix-based microfluidic platforms that replicate matrix stiffness and interfacial friction parameters to capture cell behaviours under fluid shear stress.The literature re-screening revealed that no published studies met all seven analytical criteria required to integrate real-time, single-cell-speed calculations within a unidirectional, gravity-driven dynamic flow loop tailored exclusively for ER+ breast cancer subtyping. Conclusion This review uncovers a technological and biological knowledge gap regarding integrated, low-cost microfluidic assays that can automate individual cell trajectory tracking under physiological flow conditions. Resolving this constraint by bridging advanced single-cell engineering chips with transcriptomic phenotyping and interactive clinical dashboards represents a milestone to validate cell motility as an independent prognostic biomarker, to enable personalised, precision treatment strategies.

title: From virtual cells to virtual humans: toward integrated modeling across biological scales
abstract: Advances in multi-omics, medical imaging, and physiological monitoring are extending the study of living systems beyond static descriptions towards virtual models that support simulation and prediction. This Review surveys progress in constructing virtual cells, tissues, organs, and humans, summarizes the data foundations and major methods across scales of biological organization, and discusses model validation, credibility assessment, and the current state of cross-scale modeling. Existing models can simulate cellular responses to perturbations, tissue dynamics, organ function, and whole-body regulation to address specific questions, and some studies have begun to connect adjacent scales, although such coupling remains largely confined to selected processes. Differences in state variables, spatiotemporal scales, and model formulations make it difficult to map information and establish bidirectional feedback across scales, while limited direct validation further constrains confidence in coupled simulations. Rather than centering on a single all-encompassing virtual human, future work may increasingly focus on improving model descriptions, interfaces, and sharing mechanisms, allowing models at different scales and resolutions to be selected and combined as needed within a flexible and extensible virtual biomedical ecosystem.

title: 348P Predicting immune-related adverse events from baseline PBMCs using a single-cell foundation model
Immune interaction signatures in adipose tissue fibroblasts in obesity-associated atherosclerosis.
abstract: Atherosclerosis involves changes in the vascular wall and surrounding perivascular adipose tissue, yet the cellular contributors to disease progression remain incompletely understood. Obesity exacerbates atherogenesis, but the cell types driving this aggravation are unclear. We aimed to define the key cell populations across tissues in a highly atherogenic mouse model under obese and normal-weight conditions and to identify obesity-associated cellular changes. We employed 5' single-cell RNA sequencing combined with antibody staining in Ldlr -/- Apob 100/100 male mice fed either a high-fat or control diet. Aorta, perivascular and epididymal adipose tissues, and spleen were analyzed, with CD45 + enrichment of aortic samples and CITE-seq using a 138-antibody panel. Key findings were validated in mice by immunohistochemistry and multiplexed immunofluorescence and explored in human aorta and carotid arteries using spatial transcriptomics. Analysis of ∼46,000 cells enabled characterization of cell states, gene enrichment, regulon activity, and inferred interactions. Adipose-derived fibroblast subsets displayed immune-associated transcriptional programs in obesity. The frequency of PI16 + progenitor fibroblasts was reduced per unit area, alongside marked PVAT remodelling, and the top mouse differentially expressed genes exhibited clear spatial patterning in human arteries.

title: Artificial intelligence in basic and translational cardiovascular research.
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in cardiovascular research where conventional analysis struggles with scale, heterogeneity, and multimodal integration. Its contribution differs across imaging, computational omics, mechanistic simulation, and drug discovery. This narrative review examines substantive applications of machine learning and deep learning while distinguishing them from routine bioinformatics and purely biophysical modeling. We assess independent biological units, validation strategies, and strength of inference in representative studies. Deep-learning imaging systems can provide reproducible quantitative phenotypes, but workflow performance alone does not establish mechanism. In single-cell and spatial studies, clustering, integration, trajectory inference, and network reconstruction generally yield associations or hypotheses unless experimentally supported. Mechanistic interpretation is bounded by the specific effect established through targeted perturbation or rescue with functional testing; lineage tracing and orthogonal readouts provide complementary support, not standalone proof of causation. Hybrid AI-biophysical models may accelerate personalized simulation, whereas heart-on-chip, engineered tissue, and organoid systems without learned components are validation platforms rather than AI methods. In drug discovery, active learning and molecular redesign can prioritize candidates, but predicted reductions in ion-channel liability do not demonstrate biological safety or reduced proarrhythmic risk. Major limitations include pseudoreplication, data leakage, domain shift, batch effects, uncertain labels, few independent hearts, demographic imbalance, incomplete calibration, and limited transfer among animal, iPSC-derived, and adult human systems. AI is most valuable when it produces robust phenotypes or experimentally testable hypotheses within a transparent validation framework, rather than when predictive accuracy is treated as mechanistic evidence.

title: Single-cell multimodal atlas reveals regulatory programs in the human brain
abstract: Direct measurement of chromatin states together with transcription is essential for understanding how cell-type-specific regulatory programs are established and maintained in the adult human brain. Here, we present a large-scale single-cell multimodal atlas by jointly profiling the transcriptome with active (H3K27ac) or repressive (H3K27me3) histone modifications across 18 adult brain regions. We targeted over 750,000 nuclei spanning 160 cell types and integrated these data with chromatin accessibility, DNA methylation, 3D genome architecture, and spatial transcriptomes. This framework resolved chromatin states for over 500,000 candidate regulatory elements, identified enhancer-gene links and regulatory programs, revealed Polycomb-associated ultra-long-range contacts, and uncovered brainwide epigenomic heterogeneity. We further developed a sequence-to-function model to predict cell-type-specific effects of candidate neurological disease variants. Finally, comparative analyses across species reveal conservation in active regulatory programs but divergence in repressive programs. Together, this study provides a comprehensive epigenomic reference for interpreting regulatory principles and epigenetic memory underlying human brain organization and disease.

title: Single-cell analysis of chromatin state and transcriptome in the human basal ganglia
abstract: The basal ganglia are central to motor control, learning, emotion, and reward processing, and their dysfunction contributes to many neurological and psychiatric disorders. Here, we generated a single-cell multi-omic atlas of histone modifications and transcriptomes across eight basal ganglia regions from neurotypical human donors. This atlas resolved cell-type- and region-specific landscapes of active and repressive candidate cis-regulatory elements and delineated gene regulatory networks underlying cell identity. We found that the combinatorial expression of homeobox transcription factors provides distinctive molecular descriptors of neuronal cell identities in the basal ganglia. Integration with matched MERFISH spatial transcriptomics further uncovered regional heterogeneity in epigenomic and transcriptional programs. Finally, we used this atlas to interpret noncoding risk variants associated with neuropsychiatric disorders and to construct a deep-learning model that predicts gene regulatory activities and variant effects. Together, this work provides a multimodal regulatory framework for understanding human basal ganglia organization, evolution, and disease genetics.
