llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: Virtual Skin Organoids: Building Digital Twins for Skin Diseases
abstract: Skin organoids have emerged as invaluable models for studying skin diseases. However, their broader application is constrained by batch-to-batch variability, lengthy culture periods, and challenges in scaling production. The convergence of artificial intelligence and omics technologies has recently given rise to the concept of the artificial intelligence virtual cells, which are computational models designed to simulate the dynamic behavior of cells, both individually and in populations. Building on this concept, we propose the virtual skin organoid, a next-generation computational model that synthesizes a highly biomimetic representation of skin organoids. The virtual skin organoid leverages large-scale clinical data and fuses multimodal dynamic monitoring with artificial intelligence analytics. The primary objective in developing virtual skin organoids is to construct individualized skin digital twins. This involves enabling dynamic visualization, quantitative analysis, and predictable intervention of skin physiological and pathological processes in vitro. Therefore, beginning with a synthesis of recent progress in skin organoids, this review then examines advances in virtual cells and the role of artificial intelligence. It then introduces the concept of the virtual skin organoid, outlining construction strategies and potential applications, before concluding with a critical analysis of challenges and prospective solutions.
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
Shanghai University of Medicine and Health Sciences

llm.novelty_zh: 提出虚拟皮肤类器官这一数字孪生概念，并给出构建策略设想。
llm.summary_zh: 综述回顾了皮肤类器官及虚拟细胞的研究现状，提出融合临床大数据与多模态动态监测的虚拟皮肤类器官框架。文章以个体化皮肤数字孪生为目标，讨论可视化、定量分析与可预测干预。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 将虚拟细胞思路延伸到类器官层面，为个体化皮肤疾病建模提供了方向。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要中的框架为概念性设想，未给出实验或模型验证。

title: Emerging Single-Cell and Spatial Transcriptomics: From Multi-Kingdom Interactions to Genetic Variation and Population Diversity
abstract: Plants are composed of highly specialized cell types. Their identity, location, and interactions collectively determine their development, environmental responses, and evolutionary adaptation. The emergence of single-cell/nuclear technologies has transformed plant biology by enabling the study of gene expression at cellular resolution, while spatial transcriptomics preserve the developmental and spatial context. In this review, we provide a comprehensive overview of the current experimental and computational landscape of single-cell and spatial transcriptomics in plants. We discuss the strengths, limitations, and applications of available technologies, ranging from transcriptomics at cell level to high-resolution spatial platforms, as well as recent advances in bioinformatics analysis, data integration, and community resources. Beyond methodological advances, we highlight how these technologies are redefining our understanding of plant development, responses to abiotic stress, and interactions among different kingdoms, by revealing dynamic cellular states, regulatory networks, and spatially organized biological processes that remain inaccessible to bulk analyses. We discuss the emerging integration of single-cell approaches with population genomics, evolutionary biology, and genetic demultiplexing, which opens up new avenues for identifying the cellular basis of natural variation and adaptive evolution.

llm.novelty_zh: 综述性质，系统梳理植物单细胞与空间转录组的技术和分析进展，无新方法。
llm.summary_zh: 该综述概述植物单细胞及空间转录组的实验与计算体系，讨论各平台的优劣、数据整合方法与公共资源。文章还关注这些技术在植物跨物种互作与遗传多样性研究中的应用。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为植物单细胞研究者提供技术选型与资源索引，与虚拟细胞建模关联有限。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: Deep learning inference of plant GRNs at single-cell level: from cis-elements to spatially programmable promoters.
abstract: Plant regulatory logic emerges from the interaction of cis-regulatory elements, chromatin state, transcription factors, cell identity, and microenvironmental context. This review synthesizes how single-cell and single-nucleus genomics, spatial omics, deep learning, and perturbation frameworks are converging to resolve that logic in plants. We discuss chromatin-first and sequence-informed strategies for discovering candidate cis-regulatory elements, compare major approaches for inferring single-cell gene regulatory networks, and evaluate the promise and limitations of interpretable deep learning and foundation models in data-limited plant systems. We then examine how spatial biology reconnects regulatory inference to tissue geometry, signaling context, and microenvironmental structure, and how perturbation platforms, reporter assays, CRISPRa/i, and programmable promoter engineering can be used to functionally test regulatory predictions. Together, these developments support a transition from descriptive atlases toward iterative design-test-learn frameworks in which candidate elements, networks, and perturbations can be prioritized, validated, and refined across molecular, cellular, and tissue scales.
affiliations: Genetics and Biochemistry, College of Science, Clemson University, Clemson, SC 29634, USA.
Biological Sciences, College of Science, Clemson University, Clemson, SC 29634, USA.
Mathematical and Statistical Sciences, College of Science, Clemson University, Clemson, SC 29634, USA.

llm.novelty_zh: 综述植物单细胞基因调控网络推断的深度学习与空间组学方法，提出从描述性图谱走向设计-测试-学习迭代的框架。
llm.summary_zh: 文章梳理了植物顺式元件发现、单细胞 GRN 推断、可解释深度学习与基础模型在数据有限体系中的应用。作者还讨论了空间组学、CRISPRa/i 和可编程启动子如何用于功能验证。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该综述将植物调控推断与设计-测试-学习框架结合，对跨物种的调控网络方法迁移有参考价值。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未对植物基础模型的具体性能进行量化对比，主要为概述性讨论。

title: iGPSC-DB: a comprehensive database for an inferred single-cell genetic perturbation atlas
abstract: Genetic perturbation-induced transcriptional reprogramming drastically remodels tumor cellular phenotypes and tumor microenvironment crosstalk. Unraveling the heterogeneous cellular responses to genetic perturbations is essential for the mechanistic dissection of tumors and the discovery of therapeutic targets. Here, we present iGPSC-DB (https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/iGPSC-DB), a database designed to infer connections between tumor microenvironmental cells and diverse genetic perturbation events and to dissect the heterogeneous cellular responses to these perturbations. iGPSC-DB curates associations linking 178 114 perturbation events that target 7407 genes to 9 249 080 single cells from 1580 samples across 88 cancer types. iGPSC-DB also provides seven user-friendly tools for retrieving and analyzing: (i) inferred associations between genetic perturbation events and cells/cell types; (ii) the inferred perturbation-associated effects of perturbations on cellular functions, developmental trajectories, and cell-cell communication within the tissue microenvironment; (iii) the combined effects of different perturbations on cells, facilitating the design of combination therapeutic regimens; (iv) the impact of different perturbations on the differentiation trajectories and functional states of malignant cells; and (v) the association between perturbed target genes and clinical survival outcomes. iGPSC-DB will serve as a valuable resource to advance single-cell-resolution research on gene functions, regulatory mechanisms, and the discovery of tumor therapeutic targets.
affiliations: First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University

llm.novelty_zh: 整合178,114个遗传扰动事件与约925万个肿瘤单细胞，推断扰动与细胞之间的关联并提供七类分析工具。
llm.summary_zh: iGPSC-DB 是一个数据库，推断了 178114 个遗传扰动事件（涉及 7407 个基因）与肿瘤微环境单细胞之间的关联，覆盖 88 种癌症类型。数据库提供七类工具，支持查询扰动对细胞功能、发育轨迹、细胞通讯和组合扰动的影响，以及靶基因与生存结局的关系。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为肿瘤单细胞遗传扰动图谱研究和治疗靶点发现提供了可检索的资源。
llm.limitations_zh: 关联为推断结果，摘要未提及其实验验证。

title: CircaVal: a gene-centric multi-omics platform for exploring circadian regulatory features
abstract: The circadian clock orchestrates daily physiological processes through coordinated regulation of clock-controlled gene expression across multiple molecular layers. However, systematic characterization of this multilayered rhythmic regulation remains challenging because relevant information is distributed across independent datasets and rhythmicity is evaluated using diverse analytical approaches. Here, we developed CircaVal, a gene-centric multi-omics platform for the integrated exploration and interpretation of circadian regulatory features in humans, mice, and baboons. To support this framework, CircaVal processes public datasets using standardized, data-type-specific pipelines, and gene rhythmicity is integrated with tissue-specific expression, cross-species orthology, functional annotations, and multi-omics regulatory features. CircaVal further introduces an integrated rhythmicity score (IRS), which combines concordance across multiple rhythm-detection methods with reproducibility across independent datasets to provide a quantitative basis for prioritizing candidate rhythmic genes. The platform enables users to examine gene rhythmicity across datasets, identify tissue-enriched rhythmic genes, compare rhythmicity across species, and explore associated regulatory features. Additional functions include interactive gene-centric exploration, genome-browser visualization, rhythmicity analysis of user-uploaded time-series data, and programmatic data access. Together, these capabilities provide an integrated framework for rhythmic gene prioritization and gene-level interpretation of circadian regulatory features across tissues, species, datasets, and omics data types. CircaVal is freely available at https://CircaVal.com.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出整合多种节律检测方法与跨数据集可重复性的综合节律评分（IRS），用于排序候选节律基因。
llm.summary_zh: CircaVal是面向人、小鼠和狒狒的基因中心多组学平台，对公开数据进行标准化处理并整合节律、组织特异性与调控特征。平台提供IRS评分、基因组浏览器可视化和用户数据节律分析等功能。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为节律基因的筛选与跨物种比较提供统一资源，便于研究者快速检索昼夜调控信息。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及IRS评分与实验验证的一致性，也未对平台的覆盖范围做定量说明。

title: scSpAS: an integrated single-cell and spatial atlas of transcript isoform regulation
abstract: Alternative transcript initiation, splicing, and 3'-end processing jointly shape transcript isoform diversity, but these regulatory layers remain fragmented across separate single-cell and spatial resources. Here, we present scSpAS, an integrated database of alternative transcription start site (ATS), alternative splicing, full-length transcript isoforms, and alternative polyadenylation (APA) in human and mouse. It contains 123 datasets, including over 418 000 cells and 82 000 spatial spots across healthy and disease contexts, covering 13 cancer types, 5 infectious conditions, 8 inflammatory diseases, and 90 healthy samples. Based on uniformly standardized pipelines, we utilized 5' capture and 3' capture single-cell RNA-sequencing data to identify ATS and APA sites, and the Smart-seq2 and long-read sequencing data to identify the alternative splicing events and isoforms. In total, scSpAS contains >648 000 alternative splicing events, 432 000 ATS, and 621 000 APA sites, as well as over 551 000 transcript isoforms. The database further integrates regulatory annotations derived from CLIP-seq, ATAC-seq, and CAGE-seq, together with predicted splicing regulatory motifs. scSpAS enables users to retrieve events, isoforms and genes, examine differential usage at cell-type and spatial levels, and in different biological and physiological conditions; furthermore, users can inspect the potential regulatory mechanisms of all events. It is freely available at https://scspas.chenlulab.com/.
affiliations: West China Second University Hospital of Sichuan University
West China Hospital of Sichuan University

llm.novelty_zh: 整合单细胞与空间数据中的转录起始、剪接、3'端加工与全长异构体，构建统一的异构体调控图谱数据库。
llm.summary_zh: scSpAS收录人与小鼠的123个数据集，涵盖超过41.8万个细胞和8.2万个空间点，统一标准化分析替代转录起始、可变剪接、APA事件及全长异构体。数据库还整合了CLIP-seq、ATAC-seq和CAGE-seq的调控注释，用户可检查各事件的潜在调控机制。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为单细胞与空间层面的转录异构体调控研究提供了统一资源，便于跨疾病和细胞类型比较。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及数据库更新机制，也未说明不同测序平台带来的注释偏差。

title: RNAactDrug 2.0: an updated resource for systematically exploring molecular features associated with drug sensitivity across multi-omics datasets
abstract: RNAactDrug 2.0 (available at https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug or https://bio-datamining.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug) is an updated resource for systematically exploring molecular features associated with drug sensitivity across multi-omics datasets. We have updated the RNAactDrug 2.0 database with significantly expanded data and improved features, including (i) ∼30 000 drugs, 38 908 RNA molecules, and 22 800 375 drug-RNA associations from large-scale pharmacogenomic databases, covering four molecular layers: expression, copy number variation (CNV), mutation, and methylation; (ii) 11 099 cases from The Cancer Genome Atlas across 33 cancer types are integrated to support clinical and pan-cancer analyses of drug sensitivity-associated RNA features; (iii) ∼3.8 million cells from >200 single-cell RNA sequencing datasets, spanning 34 cancer types and 38 tissues, enable analysis of cell type-specific patterns and intratumoral heterogeneity; (iv) 26 440 enhancers and 788 444 drug-enhancer associations, combined with potential target prediction, provide an exploratory epigenetic regulatory dimension; (v) enhanced search and browsing functionalities, together with seven tools for functional annotation, pan-cancer analysis, tumor microenvironment profiling, single-cell trajectory and CNV analysis, and enhancer-related analyses. In summary, RNAactDrug 2.0 is a crucial resource for the multi-omics dissection of drug sensitivity-associated molecules, providing important support for the discovery of drug resistance biomarkers and the advancement of personalized therapeutic strategies.

llm.novelty_zh: 将多组学药物敏感性关联数据、单细胞图谱与增强子信息整合为一个可检索的资源库，并增加功能分析工具。
llm.summary_zh: RNAactDrug 2.0更新了药物-RNA关联数据库，覆盖表达、拷贝数、突变和甲基化等层面，并纳入TCGA临床病例、单细胞RNA测序数据和增强子信息。该资源还提供泛癌分析、肿瘤微环境与单细胞轨迹等七种分析工具。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该资源为研究药物敏感性相关分子特征与耐药生物标志物提供了可直接使用的数据基础。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: Gene Expression Nebulas 2.0: an updated resource of gene expression profiles by incorporating more datasets, annotations, and functionalities
abstract: Gene Expression Nebulas (GEN; https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/gen/) is an open-access database that provides standardized transcriptomic profiles and manually curated metadata across diverse species. Compared with the previous release, the updated GEN has expanded in terms of datasets from 323 to 668, samples from 50 500 to 102 679, cells from 15 540 169 to 23 461 252, and species from 30 to 100. GEN 2.0 adds spatial transcriptomics data and disease-associated expression annotations from 82 human bulk RNA-seq datasets spanning 62 disease categories, including distinct subtypes, across 12 disease systems. In addition, it has been significantly upgraded by providing high-quality gene expression profiles for artificial intelligence applications, a web-based service to accept transcriptomic data submission, and an updated online analysis tool for gene expression comparisons across species, tissues, and diseases. Together, GEN offers more comprehensive, standardized gene expression profiles across diverse species and thus serves as a fundamental resource for uncovering molecular functional mechanisms and deciphering complex regulatory architecture.
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

llm.novelty_zh: 在旧版基础上扩展至668个数据集，并新增空间转录组、疾病注释与面向AI的标准化表达谱。
llm.summary_zh: GEN 2.0是标准化转录组资源，覆盖100个物种的668个数据集和102679个样本，新增空间转录组以及82个人类bulk RNA-seq数据集的疾病注释。平台还提供AI用途的高质量表达谱、数据提交服务和跨物种、组织与疾病的在线比较工具。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为跨物种和跨疾病的基因表达比较提供标准化资源，对基础数据设施建设有实际价值。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及数据标准化与注释的质量评估，也未说明数据提交的审核标准。

title: iCellOmics: connecting multi-omics profiles and phenotype evidence across industrially relevant cell lines
abstract: Industrially relevant cell lines include direct production hosts for biologics, vaccines, and viral vectors, as well as biomedical models that serve as references for host-cell engineering and comparative studies. However, their genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic profiles, together with literature-derived phenotype information, remain distributed across different repositories, project outputs, and publications. Here, we present iCellOmics (https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/icellomics), an open-access database that integrates multi-omics data for industrially relevant cell lines within a unified data and analysis framework. The current release covers 17 cell lines and provides reference genomes for seven species, encompassing 144 018 protein-coding genes, 170 408 888 genomic variants, 673 differential-expression comparisons, 30 distinct single-cell RNA-seq BioProjects comprising 1 047 274 cells, 287 089 415 ATAC-seq peaks, 37 213 deduplicated literature-curated gene-phenotype relationships spanning 104 standardized phenotype subcategories. The database supports both cell line-centric browsing of available datasets and gene-centric exploration of cross-omics analysis results. Additionally, iCellOmics offers online GO and KEGG enrichment analysis tools to facilitate further data exploration. In summary, iCellOmics provides a valuable starting point for investigating gene-phenotype relationships in industrially relevant cell lines and supports cell-line engineering and the development of improved producer lines.
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

llm.novelty_zh: 整合工业相关细胞系的多组学数据、单细胞图谱与文献来源的表型关系，形成统一的分析数据库。
llm.summary_zh: iCellOmics是工业相关细胞系的多组学数据库，覆盖17个细胞系和7个物种的参考基因组，收录约104.7万个单细胞及大量表达与表观组数据。平台还包含3.7万余条文献来源的基因表型关系，并提供GO和KEGG在线富集分析。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为工业细胞系的基因型-表型关联研究和细胞株工程提供了便捷的数据参考。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及表型关系的置信度评估及数据更新频率。

title: CROST 2.0: an expanded repository of spatial transcriptomics
abstract: CROST (https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/crost) is a public spatial transcriptomics resource that offers curated datasets, standardized analytical results, structured spatial knowledge, and interactive exploration tools. In version 2.0, our collection has expanded to 544 projects and 3538 samples, nearly a three-fold increase from version 1.0 (182 projects and 1033 samples). We have also substantially expanded the derived resources for spatial colocalization and spatially variable cancer genes. To facilitate spatial microenvironment analysis, CROST 2.0 introduces an analytical framework comprising niche-associated differential expression, spatially resolved gene-set activity analysis, spatial interaction hotspot and topic analyses, and molecular and cell-type niche analysis. CROST 2.0 also provides the Spatial Compare function to compare spatial gene expression, cell-type distributions, and niche composition across samples. It introduces the Cancer NicheDE module to systematically characterize cancer niche-associated differential expression and integrates an online cell-type annotation tool, SCType, enabling the use of single-cell reference information in spatial transcriptomic analysis. These updates extend CROST into an integrated spatial transcriptomics resource for characterizing spatial microenvironments, investigating cancer-associated spatial features, and comparing spatial patterns across samples.
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

llm.novelty_zh: 在空间转录组资源中加入微环境分析框架、癌症生态位差异表达模块以及跨样本的Spatial Compare功能。
llm.summary_zh: CROST 2.0收录544个项目和3538个样本，扩展了空间共定位与空间可变癌症基因的衍生资源。平台提供生态位相关差异表达、空间互作热点、SCType细胞类型注释等分析功能，用于比较样本间的空间微环境。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为空间转录组的微环境研究提供了规模扩大的公共资源和分析工具，便于跨样本比较。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及数据质量控制标准及注释准确性的评估。

title: CellStressDB: an AI-powered database of cellular responses to physical stressors
abstract: Physical stressors profoundly influence cellular behavior by triggering coordinated stress-response programs that regulate signaling, gene expression, metabolism, and cell fate. Here, we present CellStressDB (https://cellstressdb.omic.tech), an AI-powered database for exploring cellular responses to physical stressors. The current release contains data from 131 transcriptomic studies, with 2 364 816 cell and 1205 bulk sample observations from human and mouse across nine physical-stress classes and 21 tissue categories. Data and analyses are organized into 2848 indexed analysis entries across 71 canonical species-tissue-stress contexts with detailed exposure conditions retained. CellStressDB provides ontology-guided cell-type annotation through 22 tissue-aware classifiers and incorporates 941 Geneformer checkpoints for context-specific in silico perturbation. Analyses include stress-response programs, differential gene expression, functional enrichment, regulon activity, cell-type composition, and cell-cell communication where applicable, with candidate compound prioritization, downloadable datasets and models, and analysis of user-provided transcriptomic data. Annotation evaluation and known-factor recovery analyses indicated context-dependent performance and coverage across biological settings. The mouse radiation-intestine example identifies Stat1 as a candidate regulator of radiation-induced intestinal injury supported by independent experimental evidence. Overall, CellStressDB provides an integrated, AI-enabled framework for exploring and interpreting cellular responses to physical stressors and generating testable hypotheses.

llm.novelty_zh: 整合131项转录组研究的物理应激细胞响应数据库，并提供基于Geneformer的计算机扰动分析。
llm.summary_zh: 作者发布CellStressDB，包含131项转录组研究、约236万个细胞和1205个批量样本，覆盖9类物理应激与21类组织。数据库提供组织感知的细胞类型注释分类器、941个Geneformer检查点用于计算机扰动，以及可下载的数据与模型。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为检索和解释物理应激响应提供了一站式资源，可直接复用数据与模型生成可检验假设。
llm.limitations_zh: 注释性能随生物学语境而异，覆盖范围也不均衡，摘要指出其表现依赖语境。

title: scCVD: a comprehensive single-cell omics atlas of cerebrovascular disease
abstract: Cerebrovascular disease (CVD) is the leading cause of death and disability worldwide. Initially insulting the cerebral vasculature, CVD pathology engages the entire neurovascular unit, including endothelial and mural cells, astrocytes, microglia, neurons, and the perivascular fibroblasts and infiltrating peripheral immune cells. Single-cell studies over CVD have generated enormous scattered and heterogeneously annotated atlases, which never supplement an organized visualization and an integrated analysis. Here, we present scCVD (https://scportal.cn/sccvd), an integrated single-cell database of scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq data for CVD that characterises expression patterns and chromatin accessibility of CVD-related genes across diverse cell types and disease stages. The current release comprises 701 high-quality samples from four species (human, mouse, rat, and marmoset), encompassing over 4.68 million cells. All datasets were manually curated and standardized, with harmonised metadata covering disease versus control status, disease time points and experimental interventions. scCVD provides analysis modules for differential expression, functional enrichment, trajectory inference, cell-cell communication, transcription factor regulatory networks, and chromatin accessibility, together with interactive visualisation. scCVD also supports convenient data browsing and retrieval, customisable online analysis and batch download, facilitating systematic investigation of cellular heterogeneity and molecular regulatory mechanisms in CVD.
affiliations: First Affiliated Hospital of University of South China
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
Beijing Institute for Stem Cell and Regenerative Medicine

llm.novelty_zh: 整合多物种、多样本的脑血管疾病单细胞数据，并统一元数据与分析模块。
llm.summary_zh: scCVD 是脑血管疾病单细胞组学数据库，统一收录 701 个高质量样本，涵盖人、小鼠、大鼠和狨猴，共约 468 万个细胞。数据经过人工整理并统一了疾病状态、时间点与干预等元数据。平台提供差异表达、功能富集、轨迹推断、细胞通讯与转录因子网络等在线分析模块。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为脑血管疾病的单细胞研究提供可检索、可批量下载的标准化数据资源。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: The molecular phenotypes of null alleles in cells (MorPhiC) data resource
abstract: The MorPhiC Data Portal is the public resource for the Molecular Phenotypes of Null Alleles in Cells (MorPhiC) Consortium, which maps molecular and cellular consequences of targeted human gene inactivation. The portal integrates raw, processed and uniformly analyzed datasets from functional genomics and phenotyping assays, including bulk and single-cell RNA-seq, Perturb-seq, SLAM-seq, chromatin-accessibility profiling, and metabolomics. Release 4 (August 2026) expands the resource to perturbations of >300 genes in human induced pluripotent stem cells and derivative systems, including embryoid bodies, organoids, and differentiated models, using complementary perturbation strategies targeting DNA, RNA, and protein products. A central advance is gene-centered navigation: gene pages consolidate experimental context, perturbation strategies, cell models, datasets, phenotyping evidence, and standardized analyses, while interactive visualizations expose differential expression, enrichment, and assay-specific results. Dataset pages provide metadata, protocols, analysis summaries, and links to public repositories for raw and processed files; the portal also catalogs consortium-generated knockout cell lines. By integrating MorPhiC datasets with external annotations on essentiality, Mendelian disease associations and mammalian phenotypes, and by standardizing metadata, analysis outputs and archive submission workflows, the portal provides a reusable resource for studying human gene loss-of-function at scale. The resource is available at https://morphic.bio/data.

datasets_used: MorPhiC consortium datasets (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq, Perturb-seq, SLAM-seq, chromatin accessibility, metabolomics)
llm.novelty_zh: 将人类基因功能缺失（null allele）的多组学、多扰动策略数据整合为以基因为中心的可检索门户，并扩展到 300 余个基因在 iPSC 及衍生模型中的扰动。
llm.summary_zh: 该门户是 MorPhiC 联盟的公共数据资源，整合了 bulk/单细胞 RNA-seq、Perturb-seq、SLAM-seq、染色质可及性和代谢组学等功能基因组数据，并统一了元数据与分析流程。Release 4 将覆盖 300 余个基因在 iPSC 及类器官、胚状体等衍生系统中，使用针对 DNA、RNA 和蛋白产物的互补扰动策略。门户还以基因为中心组织实验背景、细胞模型、数据集与表型证据，并与必需性、孟德尔疾病和哺乳动物表型等外部注释关联。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 这是面向人类基因功能缺失大规模扰动数据的统一基础设施，可直接为扰动响应预测和虚拟细胞模型提供标准化训练与评测数据。其基因中心的导航和标准化归档流程也便于社区复用。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要主要描述门户功能与数据范围，未给出数据质量验证、基线评测或下游模型性能等实证结果。

title: DrugMAP 3.0: an enriched molecular atlas featuring ADMET endpoints, pharmacogenomic perturbations, and bioactivity atlas of drugs
abstract: The paradigm of targeted therapeutics has shifted from static drug-target interactions to systemic absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) endpoints, dynamic transcriptomic perturbation signatures, and quantitative binding affinities, thereby amplifying the demand for multidimensional pharmacological atlases. In other words, it is necessary to bridge systemic safety profiles, cellular responses, and molecular interactions. However, such integrative data were inadequately covered by existing databases. In this study, DrugMAP was therefore substantially updated, which accumulated (i) 112 470 fine-grained ADMET endpoint profiles covering 126 endpoints for over 7680 drugs; (ii) 406 360 pharmacogenomic signatures for 3484 chemical perturbations and 11 033 molecules; and (iii) a quantitative bioactivity atlas covering molecular affinities, cellular sensitivity, and cytotoxicity for over 15 812 drugs and 4155 drug-interacting molecules. With the growing demand for quantitative pharmacology and the rapidly growing interest in AI-assisted drug discovery, DrugMAP is expected to act as an indispensable supplement to existing databases to facilitate drug discovery. DrugMAP is freely accessible at https://idrblab.org/drugmap/.
affiliations: Second Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University

title: RNA fine-tunes KAT5 activity to shape chromatin acetylation during active transcription
abstract: KAT5 is a prominent histone acetyltransferase that deposits acetylation on histone H4 to regulate transcription, genome stability, and cell fate decisions. Although the chromatin recruitment of KAT5 and its associated NuA4/TIP60 complex is well characterized, the molecular mechanisms that regulate its catalytic activity are still largely unknown. Here, we identify RNA as a direct and reversible modulator of KAT5 activity. Using single-end enhanced crosslinking and immunoprecipitation sequencing (seCLIP-seq), we find that KAT5 binds RNA in cells with a strong preference for GC-rich mRNA sequences enriched near transcription start sites. Unexpectedly, loss of KAT5-RNA interactions during acute transcriptional inhibition triggers rapid and pronounced promoter hyperacetylation. Biochemical and structural analyses suggest that RNA engages an RNA-sensing autoinhibitory region within the HAT domain, sterically blocking substrate access to the catalytic pocket and thereby suppressing KAT5 acetyltransferase activity. Our findings uncover nascent RNA as a reversible allosteric inhibitor of KAT5, revealing an RNA-directed feedback mechanism that modulates promoter acetylation and gene expression.

llm.novelty_zh: 发现RNA作为可逆的变构抑制剂，通过占据KAT5催化口袋调控其乙酰转移酶活性。
llm.summary_zh: 研究利用seCLIP-seq发现KAT5偏好结合靠近转录起始位点的富含GC的mRNA。转录抑制时KAT5与RNA的相互作用丧失，导致启动子超乙酰化。生化与结构分析表明，RNA通过结合HAT结构域中的自抑制区域阻断底物进入催化口袋。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了新生RNA对组蛋白乙酰化的反馈调控机制。

title: scMINA: an interpretable workflow for paired scRNA-scATAC multiome integration and regulatory prioritization.
abstract: Single-cell multiomic technologies that jointly profile transcriptomic and epigenomic states provide unprecedented opportunities to investigate cellular heterogeneity and gene regulatory mechanisms in complex diseases. However, analysis of paired single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) and chromatin accessibility (scATAC-seq) data remains computationally challenging due to modality-specific technical variation, integration complexity, and limited interpretability of downstream regulatory inference. Here, we present scMINA (single-cell Multimodal Integration and Network Attribution), a modular and interpretable analytical workflow for the analysis of paired single-cell multiome datasets. scMINA comprises coordinated modules for multimodal integration, technical covariate correction, and regulatory feature prioritization, enabling systematic characterization of cellular states across transcriptomic and epigenomic modalities. In addition, scMINA incorporates explainable artificial intelligence-based attribution strategies to prioritize candidate genes and transcription factors associated with cell-state heterogeneity and disease-related regulatory alterations. We applied scMINA to the single-cell multiome data from the Seattle Alzheimer's Disease Brain Cell Atlas, where the workflow robustly resolved major glial cell populations and identified regulatory features associated with Alzheimer's disease pathology. By coupling multimodal integration with interpretable regulatory prioritization, scMINA provides a practical workflow for systematic analysis and biological interpretation of paired scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq datasets.

title: In Silico to In Vitro: Defining and Modeling Progenitor Programs in Pediatric Brain Tumors
abstract: Pediatric brain tumors remain a leading cause of cancer-related death in children and lack effective targeted therapies and faithful human models. Mounting evidence suggests these tumors co-opt normal neurodevelopmental programs, raising the possibility that mapping tumor states onto the developing brain can expose therapeutic vulnerabilities. We set out to identify conserved progenitor programs across pediatric tumors, model them in a patient-derived organoid system, and interrogate candidate dependencies using perturb-seq. We aggregated 10 single-cell RNA sequencing datasets spanning 15 pathologies and projected tumor transcriptomes onto a developmental brain reference to identify shared lineage programs, systematically comparing cell-type abundances across diagnoses. Cross-tumor projection revealed broad enrichment of radial glia and oligodendrocyte progenitor-like states across pediatric brain tumors, with radial glia programs most strikingly enriched in ependymoma, a diagnosis with limited targeted options and few faithful preclinical models. To probe this dependency in a human-relevant context, we established the first patient-derived ependymoma cortical organoid co-culture system and benchmarked it against the parent tumor using single-cell RNA sequencing. The model retained the cellular diversity of patient ependymomas, preserving radial glia-like progenitors and lineage-committed populations otherwise lost in conventional culture. The platform further supported a perturb-seq CRISPR screen targeting genes enriched in radial glia, with confirmed guide delivery and on-target knockdown, establishing a foundation for functional dissection of ependymoma vulnerabilities. Together, these results deliver a single-cell atlas pinpointing radial glia-like progenitors as a conserved feature of pediatric brain tumors and most pronounced in ependymoma, the first patient-derived ependymoma organoid model, and a coupled CRISPR screening platform. Overall, this establishes an end-to-end in silico to in vitro pipeline that translates developmental biology into lineage-based therapeutic strategies for pediatric brain tumors.

llm.novelty_zh: 首次建立患者来源的室管膜瘤皮质类器官共培养体系，并在其中支持 Perturb-seq 筛选平台。
llm.summary_zh: 作者整合了 10 个单细胞数据集，将小儿脑肿瘤转录组投影到发育脑参考上，发现放射状胶质样与少突胶质祖细胞样状态在多种肿瘤中富集，其中室管膜瘤最为明显。研究随后构建了患者来源的室管膜瘤皮质类器官共培养体系，并在其中支持针对放射状胶质相关基因的 Perturb-seq CRISPR 筛选。

title: OS09.5.A Virtual Cell Transplantation in Spatial Transcriptomics Models Tissue Context-Dependent Cell Phenotypes Across Brain States and Glioblastoma
abstract: Cell states and phenotypic heterogeneity in glioblastoma are predominantly regulated by dynamic local cell-cell interactions within the tumor microenvironment. If the impact of these microenvironmental interactions can be learned, large parts of the cellular molecular programs become predictable. Here, we established GATMovin, a deep-learning framework designed to decode the local dependencies of tumor niches and predict cellular transcriptional changes ,enabling in silico simulation of cell movement and invasion across tissue contexts.We integrated multiple internal and external single-cell spatially resolved datasets across diseases (n = 12) and species (n = 2) (total 273 datasets), including Xenium human glioblastoma samples (n = 9, 5,001 genes). GATMovin uses a staged architecture: a bridge encoder maps panel expression, cell-type identity, and Nicheformer alignment features into a shared latent space; same-type nearest neighbors provide soft anchors; and donor-conditioned graph attention predicts residual latent shifts after in silico perturbations such as virtual transplantation or movement across niches, while preserving lineage cell identity. Results are explorable at gat-movin.com for interactive querying. In glioblastoma (9 Xenium samples, 5,001 genes, n = 221,847 cells), virtual relocation of T cells from tumor periphery to core produced directional shifts toward exhaustion-associated phenotypes, with upregulation of PDCD1, HAVCR2, and TOX (sign consistency 0.89; q < 0.01) and suppression of cytotoxic effector genes GZMB and PRF1 (mean fold-change −2.3 at core niches). Neighborhood perturbation confirmed ligand-driven regulation: in silico upregulation of CD274 in myeloid neighbors produced dose-dependent suppression of GZMB in center T cells (−38% at 10× dose; Wilcoxon p < 0.001, n = 30 neighborhoods).Tumor-associated macrophage states were niche-constrained: virtual transplantation into hypoxic core niches shifted myeloid cells toward immunosuppressive programs (R² = 0.81). Predictions preserved coarse cell identity (type drift rate 7.1%) and outperformed shuffled-niche controls (P = 0.004). Together, these demonstrate that GBM cell states are predominantly niche-driven rather than cell-autonomous, and GATMovin can decode the ligand-receptor interactions governing these transitions , providing a spatially resolved framework to prioritize microenvironmental targets.GATMovin demonstrates that GBM cell states are predominantly shaped by their local tissue context rather than fixed lineage programs. Applied to glioblastoma, it provides an interpretable framework to quantify microenvironmental control of tumor and immune cell states, decode the ligand-receptor interactions driving niche-dependent transitions, and generate spatially informed hypotheses for therapeutic targeting and response stratification.

llm.novelty_zh: 用多阶段图注意力在空间单细胞数据上做计算机模拟的细胞移位与虚拟移植。

title: P01.05.A Perturbation sequencing to uncover new regulators of glioblastoma cell-states
abstract: Background Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most common primary brain tumor in adults and remains among the cancer types with the worst prognosis. Today’s standard treatment of care for GBM, a combination of surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy, is ineffective in preventing recurrence. GBMs are genetically and transcriptionally heterogeneous and can exist in different and plastic cell-states, contributing to local invasion and therapy resistance. Yet, we lack a structured understanding of how GBM cell states are regulated and if they can be modulated to therapeutic ends. Material and Methods Here, we adapt a Perturb-seq pipeline, a combination of high throughput CRISPR/Cas9 screening with single cell RNA sequencing, to patient-derived cell line xenograft (PDCX) models for a relevant in vivo setting. We expose different cell lines that recapitulate glioblastoma heterogeneity to a guide RNA library targeting 112 potential regulators of GBM cell states. Using machine learning, we associate each regulator with its downstream transcriptional impact. We later validate our findings as single knock-outs and assess their tumorigenicity and therapeutic vulnerability. Results Our results from three patient-derived cell lines reveals that there can be genetic bottleneck events during tumor formation. Through our analysis, we identify regulators where the knock-out leads to an abundance in AC-like, MES-like, OPC and NPC-like states. We follow-up the regulators whose depletion creates more developmental transcriptional profile by creating single knock-outs and assess their invasiveness and response to standard treatment as well as other targeted therapies. Conclusion Despite the demanding in vivo setting, our pipeline reveals many different regulators of GBM cell-states. Steering cells into a single state may overcome the challenge of varied therapeutic response caused by cellular heterogeneity. Cells existing in more developmental cell-states may reveal vulnerabilities to therapeutic targets.

llm.novelty_zh: 将 Perturb-seq 应用于胶质母细胞瘤患者来源异种移植模型，以寻找细胞状态调控因子。
llm.summary_zh: 研究在三个患者来源细胞系的 PDCX 模型中，用包含 112 个候选调控因子的 gRNA 文库进行 Perturb-seq，并通过单敲除验证侵袭性与治疗敏感性。结果提示肿瘤形成时存在遗传瓶颈，部分敲除导致更偏发育状态的细胞。

title: Bacterial protein function prediction via multimodal deep learning
abstract: Bacterial proteins are specialized with extensive functional diversity for survival in diverse and stressful environments. A significant portion of these proteins remains functionally uncharacterized, limiting our understanding of bacterial survival mechanisms. Hence, we develop Deep Expression STructure (DeepEST), a multimodal deep learning framework that predicts protein function in bacteria by assigning Gene Ontology (GO) terms. DeepEST comprises two modules: a multi-layer perceptron that uses gene expression and gene location, and a protein structure-based module that uses predicted structures and amino acid sequences. Within DeepEST, we integrate these modules through a learnable weighted linear combination and introduce a novel masked loss function to fine-tune the structure-based predictor for bacterial species. These choices are well suited for bacteria, in which functionally related genes frequently colocalize and are cotranscribed within operons, allowing transcription dynamics to serve as informative, condition-dependent signals. We show that DeepEST outperforms existing protein function prediction methods on a 25-species benchmark, relying solely on amino acid sequence or protein structure. Averaged over the 25 species, DeepEST reaches a protein-centric F max of 0.689 and a term-centric micro-AUPRC of 0.756, a relative improvement of 4.4% and 11.6% over the second-best method, the structure-based predictor DeepFRI. Moreover, DeepEST predicts GO terms for unclassified hypothetical proteins across 25 human bacterial pathogens, supporting their experimental characterization. DeepEST bridges organism-specific data integration and structure-based transfer learning, providing a method tailored for bacterial protein function prediction in settings with structural and multi-condition expression data.

llm.novelty_zh: 融合表达与基因位置模块和预测结构模块，并引入掩码损失对结构模型进行细菌物种微调。
llm.summary_zh: DeepEST 是一个多模态深度学习框架，利用细菌基因表达、基因位置、预测蛋白结构及氨基酸序列预测 GO 功能。作者在 25 个物种的基准上报告其优于 DeepFRI 等方法，并为人类病原菌中未表征的蛋白提供 GO 注释。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作为细菌蛋白功能注释提供了工具，可辅助未表征蛋白的实验研究，与虚拟细胞建模没有直接关系。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: Multimodal Integration Identifies C16orf74 as an EMT Regulator With Prognostic Relevance in HNSCC.
abstract: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is an aggressive malignancy characterized by marked intratumoral heterogeneity and poor clinical outcomes. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) promotes metastasis, immune evasion, and therapeutic resistance. However, the key molecular determinants underlying EMT-associated malignant states remain incompletely defined, and their translation into clinically accessible tools is challenging. In this study, we performed an integrative multiomics analysis to dissect malignant epithelial heterogeneity in HNSCC. Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) identified a highly malignant EMT epithelial subpopulation characterized by elevated genomic instability and terminal malignant states. Furthermore, an ensemble of machine learning algorithms prioritized C16orf74 as a key EMT-associated malignant regulator. Spatial transcriptomics localized C16orf74 spatially concentrated at invasive-front and transitory regions associated with distinct tumor microenvironmental niches. Gain- and loss-of-function assays confirmed that C16orf74 regulates EMT activation, migration, invasion, and tumor-sphere formation in HNSCC cells. Mechanistically, integrative regulon, transcriptomic, spatial, and functional analyses identified high-mobility group AT-hook 2 (HMGA2) as a candidate downstream mediator of C16orf74-associated EMT. To translate these biological insights into clinical practice, we developed an EMT-based pathomics prognostic model using hematoxylin and eosin-stained whole-slide images, which achieved robust prognostic stratification. Notably, high-risk group interpretably exhibited a positive correlation with C16orf74 expression, EMT enrichment, an immunosuppressive microenvironment, and resistance to standard chemotherapeutic agents. Collectively, our findings identify C16orf74 as a putative EMT regulator and develop a clinically accessible pathomics model for prognostic and therapeutic stratification in HNSCC.

title: Noncanonical enhancers control gene expression and cell fate in human pluripotent stem cells
abstract: Enhancers are key gene regulatory elements that ensure the precise spatiotemporal execution of developmental gene expression programs. However, recent findings indicate that current approaches to identify enhancers may not capture the full repertoire of active enhancers in mammalian genomes. Here, we combine massively parallel enhancer assays with chromatin structure and transcriptome profiling to functionally annotate enhancers genome-wide in human induced pluripotent stem cells. We find that a substantial fraction (∼40%) of accessible chromatin regions with enhancer function lack key features associated with active enhancers, including the active enhancer mark histone H3 lysine-27 acetylation and enhancer-associated RNAs. Perturbation of this class of noncanonical enhancers by CRISPR-mediated epigenome editing or deletion results in decreased levels of target gene expression and, in one instance, loss of pluripotent stem cell characteristics. Collectively, our data demonstrate enhancer activity for a class of gene regulatory elements that had, until now, only been associated with a neutral or inactive status, challenging current models of enhancer function.
affiliations: HMU Health and Medical University Erfurt
Max Planck Institute for Multidisciplinary Sciences

llm.novelty_zh: 通过大规模并行增强子实验证明，缺乏经典增强子标记的一类可及染色质区域同样具有增强子功能。
llm.summary_zh: 作者结合大规模并行增强子检测、染色质结构与转录组分析，在人诱导多能干细胞中全基因组注释增强子。约 40% 具有增强子功能的可及区域缺乏 H3K27ac 等经典增强子标记。对这类非经典增强子进行 CRISPR 表观编辑或删除后，靶基因表达下降，并在一个案例中导致多能性特征丧失。

llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: Evolution of trans-regulatory architecture and gene expression dosage compensation after genome duplication
abstract: Whole-genome duplication (WGD) through polyploidization has played a major role in genome evolution across eukaryotes. While many well-studied WGDs involve allopolyploidization, autopolyploidization provides a distinct context because duplicated chromosomes initially originate from within the same species and retain high sequence similarity. A major consequence of WGD is the rewiring of gene regulatory networks, partly driven by selection on gene expression dosage. In multicellular organisms, evidence for dosage balance selection has relied largely on comparative patterns of duplicate gene retention and expression, with few studies directly examining regulatory architecture after WGD. Here, we analyzed a large-scale eQTL dataset from Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar), which experienced a salmonid-specific autopolyploid WGD approximately 80 to 100 million years ago. We found that trans-regulatory connections were preferentially retained between WGD-derived syntenic regions and that syntenic trans-eQTL pairs showed elevated three-dimensional genomic contact, suggesting partial preservation of spatial proximity between duplicated chromosomal regions. Overall, 230 duplicated gene pairs (5%) shared eQTLs, suggesting conserved regulatory control. Moreover, 16 gene pairs showed genotype-dependent compensatory expression effects mediated by a common regulator, consistent with predictions of the dosage balance hypothesis. These gene pairs were significantly enriched in late-rediploidizing regions. Our results indicate that a small subset of duplicated genes have retained dosage-balanced regulatory architecture long after WGD.
affiliations: UiT The Arctic University of Norway

llm.novelty_zh: 利用大RNA-seq eQTL数据揭示全基因组复制后反式调控结构在同源区域的保留。
llm.summary_zh: 研究分析大西洋鲑大规模eQTL数据，发现复制后同源区域之间的反式调控连接被优先保留，并伴随更高的三维基因组接触。约5%的复制基因对共享eQTL，其中16对表现出符合剂量平衡假说的补偿性表达效应。

title: Hoxa10 governs lifelong skeletal stem cell maintenance and bone repair
abstract: Skeletal stem and progenitor cells (SSPCs) sustain bone homeostasis and regeneration throughout life, yet the transcriptional programs that preserve their identity remain poorly defined. Here we identify the distal Hox gene Hoxa10 as a cell-autonomous regulator of skeletal stem cell maintenance. Using inducible genetic deletion, lineage tracing, single-cell transcriptomics, and injury models, we show that loss of Hoxa10 leads to progressive depletion of SSPCs, impaired bone regeneration, and defective matrix organization. Mechanistically, Hoxa10 maintains the undifferentiated state of skeletal stem cells by restraining premature osteogenic, adipogenic, and chondrogenic commitment, while promoting collagen III production and collagen fiber alignment within regenerative niches. Hoxa10-dependent regulation of extracellular matrix composition is restricted to primitive progenitors and is uncoupled from osteoblast differentiation. Notably, transient depletion of distal Hox genes in primary human SSPCs recapitulates the murine defects in proliferation, self-renewal, and differentiation restraint. Together, these findings define a conserved Hox-dependent program that preserves skeletal stem cell identity and regenerative competence, revealing how developmental transcription factors are repurposed to sustain the adult skeleton across the life span.
affiliations: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, NYU Grossman School of Medicine, New York, NY, USA.

llm.novelty_zh: 发现Hoxa10是维持骨骼干细胞未分化状态及胶原III组织的细胞自主调节因子。
llm.summary_zh: 研究利用诱导型基因敲除、谱系示踪和单细胞转录组，证明Hoxa10缺失会导致骨骼干/祖细胞逐渐耗竭、骨再生受损和基质组织异常。机制上Hoxa10通过抑制过早的成骨、成脂和成软骨分化来维持干细胞身份，并在人源骨骼干细胞中得到重现。

title: Genetic dissection of cell type–specific congenital heart disease variants reveals ETS1 control of vascular smooth muscle cell fate
abstract: Numerous congenital heart disease (CHD) risk variants lie in cis-regulatory elements, yet the impact of variants in repressed and bivalent chromatin on cell type-specific heart development is unclear. Here, we generated a single-cell multiomic atlas of human cardiac differentiation by jointly profiling H3K27ac, H3K27me3, H3K4me3, and transcriptomes in individual cells, classifying cis-regulatory elements into six chromatin states, enabling prioritization of 610 CHD-associated noncoding variants enriched in lineage- and state-specific regulatory elements, including repressive and bivalent regions. CRISPR knockin of selected variants perturbed nearby gene expression and impaired cardiac differentiation. Dissection of a Polycomb-marked variant near ETS1 (ETS proto-oncogene 1) revealed local H3K27me3 loss, H3K27ac gain, and ETS1 up-regulation, which redirects differentiation toward second-heart-field progenitors with epithelial characteristics at early stages and, ultimately, highly migratory ETS1+ vascular smooth muscle cells. Together, our work establishes a single-cell chromatin-state framework for interpreting noncoding CHD risk variants and uncovers an ETS1-driven program linking Polycomb-deregulated noncoding variation to aberrant vascular smooth muscle fate commitment during human cardiogenesis.
affiliations: The First People's Hospital of Shunde

llm.novelty_zh: 结合染色质状态的单细胞多组学图谱与 CRISPR knock-in，揭示 Polycomb 位点变异经 ETS1 影响血管平滑肌细胞命运。
llm.summary_zh: 作者联合分析 H3K27ac、H3K27me3、H3K4me3 与转录组，构建了人类心脏分化的单细胞多组学图谱，并优先筛选出 610 个先天性心脏病非编码变异。CRISPR knock-in 证实部分变异会扰动邻近基因表达并影响心肌分化。对 ETS1 附近 Polycomb 位点的研究显示，其使 ETS1 上调并引导细胞向血管平滑肌细胞分化。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为解释先天性心脏病非编码风险变异的细胞类型特异性作用提供了实验框架。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: GenNA: Conditional generation of nucleotide sequences guided by natural language annotations
abstract: Deciphering the mapping between biomolecular sequences and complex biological functions is a central challenge in genomics. While existing generative nucleotide models capture sequence distributions, they lack explicit access to gene-associated biological semantics, limiting semantics-guided design. Here, we present GenNA, a generative nucleotide foundation model guided by natural language annotations. Pretrained on a multimodal nucleotide-text corpus spanning 2221 eukaryotic species (∼416 billion characters), GenNA internalizes relationships between sequence syntax and functional semantics within a unified autoregressive framework. Without explicit rule-based supervision, GenNA yields distinguishable perplexity responses to sequence-annotation mismatches, mutational variants, and species-label perturbations. Furthermore, across diverse generation tasks, GenNA produces statistically plausible nucleotide sequences consistent with target semantics, structural constraints, and species contexts. Overall, GenNA provides a versatile framework for controllable nucleotide generation, establishing a practical route to integrate functional descriptions with sequence design.
affiliations: State Key Laboratory of Pharmaceutical Biotechnology

llm.novelty_zh: 以自然语言注释为条件训练核苷酸基础模型，使序列生成与功能语义、物种背景直接对齐。
llm.summary_zh: GenNA是基于自然语言注释的核苷酸生成基础模型，在覆盖2221个真核物种、约4160亿字符的多模态语料上预训练。摘要称其对序列与注释不匹配、突变及物种标签扰动的困惑度具有可区分的响应，并能在多种生成任务中产生符合目标语义、结构和物种背景的序列。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为基于功能描述的序列设计提供了统一的生成框架，与序列工程和扰动设计的交叉研究相关。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及与现有核苷酸生成模型的定量比较，也未说明生成序列的湿实验验证。

title: An in vivo overexpression screen of all human transcription factors to reprogram T cells for effective solid tumor immunotherapy
abstract: Background Despite recent advances in cellular immunotherapy demonstrating its curative potential, it is clear that retargeting T cells towards solid tumors is not sufficient to generate effective therapies. Therapeutic responses are often transient, likely because of the harsh tumor microenvironment and continuous antigen exposure that drives T cells into a programmed terminal state known as exhaustion. 1 One strategy to overcome T cell exhaustion and its associated loss of plasticity is to reprogram cells into alternative states using transcription factors (TFs), such as JUN or FOXO1.2–4 TF overexpression is capable of altering the natural differentiation trajectory of cells, an extreme example being the induction of pluripotency in adult fibroblasts by the 4 Yamanaka factors.5 However, no comprehensive unbiased screen has ever been performed to identify TFs that enhance T cell function.Methods We sought to systematically discover TFs capable of enhancing T cell expansion and counteracting exhaustion in solid tumors via overexpression. We performed gain-of-function screens introducing the open reading frames (ORFs) for all human TFs in CD4 and CD8 T cells. 6 Pools of TF overexpressing T cells were transferred to mice engrafted with A375 melanoma cells engineered to activate human T cells via anti-CD3 and co-expression of CD80 (A375-CD3/CD80). The transcriptional states induced by the most enriched TFs were further characterized within the solid tumor microenvironment using in vivo Perturb-seq (scRNAseq with pooled TF overexpression). Functional and mechanistic characterizations of TF modified T cells and CAR T cells were performed using multiple xenograft models.Results Our screen revealed multiple TF families that promote T cell expansion in vitro and in vivo, with many splice variants scoring similarly. We focused validation efforts on candidate TFs with divergent transcriptional states identified via Perturb-seq. HOXD8 overexpression led to enrichment of a stem/progenitor-like T cell gene signature, while POU2F3 expanded CD4 helper subsets and reduced markers of CD8 exhaustion. HOXD8 or POU2F3 overexpressing T cells were dramatically more effective at treating established A375-CD3/CD80 tumors than control cells. Furthermore, anti-Mesothelin CAR T cells overexpressing HOXD8 or POU2F3 outperformed control CAR T cells in solid tumors with transgenic (A375-MSLN) or endogenous (AsPC-1) Mesothelin expression.Conclusions In vivo screens of the entire TF-ome identify TFs that enhance T cell function in solid tumors. Candidate TFs such as HOXD8 and POU2F3 can dramatically improve the control of solid tumors via inducing unique transcriptional states that preserve T cell effector functions.Acknowledgements We thank Drs. llm.novelty_zh: 对全部人类转录因子进行体内过表达筛选，寻找可增强 T 细胞抗实体瘤功能的因子。
llm.summary_zh: 研究在 CD4 与 CD8 T 细胞中对全部人类转录因子进行过表达的体内筛选，并用 in vivo Perturb-seq 表征候选因子的转录状态。HOXD8 与 POU2F3 修饰的 T 细胞及 CAR T 细胞在多种异种移植模型中控制实体瘤的效果更好。

title: TRAILBLAZER: multicellular foundation modeling enables zero-shot prediction of patient-level responses to immunomodulatory perturbations
abstract: Background Most single-cell foundation models treat cells as independent observations, discarding the multicellular context that shapes tissue-level outcomes in vivo.1 Models trained on aggregated datasets often fail to generalize across donors, laboratories, or interventions because their latent spaces lack the structure needed to compose known elements and extrapolate beyond observed conditions. This limits their utility for predicting patient-specific responses to immunomodulatory therapies, where outcomes depend on coordinated changes across multiple immune populations.Methods We developed TRAILBLAZER, 2 a multicellular foundation model that represents tissues as coordinated systems of interacting cells. The encoder uses permutation-invariant Induced Set Attention Blocks3 in which learned latent tokens summarize global cellular context and redistribute it to recontextualize individual cells, an explicit information bottleneck that preserves two-hop global context while keeping compute and memory near-linear in group size. This advancement enables modeling thousands of coordinated cells. The model is paired with a count-aware generative decoder and a hyperspherical latent space organized around shared healthy reference states and calibrated mechanistic directions, supporting compositional reasoning and extrapolation to unseen agents. In a proof-of-concept application, the model predicts response to anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in breast cancer patients and prioritizes potential combination partners consistent with known immunotherapy synergies.Results We benchmarked TRAILBLAZER against three recent state-of-the-art single-cell and multicellular models, STACK, LPM, and CellFlow, on the PARSE PBMCs ex vivo dataset of 90 cytokine and immunomodulator treatments across 12 donors, predicting post-treatment scRNA-seq states for unseen treatments. TRAILBLAZER was the only model that generalized accurately to unseen treatments at the multicellular level. We then deployed TRAILBLAZER as a virtual trial engine in a held-out cohort of treatment-naive patients with primary invasive breast carcinoma who received a single pre-surgical dose of pembrolizumab. The model correctly reconstructed patient-level responsiveness on molecular and phenotypic axes, and enabled zero-shot in silico screening of combinations augmenting anti-PD-1, with top-ranked candidates corroborated by literature review.Conclusions TRAILBLAZER outperforms recent single-cell and multicellular baselines on zero-shot and few-shot prediction of immunomodulator responses and extends to patient-level virtual trials of checkpoint blockade in breast cancer. By scaling near-linearly with cell-set size while preserving single-cell resolution, it provides a tractable framework for in silico prioritization of immunomodulatory combinations in immuno-oncology. We have demonstrated that by deconvoluting mechanisms of actions on hyperspherical manifolds we can represent previously unseen treatments, providing practical solutions to sparse data.References Baek S, Song K, Lee I. Single-cell foundation models: bringing artificial intelligence into cell biology. Exp Mol Med. 2025;57:2169-2181.Neñer J, Selvamani P, Badarinarayan SS, Chandramohan N, Grzybowski A. TRAILBLAZER: generative multicellular perturbation model of biology. BioRxiv. 2026. doi:10.64898/2026.03.14.711710.Lee J, Lee Y, Kim J, Kosiorek AR, Choi S, Teh YW. Set Transformer: a framework for attention-based permutation-invariant neural networks. ArXiv. 2019. doi:10.48550/arXiv.1810.00825.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出多细胞基础模型，以集合注意力建模组织内的细胞相互作用，并用超球面潜空间支持对未见处理的组合推理。
llm.summary_zh: TRAILBLAZER把组织表示为相互作用的多细胞系统，使用诱导集合注意力编码器和计数感知的生成解码器。它在PARSE PBMC数据上对未见处理的预测优于STACK、LPM和CellFlow，并在乳腺癌患者队列上重现了pembrolizumab的患者层面反应，支持组合候选的零样本筛选。

llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: Abstract 17928: Cardiomyocyte-Specific AAV9-miRNA Platform for Loss of Function Target Validation in Preclinical HFpEF Models
abstract: Background: More than half of heart failure patients have heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF). Despite recent strides, HFpEF remains less druggable than HF with reduced ejection fraction, which responds to multi-modal regimens. HFpEF drug discovery is made more difficult because tool small molecules are rarely available for novel targets and genetic knockout cannot conveniently and rapidly validate loss-of-function (LoF) physiology in complex models like the ZSF1 obese rat. We therefore developed a miRNA system that, together with our in vivo perturb-seq platform, identifies and validates human-relevant targets at scale. Hypothesis: A cardiomyocyte-specific adeno associated virus 9 (AAV)synthetic miRNA system can serve as a robust platform for LoF target validation in complex preclinical HFpEF models including the ZSF1 obese rat. Methods: Using self-complementaryAAV9 under a cardiomyocyte-specific promoter, we expressed mScarlet-I and a synthetic miRNA hairpin or a scramble control to achieve RNAi-mediated knockdown (KD). We targeted Myh6 for LoF in young, healthy male C57BL/6J mice and SD rats for 4–6 weeks. In ZSF1 obese rats (a multi-morbid model recapitulating human HFpEF, the same system was used to address a range of targets spanning high-to-low expression in cardiomyocytes using a dose range between 10 1 1 and 10 1 3 vector genomes, aiming to confirm durable KD at 12 weeks post-injection. Endpoints included mScarlet-I histology, left ventricular (LV) RT-qPCR (target, Nppb), serial echocardiography, plasma NT-proBNP, and terminal invasive hemodynamics. Results: Multiple miRNA hairpins achieved >90% Myh6 KD in healthy mice and rats, with histology confirming widespread cardiomyocyte mScarlet-I expression. In mice, Myh6 depletion caused LV dilation with reduced EF, stroke volume, and cardiac output, and increased heart mass, peak tricuspid regurgitation, and NT-proBNP. EFcorrelated with LV Nppb and plasma NT-proBNP. In healthy rats, KD induced milder cardiac phenotype— non-significant reduction in EF, increased LV and heart mass — likely reflecting greater compensatory reserve. In ZSF1 obese rats, miRNA achieved KD of all targets tested across the dose range, establishing the lowest effective dose for each and confirming knockdown at 12 weeks despite differing basal expression levels. We have thus robustly validated a system for LoF in a clinically relevant HFpEF model. Conclusions: These results validate a cardiomyocyte-specific AAV-miRNA system for LoF target validation at scale — in an established complex HFpEF model and across targets spanning constitutive expression levels, directly establishing both dose and construct selection for our system in order to achieve saturating KD and ultimately enabling target-validation studies for novel targets without available tool compounds or genetic models. .
keywords: heart failure with preserved ejection fraction

llm.novelty_zh: 用心肌细胞特异性 AAV9 合成 miRNA 系统在 HFpEF 模型中进行功能缺失靶点验证。
llm.summary_zh: 该会议摘要报告一种心肌细胞特异性 AAV9 合成 miRNA 平台，用于在小鼠与大鼠 HFpEF 模型中进行功能缺失靶点验证。研究在 ZSF1 肥胖大鼠中测试了不同表达水平的靶点，并以心室功能等指标作为终点。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为难以用小分子干预的心衰靶点提供体内验证工具，与虚拟细胞关系较弱。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要仅列出方法与终点，未给出具体结果。

title: Abstract 6532: Endothelial Cell Polygenic Risk and Coronary Artery Disease on Coronary CT Angiography
abstract: Background: An endothelial cell polygenic risk score (EC PRS) has been shown to predict cardiovascular (CV) events and response to lipid lowering therapy. How it associates with coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA)-defined plaque characteristics is unknown. Methods: All patients at Mass General Brigham (MGB) without a prior history of coronary artery disease (CAD) who were genotyped in the MGB Biobank and had a CCTA performed between 2004-2021 were included. Genetic stratification was performed with a previously validated EC PRS comprised of 35 CAD disease variants identified using a large scale cellular assay (Perturb-seq) in endothelial cells. High PRS was defined as the top decile and low as the bottom decile. The presence and severity of CAD on CCTA was categorized using a standardized reporting system as absent (CAD RADS 0), non-obstructive (CAD RADS 1,2), or obstructive (CAD-RADS 3-5). Extensive plaque was defined as involving ≥3 vessels. Relative risk (RR) was assessed using multivariable regression models. Among patients with available LDL-C values who were not receiving lipid-lowering therapy, we tested EC PRS-by-LDL-C interaction for each outcome. Results: Among 1,991 patients, coronary plaque was present in 65.6%, extensive plaque in 32.2%, and obstructive disease in 24.6%. Beyond traditional cardiovascular risk factors, EC PRS was independently associated with plaque presence, extent, and severity (Figure 1A). A high compared to low EC PRS was modestly associated with the presence of plaque (aRR 1.13, 95% CI 1.01-1.27; P=0.032), more strongly associated with plaque severity (aRR 1.49, 95% CI 1.07-2.06; P=0.018), and showed the strongest association with plaque extent (aRR 1.60, 95% CI 1.25-2.06; P<0.001). The risk conferred for plaque extent in those in the highest decile of EC PRS was comparable in magnitude to traditional risk factors including age, male sex, dyslipidemia and hypertension (Figure 1B). Among patients not on lipid-lowering therapy (34.1%), LDL-C modified the association between EC PRS and plaque extent (P-interaction=0.041, Figure 1C). The association between EC PRS and plaque extent strengthened with increasing LDL-C concentration; each 1-SD higher EC PRS was associated with a 7% higher relative risk of greater plaque extent at an LDL-C of 100 mg/dL (RR 1.07, 95% CI 0.95-1.21), a 17% higher risk at 130 mg/dL (RR 1.17, 95% CI 1.04-1.32), and a 21% higher risk at 160 mg/dL (RR 1.21, 95% CI 1.05-1.40). Consistent with this interaction, among patients with high EC PRS not receiving lipid-lowering therapy, extensive plaque was 1.7-fold more prevalent in patients with LDL-C ≥ 130 compared with LDL-C <130 mg/dL (40.0% vs 23.1%; Figure 1D). Conclusions: EC PRS captures an axis of atherosclerotic risk that is not currently captured in clinical practice and can potentially be useful to identify patients who are more susceptible to elevated LDL-C.

llm.novelty_zh: 将内皮细胞多基因风险评分与冠状动脉 CT 血管造影的斑块特征及 LDL-C 交互关联起来。
llm.summary_zh: 研究纳入 MGB 生物样本库中 1,991 名未患冠心病、做过 CCTA 的患者，用由内皮细胞扰动实验构建的 35 位点 EC PRS 分层，考察其与斑块存在、范围和严重程度的关联。结果显示高 EC PRS 与更广泛的斑块相关，并且在未用降脂药的人群中与 LDL-C 存在交互作用。

title: Multicenter CT-Based Deep Learning for Preoperative Nodal Risk Stratification in Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma.
abstract: Background Accurate preoperative risk stratification for lymph node metastasis (LNM) in papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) remains difficult. We developed and validated ThyLNT, a Transformer-based 2.5D deep learning model using preoperative computed tomography (CT), and explored related biological features in multi-omics analyses. Methods A total of 1560 patients with PTC from six hospitals were retrospectively included. The Tongji Hospital cohort was divided into training and internal validation sets, and five external cohorts were used for independent testing. Seven 2.5D tumor slices were extracted per patient, encoded with a DenseNet201 backbone, and fused by a Transformer. Model performance was compared with radiomics, ensemble learning, and multi-instance learning using AUC, calibration, decision curve, and precision-recall analyses. Bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, and spatial metabolomics were used to explore related biological features. Results ThyLNT achieved an AUC of 0.882 (CI, 0.858-0.905) in the training cohort, 0.787 (CI, 0.738-0.835) in the internal validation cohort, and 0.772 (CI, 0.662-0.878) to 0.827 (CI, 0.763-0.885) across the five external cohorts. It showed multicenter discrimination, whereas calibration and threshold-dependent operating characteristics varied across cohorts. Multi-omics analyses provided exploratory biological context, including candidate associations with vascular endothelial growth factor A-related signaling and lipid metabolism. Conclusions ThyLNT demonstrated multicenter performance for preoperative LNM prediction in PTC and may support risk stratification, although calibration, threshold use, and clinical utility require prospective validation.

llm.novelty_zh: 用Transformer融合多切片2.5D CT特征，实现甲状腺乳头状癌淋巴结转移的术前预测。
llm.summary_zh: ThyLNT在1560例PTC患者的多中心队列中，用Transformer融合DenseNet201编码的七个2.5D CT切片，预测术前淋巴结转移。模型在内部验证与五个外部队列中的AUC约为0.77至0.83，并探索了相关的多组学背景。

title: Comparison of interventional causal structure learning algorithms for gene regulatory network inference.
abstract: Background Causal structure learning offers a promising approach to studying gene regulation in cells, aiming to provide deeper mechanistic insights than purely association-based methods. Theoretical groundwork indicating that interventions improve identifiability of causal structure motivates the use of causal structure learning methods in scenarios with interventional information. Results This benchmark investigates the ability of existing causal structure learning algorithms to leverage the information revealed by targeted interventions to infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs). In this study synthetic single-cell perturbation data and experimental data from a clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR) screen are leveraged, and a suite of causal structure learning algorithms is evaluated on metrics tailored to synthetic ground truth and real biological data respectively. On synthetic data, accurate recovery of GRNs was achieved under favourable conditions: strong interventions, large sample sizes, and low measurement noise. For experimental data, no reliable ground truth is available, so inferred GRNs were assessed indirectly, using observed perturbation effects and curated regulatory annotations. Here, performance remained unreliable, with technical and biological noise and algorithmic scalability as limiting factors. This highlights a current gap between theoretical potential and practical application of causal structure learning for GRNs. Conclusions The benchmark provides insight into algorithm strengths and limitations and offers groundwork for further methodological development. We also provide an accessible software package for applying modern causal structure learning to custom datasets and thereby foster future exploration of its potential.

llm.novelty_zh: 系统评测干预性因果结构学习算法在合成与 CRISPR 数据上推断基因调控网络的能力，并提供配套软件包。
llm.summary_zh: 文章利用合成单细胞扰动数据和 CRISPR 筛选实验数据，评估一组因果结构学习算法从干预信息恢复基因调控网络的能力。结果显示在强干预、大样本和低噪声条件下可较好恢复，但在实验数据上因噪声与可扩展性问题表现不稳定。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 研究揭示了理论可识别性与实际应用之间的差距，为因果调控网络方法的改进提供了明确基准。
llm.limitations_zh: 真实实验数据缺乏可靠真值，实验结果只能通过扰动效应与注释的间接指标进行评估。

title: Auditing correlational gene regulatory networks through perturbation-grounded causal analysis for drug target prioritization
abstract: Gene regulatory network (GRN) inference for drug-target prioritization relies overwhelmingly on undirected co-expression, with highly connected “hub” genes routinely advanced as candidate regulators without independent causal verification. Although perturbation-based technologies now make direct causal validation feasible at genome scale, no study has directly tested whether correlational hub status reliably predicts causal regulatory importance or real-world druggability against an independent outcome rather than another network. This study evaluates that question and tests whether a simple, perturbation-free correction can recover any resulting predictive gap. Using the K562 essential-gene Perturb-seq dataset (2,285 pseudobulk CRISPR-interference profiles; 8,563 genes), an undirected correlational network and an independently constructed, perturbation-anchored causal network were built from identical data and compared across 1,868 shared genes via Spearman rank correlation and top-K overlap across three thresholds; both rankings were cross-referenced against Open Targets for documented drug mechanisms, and a logistic regression classifier quantified predictive value for known-drug status, with two specificity-adjustment refinements tested symmetrically on both networks. Rank agreement was weak and threshold-invariant (ρ = 0.091–0.158; zero top-20 overlap), yielding 77 correlational “false hubs” and 92 causal “hidden drivers.” Hidden drivers showed no category-level druggability enrichment (7.6% vs. 10.9% background) but included compelling, independently corroborated exceptions, CDK7 and AURKB, both invisible or near-invisible to correlation alone. Causal position outperformed correlational position for predicting known-drug status (AUC 0.655 vs. 0.625; combined 0.704), and specificity correction applied to the correlational network matched causal performance without perturbation data (AUC 0.655), reaching AUC 0.736 combined. These findings indicate correlational hub centrality is an unreliable proxy for causal importance and druggability, but a simple correction can recover much of the causal network’s advantage when tested empirically in both directions.

llm.novelty_zh: 用扰动锚定的因果网络系统比较相关性 hub 基因与因果调控重要性，并检验一种无需扰动数据的特异性校正。
llm.summary_zh: 作者在 K562 必需基因 Perturb-seq 数据上分别构建相关性网络与扰动锚定的因果网络，比较两者在 1868 个共有基因上的排序一致性，并以 Open Targets 中的已知药物机制作为外部结局。结果显示二者排序一致性很弱，因果位置对已知药物状态的预测略优，而对相关网络施加的特异性校正可达到相近效果。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 研究质疑以相关性 hub 基因作为药物靶点候选的做法，对基于调控网络的靶点优先排序具有实际警示意义。
llm.limitations_zh: 因果网络相对相关网络的预测优势幅度较小（AUC 0.655 对 0.625），摘要也未讨论药物注释本身的覆盖偏差。

title: G-quadruplex profiling using single-cell CUT&Tag offers insight into the epigenetic landscape of the developing mouse brain
abstract: BACKGROUND: G-quadruplexes (G4s) are non-canonical DNA structures that have gained increasing attention for their potential roles in gene regulation and role in neurodegenerative diseases and cancer. Despite their biological significance, G4 structures have not been studied systematically across tissues and cell types. RESULTS: In this study, we employ G4 single-cell CUT&Tag (G4 scCUT&Tag) to characterize G4 landscapes in postnatal mouse brain cells, leveraging single-cell analytical approaches commonly used in scRNA-Seq and scATAC-Seq datasets. Using conventional single-cell omics workflows to process and explore our data, we distinguish distinct cell lineages based on G4 heterogeneity and establish that a subset of lineage-specific genes show unique promoter G4s. Multi-omics integration with scRNA-Seq gene expression profiles, using both a covariance-based technique (canonical correlation analysis) and a transfer learning-based approach, enables more accurate cell-type annotation. These integrations not only reveal correlations between G4 signal and gene expression, but demonstrate that G4 scCUT&Tag enables detailed examination of G4 heterogeneity in complex tissues and supports integrative analysis of G4 profiles with other omics layers, offering new insights into the epigenomic landscapes of the developing brain. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings establish G4 scCUT&Tag as a framework for investigating the cellular heterogeneity of G4 landscapes in complex tissues and provide a basis for exploring their relationships with gene regulation and other layers of chromatin organization.

llm.novelty_zh: 将单细胞CUT&Tag用于G4结构图谱绘制，并借助迁移学习与典型相关分析实现跨组学细胞类型注释。
llm.summary_zh: 作者使用G4 scCUT&Tag检测出生后小鼠脑细胞的G4景观，区分出不同谱系并发现部分谱系特异基因具有独特的启动子G4。将G4数据与scRNA-seq联合分析后，典型相关分析和迁移学习方法均可用于提高细胞类型注释的准确性。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为研究组织中G4结构的细胞异质性及其与基因调控的关系提供了单细胞层面的实验框架。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及G4与基因表达关系的因果证据，也未说明注释提升的定量幅度。

title: SPiCe: integrative spatial modelling of cellular plasticity using graph neural networks and geostatistics
abstract: Cellular plasticity, the ability of cells to change phenotype in response to intrinsic and environmental cues, is central to development and disease, yet remains difficult to quantify. We present SPiCe, a framework that integrates graph neural networks and spatial regression models to predict and explain cell state variation in spatial transcriptomics data. Applied to epithelial-mesenchymal plasticity (EMP) in breast cancer, SPiCe shows that mesenchymal states are stabilised by copy number alterations and microenvironmental cues, whereas hybrid states remain unpredictable, and uncovers long-range myofibroblast influences on EMP. Together, these analyses provide a framework for quantifying cellular plasticity and its spatial determinants.

llm.novelty_zh: 将图神经网络与空间地质统计回归结合，量化细胞可塑性的空间决定因素。
llm.summary_zh: SPiCe 结合图神经网络与空间回归预测空间转录组中的细胞状态变化，并以乳腺癌上皮-间质可塑性为例，揭示拷贝数变异和肌成纤维细胞的长程影响。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为细胞可塑性的空间决定因素分析提供了框架。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及跨数据集的验证。

title: Joint-Cabernet enables scalable single-cell joint profiling of transcriptomes with DNA methylation and hydroxymethylation in the brain
abstract: DNA methylation, particularly CpG methylation, is vital to brain development and function, yet conventional bisulfite-based detection cannot distinguish 5-methylcytosine (5mC) from 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC), which is enriched in neurons. We develop Joint-Cabernet, a bisulfite-free single-cell platform simultaneously profiling 5mC, 5hmC, and transcriptomes at scale. Applying Joint-Cabernet to 47,712 adult mouse brain nuclei, we resolve cell-type-specific hydroxymethylation landscapes and identify elevated 5hmC in active genes and regulatory elements. We further uncover two modes of methylation-associated gene activation: progressive demethylation linked to neurodevelopmental genes and stable hydroxymethylation associated with cellular maintenance. Joint-Cabernet enables high-resolution dissection of gene regulation by 5mC and 5hmC.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出无亚硫酸氢盐的单细胞平台，可同时测定转录组、5mC与5hmC。
llm.summary_zh: Joint-Cabernet通过无亚硫酸氢盐方法在单细胞水平联合检测转录组、5mC和5hmC，并应用于47712个成年小鼠脑细胞核。作者揭示了5hmC在活跃基因与调控元件上的富集，以及脱甲基化与羟甲基化两种基因激活模式。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为区分5mC与5hmC并研究其与基因调控的关系提供了可扩展的单细胞技术。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及方法的检测灵敏度和覆盖率限制。

title: AURA decomposes spatial gene expression to reveal composition-dependent regulation
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics at single-cell resolution can relate each cell’s expression to its surroundings, yet analyses still depend on predefined domains or niches. We present AURA, a statistical framework that tests and quantifies how a cell type’s gene expression depends on the continuous composition of its local neighborhood, separating this from cell-level transcriptional output and flagging transcript spillover. AURA is calibrated in simulations, scales to millions of cells, and applies to Xenium, CosMx and Visium HD data. Across lymph node, fibrotic lung and cancer, it reveals widespread small composition-dependent effects organized into a few interpretable axes.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出统计框架，检验细胞基因表达对局部邻域组成的依赖，并区分转录本溢出。
llm.summary_zh: AURA 是一个空间转录组统计框架，用于检验细胞类型的基因表达如何依赖连续的邻域组成，并将其与细胞自身的转录输出分离。作者报告其在模拟中校准良好，并在 Xenium、CosMx 与 Visium HD 数据的淋巴结、纤维化肺和癌症样本中发现广泛存在的小幅组成依赖效应。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法为微环境对基因表达的影响提供了统计工具，与虚拟细胞的状态建模关系较为间接。
